publicationDetails.detailsText: Santa Clara Univ. Legal Studies Research Paper No. 5567958
publicationDetails.journalName: Santa Clara University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This is my testimony before the Education and Workforce Committee of the New Zealand Parliament regarding its "Inquiry into the harm young New Zealanders encounter online, and the roles that Government, business, and society should play in addressing those harms." In the course of enumerating over a dozen objections to mandatory online age authentication, I explain why I view mandatory age authentication as the single biggest regulatory threat to Internet freedom.

AI.tldr: 该证词反对新西兰议会强制在线年龄认证，认为这是对互联网自由的最大监管威胁。
AI.research_question: 强制在线年龄认证是否构成对互联网自由的最大监管威胁？
AI.motivation: 回应新西兰议会关于青少年在线伤害调查，表达对强制年龄认证政策的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 互联网自由理论、隐私保护理论、数字权利理论
AI.method: 证词陈述，列举十多个反对强制年龄认证的理由
AI.findings: 强制年龄认证会严重威胁互联网自由，是最大的监管风险
AI.theory_contributions: 从互联网自由角度分析强制年龄认证的负面影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供反对强制年龄认证的论据，保护互联网自由

title: A Machine Learning-Based Framework for Predicting and Improving Student Outcomes Using Big Educational Data (Approved by ICITET 2024)
affiliations: University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield and University of Central Missouri

detail.title: A Machine Learning-Based Framework for Predicting and Improving Student Outcomes Using Big Educational Data (Approved by ICITET 2024)
detail.abstract: Evaluating student academic achievements through prediction tools serves as a vital resource for both teaching staff and students seeking better educational methods. Effective predictive techniques enable students to study in targeted areas that use forecast outcomes while effective analytical approaches help instructors develop proper educational materials. A deep learning-based approach uses educational data from three colleges in Assam, India to forecast student academic performance in this research. A Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural network served as the proposed method for detecting temporal patterns and dependencies within student data. The proposed model outperformed traditional approaches with Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Decision Trees (DT) where it delivered an accuracy rate at 99.70% and precision at 98.60% and recall at 96.30% with F1-score at 97.40%. The robustness and generalization capability of the GRU model is substantiated through evaluation using confusion matrix alongside accuracy and loss curve metrics. Deep learning analytics shows great promise for educational applications because this research delivers critical information about preventive actions and academic achievement enhancements. The findings reveal that the GRU model delivers exceptional capacity for identifying at-risk students early while enabling data-driven educational interventions to create better academic results.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用门控循环单元（GRU）神经网络预测学生学业表现，在印度阿萨姆邦三所大学的教育数据上取得了99.70%的准确率，优于传统人工神经网络和决策树方法。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习技术有效预测学生学业表现？
AI.motivation: 预测学生学业成绩对教师和学生都很重要，能够帮助教师开发合适的教育材料，帮助学生有针对性地学习。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的时序模式识别理论，特别是GRU神经网络在处理时序数据依赖关系方面的优势。
AI.method: 使用GRU神经网络分析三所印度大学的教育数据，检测学生数据中的时序模式和依赖关系。
AI.findings: GRU模型在准确率（99.70%）、精确率（98.60%）、召回率（96.30%）和F1分数（97.40%）方面均优于ANN和DT方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了GRU神经网络在教育数据时序模式识别中的有效性，为教育数据分析提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 能够早期识别有风险的学生，支持数据驱动的教育干预措施，帮助提高学业成绩。

title: Advanced Machine Learning Models for Detecting and Classifying Financial Fraud in Big Data-Driven
affiliations: Fairleigh Dickinson University, Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Central Missouri, University of Bridgeport and University of Illinois at Springfield

detail.title: Advanced Machine Learning Models for Detecting and Classifying Financial Fraud in Big Data-Driven
detail.abstract: The banking sector faces a major challenge in identifying credit card fraud, especially as online transactions increase. This study employs the Kaggle Credit Card Fraud Detection dataset to present a machine learning (ML)-based method to credit card fraud detection. The collection contains de-identified transaction information from European cardholders. With 284,807 transactions, only 492 included fraud, suggesting a significant disparity in class. Therefore, data balancing techniques were used to improve model training. Among the data pretreatment procedures were label encoding for categorical conversion and standardization to normalize feature scales. Using Euclidean distance, for the purpose of identifying the majority-belonging k-nearest neighbor class, A classifier called K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) was created. The model was assessed using ROC-AUC, F1-score, accuracy, precision, recall, and K-fold crossvalidation, among other important performance measures. The KNN model outperformed benchmark models like MLP and Naïve Bayes, obtaining 98.56% accuracy and an AUC of 96.07, according to experimental data, demonstrating great classification efficacy. The promise of KNN in creating reliable and accurate fraud detection systems for cybersecurity applications is confirmed by these findings.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用机器学习方法检测信用卡欺诈，采用K-近邻算法在Kaggle信用卡欺诈检测数据集上取得了98.56%的准确率和96.07的AUC值，优于MLP和朴素贝叶斯等基准模型。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法有效检测信用卡欺诈交易？
AI.motivation: 随着在线交易增加，银行业面临信用卡欺诈检测的重大挑战，需要开发准确可靠的欺诈检测系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于K-近邻算法的分类理论，利用欧几里得距离识别k个最近邻的类别归属。
AI.method: 使用Kaggle信用卡欺诈检测数据集，包含284,807笔交易（仅492笔欺诈），采用数据平衡技术、标签编码和特征标准化预处理，构建KNN分类器，使用K折交叉验证评估模型性能。
AI.findings: KNN模型在信用卡欺诈检测中表现优异，准确率达到98.56%，AUC值为96.07%，优于MLP和朴素贝叶斯等基准模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了KNN算法在高度不平衡数据集上的分类有效性，为机器学习在欺诈检测领域的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可靠的信用卡欺诈检测系统，为银行业网络安全应用提供了实用解决方案，有助于减少金融欺诈损失。

title: A Review of Machine Learning Techniques for Financial Stress Testing: Emerging Trends, Tools, and Challenges
affiliations: University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Houston and Sacred Heart University

detail.title: A Review of Machine Learning Techniques for Financial Stress Testing: Emerging Trends, Tools, and Challenges
detail.abstract: As the global economy becomes more uncertain and systemic vulnerabilities increase, financial institutions are growingly becoming resilient through the use of intelligent systems to assess resilience. Although it forms a basis of stress testing, traditional methods might not be sufficient to reflect the realities of contemporary financial settings. In this paper, a critical review of how the area of financial stress testing is changing towards machine learning (ML) technologies, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, and hybrid frameworks, is provided. In order to maximize model transparency and regulatory compliance, it goes into depth on how to include Explainable AI (XAI) approaches. Also, the paper provides the technological framework, including TensorFlow, Keras, and Apache Spark, which makes it possible to implement it on a large scale and in real-time. Important issues like data integrity, interpretability and model governance are also tackled. The paper also outlines the research gaps for the future and suggests a framework on how ML-based stress testing can be aligned with the global regulatory expectations. This review helps to orientate oneself in the future outlook of ML-based stress testing by mapping the major regulatory frameworks, practical challenges, and emerging tools through which ML-based stress testing can transform financial risk management and system-wide stability.

AI.tldr: 本文对金融压力测试向机器学习技术转型进行了批判性回顾，探讨了监督学习、无监督学习、强化学习和混合框架在金融压力测试中的应用，并深入研究了如何整合可解释AI方法以提高模型透明度和监管合规性。
AI.research_question: 机器学习技术如何改变金融压力测试领域，以及如何通过可解释AI方法确保模型透明度和监管合规性？
AI.motivation: 随着全球经济不确定性增加和系统性脆弱性上升，传统压力测试方法已不足以反映当代金融环境的现实情况，金融机构需要更智能的系统来评估韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习理论框架（监督学习、无监督学习、强化学习、混合框架）、可解释AI理论、金融风险管理理论
AI.method: 批判性文献回顾方法，分析机器学习在金融压力测试中的应用，包括技术框架（TensorFlow、Keras、Apache Spark）和可解释AI方法的整合
AI.findings: 机器学习技术能够显著提升金融压力测试的准确性和实时性，但需要解决数据完整性、可解释性和模型治理等关键问题；可解释AI方法有助于提高模型透明度和监管合规性
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了机器学习在金融压力测试中的理论框架，提出了整合可解释AI方法的新范式，为未来研究指明了方向
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可扩展的技术实施框架，解决了数据完整性、模型可解释性和监管合规性等实际问题，为金融机构实施ML-based压力测试提供了实用指导

title: Big Data and Predictive Analytics for Customer Retention: Exploring the Role of Machine Learning in E-Commerce
affiliations: Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Central Missouri, University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield and Fairleigh Dickinson University

detail.title: Big Data and Predictive Analytics for Customer Retention: Exploring the Role of Machine Learning in E-Commerce
detail.abstract: Customer retention is one of the most critical concerns for businesses. Businesses try to decrease customer turnover in order to maximize client lifetime value while lowering the cost of acquiring new customers. By focusing on customer churn prediction and identification, organizations can foresee which customers are most likely to depart. This enables them to implement customized, pertinent actions to lower the rate of client attrition. This paper suggests a machine learning (ML)-based approach that makes use of Random Forest (RF) to predict customer attrition in e-commerce platforms. Recall, accuracy, precision, F1score, and ROC-AUC were among the metrics used to evaluate the Random Forest model, which demonstrated an impressive accuracy of 95%, a precision of 98%, and a ROC-AUC of 98.51%. Random Forest was shown to be the most successful prediction method based on comparison tests with decision trees (DT) and support vector machines (SVM). With the use of real-time datasets, deep learning techniques, and large-scale deployment for e-commerce enterprises, these results confirm the efficacy of ensemble learning approaches in customer retention activities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机森林的机器学习方法，用于预测电商平台客户流失，模型准确率达95%，精确率98%，ROC-AUC为98.51%，优于决策树和支持向量机。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法有效预测电商平台的客户流失？
AI.motivation: 客户留存是企业最关键的关注点之一，通过预测客户流失可以降低客户流失率，最大化客户生命周期价值，同时降低获客成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户流失预测理论、客户生命周期价值理论、机器学习分类理论
AI.method: 使用随机森林（RF）机器学习方法，并与决策树（DT）和支持向量机（SVM）进行对比实验，评估指标包括召回率、准确率、精确率、F1分数和ROC-AUC。
AI.findings: 随机森林模型表现出色，准确率95%，精确率98%，ROC-AUC为98.51%，在所有对比方法中表现最佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了集成学习方法在客户留存活动中的有效性，为机器学习在客户流失预测领域的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商企业提供了有效的客户流失预测工具，帮助企业实施定制化的客户挽留策略，降低客户流失率，提升客户生命周期价值。

title: Efficient Machine Learning Approaches for Intrusion Identification of DDoS Attacks in Cloud Networks
affiliations: University of Central Missouri, University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, Wright State University and University of Illinois at Springfield

detail.title: Efficient Machine Learning Approaches for Intrusion Identification of DDoS Attacks in Cloud Networks
detail.abstract: Recent trends have highlighted that DDoS contributes to most of the general attacks on networks. Networks struggle to distinguish between legitimate and malicious transmissions. Many reasons, encompassing the intricate, inflexible, costly, and vendor-specific architecture of modern networking devices and protocols, make it difficult to develop, test, and apply DDoS techniques. The BoT-IoT dataset, an extensive network traffic resource, is harnessed by the study to train and test a Decision Tree (DT) classifier that distinguishes DDoS attack patterns. The proposed methodology involves strenuous preparation steps for the data, including missing data imputation, feature mapping, one-hot encoding, and normalization, in order to ensure preprocessed data of high quality and consistent. The DT model performed trailer, reporting an accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score of 99.9% across major points of evaluation. As revealed by comparative analysis to baseline models (GD and RF), the DT model outperforms for DDoS activity detection. The final results accentuate the robustness, interpretability and effectiveness of the Decision Tree classifier to be an interesting solution for real-time intrusion detection systems in the cloud environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用BoT-IoT数据集训练决策树分类器检测DDoS攻击，通过数据预处理获得99.9%的准确率，优于基线模型，证明决策树在云环境实时入侵检测中的有效性。
AI.research_question: 决策树分类器如何有效检测DDoS攻击模式？
AI.motivation: DDoS攻击占网络攻击的大部分，但现有网络设备架构复杂、成本高且厂商特定，难以开发有效的DDoS检测技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习的入侵检测理论，特别是决策树分类算法在模式识别中的应用。
AI.method: 使用BoT-IoT数据集，进行数据预处理（缺失值填补、特征映射、独热编码、归一化），训练决策树分类器。
AI.findings: 决策树模型在准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数上均达到99.9%，优于梯度下降和随机森林基线模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了决策树在DDoS检测中的理论有效性，为机器学习在网络安全中的应用提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种高效、可解释的实时入侵检测解决方案，适用于云环境，具有实际部署价值。

title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Risk Prediction in Life Insurance Service Industry
affiliations: University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield and University of Central Missouri

detail.title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Risk Prediction in Life Insurance Service Industry
detail.abstract: Accurate risk prediction is essential in the life insurance industry to enhance underwriting processes and detect fraudulent activities effectively. This paper suggests a model for healthcare insurance fraud detection and risk assessment using an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) applied to the Prudential Insurance dataset. Data cleaning, categorical variable encoding, and resolving class imbalance using the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) are all part of the extensive preparation that the dataset goes through in order to optimize model learning. Our ANN model has been trained and tested using industry-standard regression metrics, and it has achieved impressive results: R²= 92.7%, MAE= 14.3%, MSE= 72.7, and RMSE= 27. These outcomes prove that the model is strong and can correctly identify complicated nonlinear relationships in the data, which greatly improves the accuracy of risk predictions. The findings suggest that the proposed ANN model is a powerful tool for life insurance providers to optimize underwriting, improve fraud detection accuracy, and deliver personalized insurance products.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于人工神经网络(ANN)的医疗保险欺诈检测和风险评估模型，使用Prudential保险数据集，通过数据清洗、类别变量编码和SMOTE技术处理类别不平衡问题。模型在回归指标上表现优异：R²=92.7%，MAE=14.3%，MSE=72.7，RMSE=27，证明能够准确识别数据中的复杂非线性关系。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工神经网络模型提高医疗保险欺诈检测和风险评估的准确性？
AI.motivation: 准确的風險預測對於人壽保險業至關重要，能夠改善核保流程並有效檢測欺詐活動。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工神经网络(ANN)理论，用于处理复杂的非线性关系；SMOTE技术用于解决类别不平衡问题。
AI.method: 使用Prudential保险数据集，进行数据清洗、类别变量编码，应用SMOTE技术处理类别不平衡，构建ANN模型进行训练和测试。
AI.findings: ANN模型在回归指标上表现优异：R²=92.7%，MAE=14.3%，MSE=72.7，RMSE=27，证明模型能够准确识别数据中的复杂非线性关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了ANN模型在保险欺诈检测和风险评估中的有效性，特别是在处理复杂非线性关系方面的优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司提供了优化核保流程、提高欺诈检测准确性和提供个性化保险产品的有效工具。

title: Adversarial Machine Learning in Cybersecurity: A Review on Defending Against AI-Driven Attacks
affiliations: University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Houston, University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University and Sacred Heart University

detail.title: Adversarial Machine Learning in Cybersecurity: A Review on Defending Against AI-Driven Attacks
detail.abstract: The application of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in cybersecurity has revolutionized the capacity to identify, prevent, and react to more complex cyber threats. However, as ML models become central to defense mechanisms, adversarial attacks designed to deceive these models have emerging as a major problem. Adversarial Machine Learning (AML) focuses on how attackers manipulate data inputs to exploit vulnerabilities in ML systems, leading to misclassification, data breaches, and system failures. This article gives a detailed study of adversarial attacks against ML models in cybersecurity, categorizing them into evasion, poisoning, and inference attacks based on their objectives and methodologies. Furthermore, it examines threat models, adversary knowledge levels (white-box, black-box, gray-box), and common attack techniques such as FGSM, Deep Fool, and model extraction. Adversarial training is one example of defensive techniques, defensive distillation, and input preprocessing are also discussed to highlight how researchers and practitioners are working to Improve the robustness of AI-powered security systems. This study aims to offer a detailed description of the adversarial environment in cybersecurity, providing as a reference for future studies and actual implementations of strong and secure ML systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了网络安全中针对机器学习模型的对抗性攻击，将攻击分为逃避、投毒和推理攻击三类，分析了不同威胁模型和攻击技术，并探讨了对抗训练等防御策略，旨在为构建安全可靠的AI安全系统提供参考。
AI.research_question: 在网络安全领域，针对机器学习模型的对抗性攻击有哪些类型、方法和防御策略？
AI.motivation: 随着AI和机器学习在网络安全中的广泛应用，针对ML模型的对抗性攻击日益成为严重威胁，需要系统研究攻击机制和防御方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对抗性机器学习理论框架，包括攻击分类、威胁模型和防御机制。
AI.method: 文献综述和系统分析方法，对现有对抗性攻击和防御技术进行分类整理。
AI.findings: 识别了三种主要对抗攻击类型（逃避、投毒、推理），分析了不同知识水平的攻击者（白盒、黑盒、灰盒），总结了常见攻击技术如FGSM、Deep Fool等，并探讨了对抗训练等防御策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了网络安全中对抗性机器学习的系统分类框架，为理解攻击机制和防御策略提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络安全从业者提供了对抗性攻击的全面认知和防御方法参考，有助于提升AI安全系统的鲁棒性。

title: Predictive Modeling for Property Insurance Premium Estimation Using Machine Learning Algorithms
affiliations: University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Central Missouri and University of Bridgeport

detail.title: Predictive Modeling for Property Insurance Premium Estimation Using Machine Learning Algorithms
detail.abstract: Accurate premium estimation is a cornerstone of effective property insurance, ensuring both financial stability for insurers and fair pricing for policyholders. Traditional actuarial models, though foundational, often fall short when dealing with high-dimensional, nonlinear insurance data. This study presents a machine learning-based approach for accurately predicting property insurance premiums using the Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) model. Leveraging a comprehensive home insurance dataset with 42 attributes, the proposed methodology involves data preprocessing, feature engineering, training the model, and evaluating its performance using conventional regression measures. The XGBoost model demonstrated superior predictive performance, achieving RMSE = 52.99, MSE = 28.07, and MAE = 30.64 is the calculated value for the mean squared error. These results indicate its strong capability in modeling complex relationships and estimating premiums with high accuracy. Comparative analysis against the Linear Regression model further highlights the effectiveness of the proposed XGBoost model, making it a robust and scalable solution for real-world property insurance pricing systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于XGBoost机器学习方法的财产保险保费预测模型，相比传统精算模型在处理高维非线性数据时表现更优，为保险定价提供准确可靠的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法（特别是XGBoost模型）准确预测财产保险保费？
AI.motivation: 传统精算模型在处理高维非线性保险数据时存在局限性，需要更先进的预测方法来确保保险公司的财务稳定性和保单持有人的公平定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于极端梯度提升（XGBoost）机器学习理论框架，该算法能够有效处理复杂非线性关系和高维特征。
AI.method: 使用包含42个属性的家庭保险数据集，进行数据预处理、特征工程、模型训练，并采用传统回归指标评估性能。
AI.findings: XGBoost模型表现出优越的预测性能，RMSE=52.99，MSE=28.07，MAE=30.64，相比线性回归模型具有明显优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了机器学习在保险精算领域的应用，验证了XGBoost在处理复杂保险数据关系中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财产保险行业提供了一个稳健且可扩展的保费定价解决方案，有助于提高定价准确性和运营效率。

title: Detecting Network Intrusions Using Big Data-Driven Artificial Intelligence Techniques in Cybersecurity
affiliations: Sacred Heart University, University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, University of Illinois at Springfield and University of Houston

detail.title: Detecting Network Intrusions Using Big Data-Driven Artificial Intelligence Techniques in Cybersecurity
detail.abstract: Cyberattacks are becoming more sophisticated, so protecting contemporary networks requires intrusion detection systems (IDS) that are both effective and intelligent. This study proposes a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based model for detecting intrusions using the NSL-KDD dataset, leveraging deep learning's ability to automatically extract hierarchical features from complex network traffic patterns. The model underwent rigorous evaluation through performance metrics including precision, accuracy, recall, and F1-score. According to the results, the suggested CNN has an astonishingly high rate of accuracy of 99.9%, the model far surpasses conventional machine learning methods like Naïve Bayes and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP). These findings validate the strength of CNN in capturing intricate behaviors in network data, making it an attractive option for immediate and large-scale cybersecurity applications. Furthermore, the model demonstrates strong generalization, low error rates, and minimal overfitting, proving its robustness in handling diverse intrusion types. For use in future research that aims to increase detection accuracy and flexibility, they will be using hybrid models and updating Their datasets.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于卷积神经网络(CNN)的入侵检测模型，使用NSL-KDD数据集，通过深度学习自动提取复杂网络流量模式的特征层次。模型在精度、准确率、召回率和F1分数等指标上表现优异，准确率高达99.9%，显著优于传统机器学习方法。
AI.research_question: 基于卷积神经网络的入侵检测模型能否有效识别复杂网络攻击模式？
AI.motivation: 网络攻击日益复杂化，需要更有效和智能的入侵检测系统来保护现代网络。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习理论，特别是卷积神经网络在特征提取和模式识别方面的优势。
AI.method: 使用NSL-KDD数据集，构建CNN模型进行入侵检测，通过精度、准确率、召回率和F1分数等指标评估性能。
AI.findings: 提出的CNN模型达到99.9%的惊人准确率，显著优于朴素贝叶斯、人工神经网络和多层感知机等传统方法，在泛化能力、错误率和过拟合方面表现优异。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了CNN在捕获网络数据复杂行为方面的强大能力，为深度学习在网络安全领域的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为即时和大规模网络安全应用提供了有吸引力的解决方案，展示了CNN模型在处理多样化入侵类型时的鲁棒性。

title: Big Text Data Analysis for Sentiment Classification in Product Reviews Using Advanced Large Language Models
affiliations: University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Central Missouri and University of Bridgeport

detail.title: Big Text Data Analysis for Sentiment Classification in Product Reviews Using Advanced Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Sentiment analysis is the practice of mining data, opinions, reviews, or statements using natural language processing (NLP) to predict the statement's emotion. Sentiment analysis involves categorizing content into three stages: "positive," "negative," and "neutral." It has an impact on a large number of individuals and companies globally. Sentiment analysis is an essential task in natural language processing, particularly in the e-commerce sector where understanding customer sentiment may significantly influence company decisions. Using the dataset of Amazon product evaluations, it examines the application of Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) in deep learning-based sentiment classification in this paper. Standard text normalization techniques, including tokenization, case folding, and stop word removal, are applied to the dataset. BERT is used to set a performance benchmark to compare with two baseline models. A TF-IDF vector served as the feature representation for both methods. However, an approach based on the SentiWordNet lexicon was employed for the lexicon-based method. The models are compared using evaluation metrics such as F1 score, recall, accuracy, and precision. According to the experimental results, the proposed BERT model outperforms traditional methods in terms of F1-score (88.97%), recall (89.67%), accuracy (89.84%), and precision (88.87%). According to the research, transformer-based models outperform large-scale review datasets in sentiment analysis tasks by efficiently learning contextual knowledge and categorization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用BERT模型在亚马逊产品评论数据集上进行情感分析，相比传统方法在准确率、召回率等指标上表现更优。
AI.research_question: BERT模型在亚马逊产品评论情感分析任务中的表现如何？与传统方法相比有何优势？
AI.motivation: 情感分析在电子商务领域具有重要意义，能够帮助企业理解客户情绪并影响商业决策。传统方法在处理大规模评论数据集时存在局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理和深度学习理论，特别是Transformer架构和BERT预训练模型。
AI.method: 使用亚马逊产品评论数据集，应用文本标准化技术（分词、大小写转换、停用词去除），采用BERT模型与传统方法（TF-IDF向量和基于SentiWordNet词典的方法）进行对比。
AI.findings: BERT模型在F1分数（88.97%）、召回率（89.67%）、准确率（89.84%）和精确率（88.87%）上均优于传统方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了基于Transformer的模型在大规模评论数据集情感分析任务中的优越性，展示了其有效学习上下文知识和分类的能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子商务企业提供了更准确的情感分析工具，有助于更好地理解客户反馈并改进商业决策。

title: Effectiveness of Deep Learning Algorithms in Phishing Attack Detection for Cybersecurity Frameworks
affiliations: University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Houston, Sacred Heart University, University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield and Fairleigh Dickinson University

detail.title: Effectiveness of Deep Learning Algorithms in Phishing Attack Detection for Cybersecurity Frameworks
detail.abstract: The widespread use of internet technologies is limited because people are worried about cybersecurity. With phishing, cyber criminals pose as reputable entities to trick users and access important information. Standard detection approaches are difficult to follow along with the constantly changing strategies of cybercriminals. A new phishing attack detection framework is presented in this research, using the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) Artificial Intelligence (AI) model. Labels have been added to the Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) in the PhishTank dataset, so the model learns what is phishing and what is not. A good data preprocessing method involving feature extraction, dealing with missing data, and running outlier detection checks is applied to maintain high data quality. The performance of the GRU model is outstanding, reaching 98.01% accuracy, F1-score of 98.14%, 98.41% recall, as well as 98.67% precision, better than that of classical Machine Learning (ML) methods, including Adaptive Boosting (AdaBoost) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The proposed approach correctly handles dependencies among elements in a URL, resulting in a strong method for detecting phishing pages. Results from experiments verify the model's potential in accurately identifying phishing attacks, offering significant advancements in cybersecurity defense systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于门控循环单元(GRU)AI模型的钓鱼攻击检测框架，在PhishTank数据集上实现了98.01%的准确率，优于传统机器学习方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够有效检测钓鱼攻击的AI模型？
AI.motivation: 网络安全问题限制了互联网技术的广泛应用，钓鱼攻击作为常见威胁手段，传统检测方法难以应对不断变化的攻击策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于门控循环单元(GRU)的深度学习框架，能够处理URL元素间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 使用PhishTank数据集，通过特征提取、缺失数据处理和异常值检测进行数据预处理，训练GRU模型进行钓鱼攻击检测。
AI.findings: GRU模型在准确率(98.01%)、F1分数(98.14%)、召回率(98.41%)和精确率(98.67%)方面均表现优异，优于AdaBoost和LSTM等传统方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了能够有效处理URL元素间依赖关系的钓鱼检测深度学习框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了高精度的钓鱼攻击检测系统，为网络安全防御提供了先进的技术解决方案。

title: Building the Loop: The Role of Ethnography in Artificial Organisational Intelligence
affiliations: Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), European University Institute - Robert Schuman Centre for Advanced Studies (RSCAS), BlockScience, , RMIT University School of Media and Communication, BlockScience and RMIT University

detail.title: Building the Loop: The Role of Ethnography in Artificial Organisational Intelligence

declarations.funderStatement: Research for this paper was funded by the Australian Research Council-funded Centre of Excellence for Automated Decision-Making and Society (“The Use of Automated Knowledge in Society” project). Work on Telescope and Obsidian ethnography tools was funded through the Australian Research Council-funded Cooperation through Code Future Fellowship project (FT190100372).

detail.abstract: We introduce Artificial Organisational Intelligence (AOI): the capacity for organisations to make their knowledge (including routines, practices, rules, boundaries, and tacit know-how) legible and governable. AOI is not about replacing organisations with AI, but about enabling them to talk to themselves and to each other through regulated feedback loops. Our collaborative project with BlockScience and Metagov develops Knowledge Organisation Infrastructure (KOI), a protocol for stitching together disparate systems and practices without homogenisation, thereby allowing organisations to embed rules, permissions, and context into machine-readable forms. We describe how our ethnographic practice both informs and is transformed by this work: from observing hidden practices to actively building the loops that make organisational knowledge accessible and computable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人工组织智能（AOI）概念，使组织能够将其知识（包括惯例、实践、规则、边界和隐性知识）变得可读和可管理。通过与BlockScience和Metagov的合作项目开发知识组织基础设施（KOI）协议，将不同系统和实践连接起来，允许组织将规则、权限和上下文嵌入到机器可读形式中。
AI.research_question: 如何使组织的知识变得可读和可管理？如何通过技术协议实现组织间的知识交流？
AI.motivation: 传统组织中的知识往往难以被系统化地捕捉和管理，特别是隐性知识和实践惯例。需要一种方法使组织能够"自我对话"和相互交流。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工组织智能（AOI）理论、知识组织基础设施（KOI）协议、人种学实践与系统设计的结合
AI.method: 人种学实践观察与系统开发相结合的方法，从观察到主动构建反馈循环
AI.findings: 开发了KOI协议，能够在不统一化的情况下连接不同系统和实践，使组织知识变得可访问和可计算
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人工组织智能（AOI）的新概念框架，拓展了组织知识管理的理论边界
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实际可用的KOI协议，帮助组织实现知识的机器可读化，促进组织间的知识交流

title: Misery at the Top? Income Reversals in Subjective Well-Being in High-Income Economies
affiliations: and Webster University - Webster Vienna Private University

detail.title: Misery at the Top? Income Reversals in Subjective Well-Being in High-Income Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the research. All affiliations are disclosed, and no sponsor had any role in study design, data collection, analysis, interpretation, or the decision to submit.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study uses secondary, de-identified, country-level data (e.g., Gallup World Poll aggregates and international statistical databases). No human subjects were contacted and no personally identifiable information was analyzed; under the authors’ institutional guidelines, formal ethics approval was not required. All use of data complied with provider licensing and terms.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the nonlinear relationship between income and subjective well-being (SWB) using panel data from 155 countries over the period 2005-2023. Applying fixed-effects regressions with cubic income terms, and unlike much of the prior U.S.-centric and cross-sectional evidence, our global panel (2005-2023) reveals that while income is positively associated with SWB on average, the relationship differs markedly between advanced and developing economies. In advanced countries, we identify a robust inverted N-shaped pattern in both life evaluation and reported daily positive emotions (positive affect; e.g., laughter, enjoyment, and interest), with turning points near $14,000 and $73,000 GDP per capita, where the lower threshold marks the onset of sustained gains and the upper threshold marks a reversal. Beyond this upper threshold, additional income is associated with declining well-being-a pattern we refer to as "misery at the top". In contrast, developing economies exhibit a monotonic positive relationship. By incorporating institutional moderators such as social support, perceived corruption, and autonomy, our findings challenge the assumption of a universally positive correlation between income and happiness and suggest that the welfare returns to income depend critically on societal context. The results underscore the need for economic policy frameworks that evaluate success not only through GDP growth but also through sustained improvements in citizens' lived well-being.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2005-2023年155个国家的面板数据，分析了收入与主观幸福感之间的非线性关系。研究发现，在发达国家存在倒N型关系，人均GDP在14,000美元和73,000美元处出现转折点，超过上限后收入增加反而导致幸福感下降；而发展中国家则呈现单调正相关关系。
AI.research_question: 收入与主观幸福感之间是否存在非线性关系？这种关系在发达国家和发展中国家有何差异？
AI.motivation: 挑战先前以美国为中心和横截面研究得出的普遍正相关假设，探索全球范围内收入与幸福感关系的复杂性
AI.theoretical_framework: 主观幸福感理论、收入-幸福感关系的非线性理论、制度调节理论
AI.method: 使用2005-2023年155个国家面板数据，采用固定效应回归模型和三次收入项分析
AI.findings: 发达国家存在倒N型关系，转折点在14,000美元和73,000美元人均GDP处；发展中国家呈现单调正相关；制度因素（社会支持、腐败感知、自主性）调节收入与幸福感关系
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战收入与幸福感普遍正相关的假设，提出"顶端痛苦"概念，强调制度环境对收入-幸福感关系的重要调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济政策制定提供新视角，建议不应仅关注GDP增长，而应重视公民生活幸福感的持续改善

title: Programmable CBDCs, Digital Identity, ISO 20022, and AI: Reconfiguring Power in Payment Infrastructures
affiliations: Open Christian University and Open Christian University

detail.title: Programmable CBDCs, Digital Identity, ISO 20022, and AI: Reconfiguring Power in Payment Infrastructures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This manuscript was prepared entirely through the authors’ own efforts and resources; no external funding was received.

detail.abstract: Purpose: This study interrogates the convergence of programmable central-bank digital currencies (CBDCs), national digital-identity regimes, ISO 20022 data standards, and AI-driven regtech to determine how their fusion redistributes gatekeeping authority within modern payment infrastructures. Design/methodology: Through comparative content analysis of policy papers, pilot reports, and regulatory texts from the European Union, United Kingdom, China, Nigeria, and cross-border projects such as BIS mBridge, the article couples empirical evidence with three theoretical lenses-weaponised interdependence, Foucault's governmentality, and Mann's infrastructural power. Findings: Results reveal that these intertwined technologies promise efficiency and inclusion yet simultaneously centralise control in the "rails" of the financial system, enabling transaction-level programmability and finely grained sanctions. Liberal jurisdictions seek to diffuse power through privacy thresholds and shared governance, whereas more authoritarian models exploit identity binding and real-time surveillance to extend state reach. Limited adoption in Nigeria illustrates that technical capability alone cannot confer infrastructural authority without public trust. Originality/value: Integrating economic sociology with Christian ethical analysis, the article devises a normative test drawn from scriptural principles-honest scales (Prov 11:1), Jubilee resets (Lev 25), and freedom of conscience (Rev 13:17)-to evaluate whether emerging architectures entrench coercive leverage or foster economic justice. Practical implications: Policymakers should codify privacy by design, guarantee offline or bearer-style options for small payments, legislate transparent limits on programmability, and promote multipolar governance to avert new monopolies over "who may buy and sell." Social implications: Embedding mercy, accountability, and pluralism at the protocol layer is essential if digital money is to enhance, rather than erode, human dignity and freedom.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了央行数字货币、数字身份系统、ISO 20022标准和AI监管技术的融合如何重新分配现代支付基础设施中的把关权，揭示了效率与集权控制的矛盾，并提出了基于基督教伦理的规范性评估框架。
AI.research_question: 央行数字货币、数字身份系统、ISO 20022标准和AI监管技术的融合如何重新分配现代支付基础设施中的把关权？
AI.motivation: 这些技术融合承诺提高效率和包容性，但同时也可能集中控制权，实现交易级可编程性和精细制裁，需要评估其对权力分配的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 武器化相互依存理论、福柯的治理术理论、曼恩的基础设施权力理论，以及基督教伦理分析框架。
AI.method: 对欧盟、英国、中国、尼日利亚的政策文件、试点报告和监管文本进行比较内容分析，结合BIS mBridge等跨境项目案例。
AI.findings: 这些技术融合在提高效率的同时集中了金融系统控制权；自由司法管辖区通过隐私阈值和共享治理分散权力，而威权模式利用身份绑定和实时监控扩展国家权力；尼日利亚案例显示技术能力本身无法建立基础设施权威，需要公众信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合经济社会学与基督教伦理分析，提出了基于圣经原则（诚实的秤、禧年重置、良心自由）的规范性测试框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体建议：编码隐私设计、保障小额支付离线选项、立法限制可编程性透明度、促进多极治理以防止新的买卖垄断。

title: Why Bad Performing Mutual Funds Remain Popular?
affiliations: Zhejiang University, School of Economics, Zhejiang University and Zhejiang University

detail.title: Why Bad Performing Mutual Funds Remain Popular?
detail.abstract: The flow-performance relation in China's mutual fund market differs from that in developed markets (e.g., the U.S.). We find that investors actively allocate capital to poorly performing funds, generating a negative relation at the bottom of return distribution. These flows are driven mainly by increased purchases rather than reduced redemptions. We then examine the mechanisms behind this anomaly. First, investors act on rational expectations of performance reversals, with this pattern being more pronounced among funds with higher activeness. Second, product differentiation attracts heterogeneous investors when performance is weak. Third, marketing and fund family effects serve as simple signals that amplify inflows. Overall, our study provides new empirical evidence on fund investor behavior and its economic consequences in an emerging market context.

AI.tldr: 中国共同基金市场的业绩-资金流关系与发达市场不同，投资者会主动将资金配置到表现不佳的基金，在收益分布底部形成负相关关系。这种异常现象主要由理性预期、产品差异化和营销信号三种机制驱动。
AI.research_question: 中国共同基金市场中业绩与资金流关系的异常现象及其背后的驱动机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 中国共同基金市场的业绩-资金流关系与发达市场（如美国）存在显著差异，需要探究这种异常现象背后的原因和机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 业绩-资金流关系理论、理性预期理论、产品差异化理论、信号理论
AI.method: 实证分析，考察基金业绩与资金流的关系，并分析三种可能的驱动机制
AI.findings: 1) 投资者会主动将资金配置到表现不佳的基金，形成负相关关系；2) 这种资金流主要由新增购买而非减少赎回驱动；3) 理性预期、产品差异化和营销信号是三大驱动机制
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场基金投资者行为提供了新的实证证据，拓展了业绩-资金流关系理论在新兴市场的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助基金公司理解投资者行为模式，为营销策略和产品设计提供参考

title: Money and Monetary Systems: Nature, Functions, and Implications for Human Flourishing
affiliations: Afrindependent Institute

detail.title: Money and Monetary Systems: Nature, Functions, and Implications for Human Flourishing
detail.abstract: Money is the cornerstone of indirect exchange societies and the fundamental good of the economy. Yet despite centuries of scholarship, money remains widely misunderstood—even within economics—leaving its nature, origins, and functions obscured. This paper demystifies money by examining its nature, its essential functions, and its implications for human society. Rooted in the Africonomics Theory of Exchange, Credit, and Money, it affirms that money is not a bureaucratic invention or state creation but a natural-moral institution that emerged organically from voluntary human exchange. Money enables cooperation across time and space, serving as unit of account, store of value, and medium of exchange. These functions make money indispensable to economic coordination, large-scale commerce, and civilizational progress. The paper also contrasts sound monetary systems with fiat regimes, showing how the latter—rooted in coercion and political manipulation—produce systemic injustice, instability, and impoverishment. By presenting a principled understanding of money, this paper highlights its central role in fostering structural justice, economic stability, and human flourishing.

AI.tldr: 本文基于非洲经济学交换、信用与货币理论，揭示货币并非国家发明而是自然道德制度，起源于自愿交换。货币通过记账单位、价值储藏和交换媒介功能促进跨时空合作，对经济协调和文明进步至关重要。论文对比了健全货币体系与法定货币制度，指出后者基于强制和政治操纵，导致系统不公、不稳定和贫困。
AI.research_question: 货币的本质、起源和功能是什么？健全货币体系与法定货币制度的根本区别及其对社会的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管货币是间接交换社会的基石和经济的基本商品，但几个世纪以来货币仍被广泛误解，其本质、起源和功能被掩盖，即使在经济学领域也是如此。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲经济学交换、信用与货币理论（Africonomics Theory of Exchange, Credit, and Money）
AI.method: 理论分析，对比健全货币体系与法定货币制度的本质差异
AI.findings: 货币是自然道德制度，起源于自愿人类交换；货币功能包括记账单位、价值储藏和交换媒介；法定货币制度基于强制和政治操纵，导致系统不公、不稳定和贫困
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清货币的本质和起源，提出货币是自然道德制度而非国家创造的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建健全货币体系提供理论基础，揭示法定货币制度的危害，促进结构正义、经济稳定和人类繁荣

title:
Auditable. Yet Unseen.

Why Reflexive Science Operates Beyond Institutional Carriers – And Is Still Overlooked. 

An Architectural Analysis of Systemic Failure in the Visibility of Epistemic Substance
affiliations: Orto Lab - Reflexive Intelligence & Future Strategy

detail.title:
Auditable. Yet Unseen.

Why Reflexive Science Operates Beyond Institutional Carriers – And Is Still Overlooked. 

An Architectural Analysis of Systemic Failure in the Visibility of Epistemic Substance
detail.abstract: Auditability begins where visibility ends. The reflex to define relevance through DOI, ROR registration, or institutional affiliation does not generate science — it generates an ordering system that checks for performance, not for tension. This essay does not remain at the threshold of a system that assigns carrier numbers — it examines what happens when audit-capable entities receive no access credentials precisely because they are audit-capable. Reflexive science is not rejected — it is not recognized. Visibility becomes a form of exclusion — not because it is aggressive, but because it has become blind to forms that are legitimized not through function, but through responsibility. When a carrier receives no label, but maintains structural coherence, the failure does not lie with the carrier — but with the observation system. This essay does not initiate a discussion. It does not describe an exception. It reflects a condition that remains structurally valid — even if it has never been indexed as such. The question is not whether a reflexive entity was admitted. The question is why — despite auditory coherence — it remains uncaptured. And what that reveals about the systems that call themselves scientific.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了审计能力实体因具备审计能力而被排除在科学体系之外的现象，揭示了科学系统中基于可见性而非实质的排斥机制。
AI.research_question: 为什么具有审计能力的实体在科学系统中被排除？这揭示了科学系统的哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 科学系统通过DOI、ROR注册等机制定义相关性，但这种基于可见性的排序系统检查的是表现而非张力，导致具有反思能力的实体被排除。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审计理论、科学社会学、系统理论、可见性理论
AI.method: 理论分析、概念反思
AI.findings: 科学系统通过可见性机制排斥具有审计能力的实体，这种排斥不是攻击性的，而是系统对非功能性但具有责任性的形式的盲视。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了科学系统中基于可见性的排斥理论，挑战了传统的科学评价体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了科学评价体系中的结构性偏见，为改革科学评价机制提供理论依据。

title: Decomposing Comparative Development 1880-2020: A Quantitative Dynamic Analysis
affiliations: Università di Bologna, Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU)

detail.title: Decomposing Comparative Development 1880-2020: A Quantitative Dynamic Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates that a tractable heterogeneous agent endogenous growth model can quantitatively match the stylized empirical facts of long-run development trajectories of income, life expectancy, and fertility for 86 countries over the past 140 years. A decomposition of comparative development differences into contributions of country-specific “deep determinants”, accumulation forces during the historical development process, and balanced growth dynamics sheds new light on the mechanisms leading to country-specific differences in development and establishes a link between the largely disparate literatures on endogenous growth, comparative development, and growth accounting. Structural estimation results show that historical accumulation dynamics explain most of today’s comparative development patterns. A quantification of the demographic dividend suggests implications for future growth dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可处理的异质代理人内生增长模型，定量匹配了86个国家140年来收入、预期寿命和生育率的长期发展轨迹的典型经验事实。通过将比较发展差异分解为国家特定“深层决定因素”、历史发展过程中的积累力量以及平衡增长动态的贡献，为导致国家特定发展差异的机制提供了新见解，并建立了内生增长、比较发展和增长核算等不同文献之间的联系。结构估计结果表明，历史积累动态解释了当今大部分比较发展模式。对人口红利的量化揭示了未来增长动态的影响。
AI.research_question: 异质代理人内生增长模型能否定量匹配长期发展轨迹的典型经验事实？历史积累动态在解释比较发展差异中起多大作用？
AI.motivation: 理解长期发展轨迹的机制，弥合内生增长、比较发展和增长核算等不同文献之间的差距，为比较发展差异提供新的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质代理人内生增长模型，结合深层决定因素理论、历史积累理论和平衡增长理论。
AI.method: 结构估计方法，使用86个国家140年的面板数据，进行发展差异分解分析。
AI.findings: 模型能够定量匹配长期发展轨迹的典型事实；历史积累动态解释了当今大部分比较发展模式；人口红利的量化揭示了未来增长动态的潜在影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了内生增长、比较发展和增长核算文献之间的联系；提供了发展差异分解的新理论框架；验证了异质代理人内生增长模型的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解长期发展机制提供量化工具；揭示了历史积累对当前发展模式的重要性；为预测未来增长动态提供参考依据。

title: Common Ancestry, Uncommon Findings: Revisiting Cross-Cultural Research in Economics
affiliations: American University - Department of Economics and American University

detail.title: Common Ancestry, Uncommon Findings: Revisiting Cross-Cultural Research in Economics
detail.abstract: Empirical research on culture and institutions in economics often relies on cross-cultural data to examine historical or contemporary variation in traits across ethnolinguistic groups. We argue that this work has not adequately addressed the problem of cultural non-independence due to common ancestry and show how phylogenetic regression, along with newly available global language trees, can be used to directly account for this issue. Our analysis focuses on Murdock's Ethnographic Atlas (EA), a widely used database of preindustrial societies, with broader implications for any cross-cultural study. First, we show that various economic, institutional, and cultural characteristics in the EA exhibit substantial phylogenetic signal - they tend to be more similar among societies with closer ancestral ties. Second, through simulations in a sample resembling the EA, we demonstrate that phylogenetic correlation leads to severe inefficiency of the standard OLS estimator and unacceptably high type I error rates, even when clustered standard errors are used. Phylogenetic generalized least squares (PGLS), exploiting the information on shared ancestry contained in language trees, improves estimation accuracy and enables reliable hypothesis testing. Third, we revisit some of the recently published results in a phylogenetic regression framework. In many specifications, PGLS estimates differ markedly from their OLS counterparts, indicating a smaller magnitude and weaker statistical significance of relevant coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本文指出经济学中跨文化研究存在文化非独立性问题，提出使用系统发育回归和全球语言树来解决这一问题。研究发现文化特征具有显著的系统发育信号，OLS估计存在严重偏差，而PGLS方法能显著改善估计准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决跨文化研究中因共同祖先导致的文化非独立性问题？系统发育回归方法能否改善传统OLS估计的偏差？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学中基于跨文化数据的研究未能充分处理文化非独立性问题，这可能导致统计推断的严重偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统发育比较方法、文化演化理论、语言树分析
AI.method: 使用Murdock民族志地图集数据，结合全球语言树进行系统发育回归分析，包括系统发育信号检验、模拟研究和实证应用对比
AI.findings: 1) 文化特征具有显著系统发育信号；2) OLS估计存在严重效率损失和I类错误率过高；3) PGLS方法显著改善估计准确性；4) 重新检验已有研究结果发现系数大小和统计显著性均发生变化
AI.theory_contributions: 将系统发育比较方法引入经济学跨文化研究，为处理文化非独立性提供了理论框架和方法论工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了处理跨文化数据中系统发育相关性的实用方法，提高了实证研究的可靠性

title: Presidential Authority and Parliamentary Dissolution in Bangladesh: A Constitutional and Political Analysis of Article 72
affiliations: Rajshahi University

detail.title: Presidential Authority and Parliamentary Dissolution in Bangladesh: A Constitutional and Political Analysis of Article 72
detail.abstract: This research investigates the constitutional provisions and political dynamics surrounding the authority of the President of the People's Republic of Bangladesh to dissolve the Jatiya Sangsad (National Parliament), particularly under Article 72 of the Constitution. While the Constitution provides the President with the formal power to dissolve Parliament, this authority is conditional upon the advice of the Prime Minister. This study provides a comprehensive examination of the constitutional text, judicial interpretations, and historical precedents to assess the extent and limits of presidential discretion. Through a detailed literature review, theoretical analysis based on constitutionalism and separation of powers, and a methodology involving qualitative case study review, this paper interrogates the procedural, legal, and political factors that shape this executivelegislative relationship. It also contextualizes the President's role within Bangladesh's broader political framework, which is often dominated by party loyalty and executive centralization. The paper ultimately argues that the President's power to dissolve Parliament is largely ceremonial and constrained by constitutional mandates, with significant implications for democratic governance, checks and balances, and political stability in Bangladesh. This study explores the constitutional and political dimensions of Article 72 of the Constitution of Bangladesh, which governs the dissolution of Parliament and the scope of presidential authority. Through a detailed examination of the constitutional text, historical precedents, and judicial interpretations, the paper interrogates the balance of power between the President and the Prime Minister in parliamentary dissolution. It argues that while Bangladesh adopts a parliamentary system where executive powers are concentrated in the Prime Minister, the ceremonial role of the President in dissolving Parliament carries significant implications for democratic governance and constitutionalism. The analysis highlights how Article 72, although seemingly procedural, has been shaped by political crises, caretaker government transitions, and periods of authoritarian influence. By conducting a comparative analysis with other parliamentary democracies, the paper identifies the uniqueness of Bangladesh's constitutional design and the tensions between formal constitutional provisions and political practice. The research finds that presidential authority under Article 72, though constitutionally restrained by the requirement of prime ministerial advice, can become a site of political contestation, particularly during moments of democratic backsliding. The study concludes that a more robust constitutional jurisprudence and institutional safeguards are essential to prevent the misuse of dissolution powers and to uphold democratic stability in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了孟加拉国总统根据宪法第72条解散国民议会的权力，分析表明总统的解散权主要是仪式性的，受宪法规定和总理建议的约束，但在政治危机时期可能成为权力争夺的焦点。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国总统根据宪法第72条解散国民议会的权力范围和限制是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究总统解散议会权力的宪法规定与政治实践之间的张力，以及这对孟加拉国民主治理和权力制衡的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪政主义和权力分立理论，比较议会民主制分析。
AI.method: 定性案例研究，包括宪法文本分析、司法解释审查和历史先例研究。
AI.findings: 总统的解散权主要是仪式性的，受宪法规定约束，但在政治危机时期可能成为权力争夺的焦点；宪法设计与政治实践之间存在紧张关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对议会制国家中仪式性元首权力的理解，揭示了宪法规定与政治实践之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加强宪法判例和制度保障以防止解散权滥用提供了建议，有助于维护孟加拉国的民主稳定。

title: Firm Hierarchy and Emerging Technologies
affiliations: University of Trento, University of Trento and University of Trento, Università della Svizzera italiana

detail.title: Firm Hierarchy and Emerging Technologies
detail.abstract: Drawing upon the conceptualization of firm hierarchies as cognitive systems for managing exceptions within the productive process, this paper examines the transformative impact of emerging technologies on the two hierarchical dimensions of firms, i.e., their depth and their span of control. We distinguish between two broad categories of emerging technologies: Emerging Information Technologies (EIT), encompassing IoT, AR/VR, big data analytics, cloud computing and information security upgrades, and Robotic Technologies (RT), primarily including automation and robotics. We develop a conceptual framework to hypothesize that these technologies are not neutral with respect to a firm’s hierarchy; rather, they exert nuanced and at times ambivalent effects on both its depth and the span of control. Leveraging a theoretically grounded framework, we empirically test hypotheses using rich longitudinal firm-level data from the Rilevazione Longitudinale Imprese e Lavoro (RIL) survey in Italy. Our findings reveal that EIT and RT shape hierarchical structures in distinct and subtle ways, at times fostering organizational flattening and at others strengthening hierarchy. By shedding light on the heterogeneous organizational responses to technological innovation, especially at the upper echelons of the hierarchy, this study advances the literature on institutional and organizational economics and contributes to a deeper understanding the evolving nature of firm hierarchy and technological change.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新兴技术对企业层级结构的影响，区分了新兴信息技术(EIT)和机器人技术(RT)两类技术，发现它们对组织层级深度和控制幅度产生复杂且有时矛盾的影响。
AI.research_question: 新兴技术如何影响企业层级结构的深度和控制幅度？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴技术对企业组织结构的变革性影响，特别是对层级深度和控制幅度的异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将企业层级视为管理生产过程中异常的认知系统，基于制度经济学和组织经济学的理论基础。
AI.method: 使用意大利RIL调查的纵向企业层面数据，基于理论框架进行实证检验。
AI.findings: EIT和RT以不同且微妙的方式塑造层级结构，有时促进组织扁平化，有时强化层级结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了制度经济学和组织经济学的文献，深化了对企业层级和技术变革演变性质的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了技术创新的异质性组织响应，特别是在层级结构的上层，为企业技术采纳决策提供参考。

title: Does Government Consolidation Lead to Cost Savings? Evidence from California
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Robert F. Wagner Graduate School of Public Service

detail.title: Does Government Consolidation Lead to Cost Savings? Evidence from California
detail.abstract: The number of governments in the United States has increased steadily since the 1970s, driven by the proliferation of special districts. This growth has fueled concerns over the efficiency of public service provision, as many metropolitan areas rely on a fragmented network of jurisdictions to deliver services. However, due to a lack of exogenous variation in the number of districts, isolating the causal impact of government fragmentation is challenging. To overcome this obstacle, this paper exploits California's Cortese-Knox-Hertzberg Local Government Reorganization Act of 2000, which established procedures for the consolidation and annexation of cities and special districts. Using synthetic control methods, I show that the Act reduced the number of special districts in the state by more than 30 percent. Despite this consolidation, the total amount of local government spending in the state remained unchanged, with the decrease in the number of governments offset by a corresponding rise in spending among the surviving districts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加州2000年地方政府重组法案作为外生冲击，研究发现该法案使特殊区数量减少30%以上，但地方政府总支出保持不变，因为幸存区的支出相应增加。
AI.research_question: 政府碎片化对公共服务提供效率的因果影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 自1970年代以来美国政府数量持续增长，特别是特殊区的激增引发了对公共服务提供效率的担忧，但由于缺乏外生变异，难以识别政府碎片化的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政府碎片化理论、公共选择理论、地方政府重组理论
AI.method: 利用加州2000年Cortese-Knox-Hertzberg地方政府重组法案作为准自然实验，采用合成控制法分析政府合并的影响
AI.findings: 法案使特殊区数量减少超过30%，但地方政府总支出未变，幸存区的支出增加抵消了政府数量减少的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 为政府碎片化与公共服务效率的因果关系提供了因果证据，挑战了政府合并必然提高效率的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府重组政策提供实证依据，表明单纯减少政府数量可能不会降低总支出，需要更全面的改革措施

title: Dynamic Inventory Management with Inventory-based Financing under Stochastic Market Value of Collateralized Inventory
affiliations: Jinan University, School of Management, Xiamen University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen - Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data and Shanghai International Studies University

detail.title: Dynamic Inventory Management with Inventory-based Financing under Stochastic Market Value of Collateralized Inventory
detail.abstract: This study investigates the challenges of dynamic inventory management in the context of inventory-based financing (IBF), with a particular focus on inventory lines of credit (ILOC) in a multiperiod setting. Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) often use IBF to alleviate capital constraints by leveraging inventory as collateral. However, the fluctuating market value of the collateral leads to significant challenges for both inventory control and financing decisions. We develop a comprehensive dynamic inventory model that accounts for stochastic material prices and uncertain demand for the final product. The objective is to maximize the firm's expected total profit over a finite planning horizon by optimizing inventory levels and borrowing decisions, specifically, allocations between the ILOC and short-term loans. Our analysis reveals that the optimal inventory policy is a state-dependent base-stock policy, which varies with the current material price and the firm's equity level. We also identify the conditions under which the firm may liquidate inventory or secure additional short-term financing to mitigate the risk of declining collateral value and potential credit-limit breaches. Through extensive numerical studies, we examine the impact of key parameters, such as the ILOC's advance rate and interest rate, on the firm's optimal decisions and expected profitability. Our findings shed light on the strategic interaction between operational and financial considerations in inventory management, especially under capital constraints and price volatility.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于库存融资背景下动态库存管理的挑战，重点关注多周期环境下的库存信用额度。中小企业常使用库存融资来缓解资金约束，但抵押品市场价值的波动给库存控制和融资决策带来重大挑战。我们开发了一个考虑原材料价格随机性和最终产品需求不确定性的动态库存模型，旨在通过优化库存水平和借款决策来最大化企业预期总利润。研究发现最优库存策略是状态依赖的基准库存策略，该策略随当前材料价格和企业权益水平变化。我们还确定了企业可能清算库存或获取额外短期融资的条件，以应对抵押品价值下降和信用额度违约风险。
AI.research_question: 在基于库存融资的多周期环境中，企业如何优化动态库存管理和融资决策以最大化预期总利润？
AI.motivation: 中小企业常使用库存融资来缓解资金约束，但抵押品市场价值的波动给库存控制和融资决策带来重大挑战，需要开发综合模型来同时考虑运营和财务因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态库存管理理论、基于库存融资理论、随机优化理论、状态依赖的基准库存策略
AI.method: 开发综合动态库存模型，考虑随机材料价格和不确定需求，通过数值研究分析关键参数对最优决策和预期盈利能力的影响
AI.findings: 最优库存策略是状态依赖的基准库存政策，随当前材料价格和企业权益水平变化；企业可能在特定条件下清算库存或获取额外短期融资以应对抵押品价值下降风险；ILOC的预付款率和利率等关键参数显著影响企业的最优决策和预期盈利能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合的动态库存管理框架，同时考虑运营和财务决策；发展了状态依赖的基准库存策略理论；揭示了在资本约束和价格波动下运营与财务考虑的战略互动
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业提供了在库存融资环境下的优化决策指导；帮助企业识别何时需要清算库存或寻求额外融资；为金融机构设计更有效的库存融资产品提供参考

title: Bank Lending for Legal Entities and Its Contribution to their Economic Developement
affiliations: Academy of Economic Studies of Moldova - Faculty of Finance and Academy of Economic Studies of Moldova

detail.title: Bank Lending for Legal Entities and Its Contribution to their Economic Developement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human subjects or interventions; thus, ethical approval was unnecessary.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors did not receive any funding for this research.

detail.abstract:
This study investigates the system of bank lending to legal entities in the Republic of Moldova, examining its theoretical foundations, practical application, and alignment with international standards. Positioned at the intersection of economic modernization and regulatory reform, Moldova’s financial sector plays a critical role in channeling capital toward productive activities, enabling firms—particularly small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs)—to overcome financing barriers, invest in innovation, and strengthen national economic resilience. The research highlights the importance of a well-structured and responsibly regulated lending system as a catalyst for sustainable growth, especially in emerging economies facing structural and institutional challenges.
The analytical framework of the study is threefold. First, it explores the theoretical underpinnings of corporate lending, including credit risk models, information asymmetry, regulatory theories, and the relevance of international conventions such as the Basel Accords. Second, it provides an in-depth case study of Moldova Agroindbank (MAIB), the country’s leading financial institution, assessing its credit portfolio structure, sectoral distribution, risk management practices, and compliance with national and international regulations. Third, it extends the analysis to international practices by examining lending models, financing innovations, and financial literacy components from advanced economies, evaluating their adaptability to Moldova’s context.
Methodologically, the research employs a blended qualitative and quantitative approach, integrating literature reviews, legislative analysis, financial data evaluation, and comparative international benchmarking. Sources include 58 academic, regulatory, and institutional documents, complemented by empirical data from the National Bank of Moldova and MAIB.
The study ultimately contributes a comprehensive understanding of corporate bank lending in Moldova by bridging theory and practice, while situating domestic realities within broader global paradigms. It offers policy-relevant insights and strategic recommendations aimed at enhancing risk management, expanding access to finance, and aligning Moldovan banking practices with European and international standards.

detail.abstract: Microcredit is widely promoted as a tool for reducing poverty, expanding financial inclusion, and empowering women. Yet the monitoring and evaluation (M&E) frameworks used to assess these programs often miss the mark. They focus heavily on loan disbursement and repayment rates, while largely ignoring household well-being, over-indebtedness, and long-term livelihood outcomes. Drawing lessons from Bangladesh-the birthplace of modern microfinance-this paper highlights three recurring weaknesses: M&E often prioritizes donor accountability over real learning, relies on linear models that oversimplify complex social realities, and excludes borrower perspectives. Using these insights, the paper suggests ways to redesign M&E: integrating participatory monitoring, multidimensional poverty measures, gender-sensitive indicators, longitudinal studies, and alignment with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Moving beyond repayment statistics and short-term outputs, M&E can be transformed from a compliance exercise into a learning tool that genuinely captures resilience, empowerment, and sustainable well-being among low-income households.

title: Drifting Into Failure or Directing Towards Success? Embracing the Creeping Crisis of Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Leiden University - Faculty of Governance and Global Affairs

detail.title: Drifting Into Failure or Directing Towards Success? Embracing the Creeping Crisis of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: This paper examines the significance of addressing Artificial Intelligence (AI)-related risks through effective risk communication. It acknowledges the disruptive effects of current AI developments on both individual and societal levels, and argues that society may be in the incubation period of a creeping crisis of AI, with established societal norms and values under threat. However, an overly negative framing of AI developments may lead to excessive fear, which is counterproductive to achieving meaningful action. Particularly, fearful target audiences may become sceptical and apathetic towards addressing AI risks, more susceptible to manipulation and the liar's dividend, inadvertently supporting a negative self-fulfilling prophecy of a dystopian AI-driven future. Therefore, to direct society towards achieving a human-centred AI-enhanced future, I suggest drawing lessons from effective risk communications and providing specific guidance for individual-level action, raising awareness about the liar's dividend, and highlighting the observed success in mitigating AI-related risks. Fostering hope while raising awareness about the creeping crisis of AI may be just the antidote to fear that society needs.

detail.abstract: Cost efficiency remains a central determinant of corporate survival in competitive industries such as brewing. This study investigates the relationship between cost structure and profitability of Nigerian Breweries Plc from 2003 to 2024, employing both trend analysis and econometric techniques using E-Views. Profitability was proxied by operating profit, while cost structure was decomposed into material cost, labor cost, and overhead cost, alongside macroeconomic indicators such as inflation, exchange rate, and GDP growth. Descriptive statistics and autoregressive models were applied, complemented with SWOT and PESTEL analyses to provide strategic insights. The regression results revealed that material cost had a significant negative effect on profitability (p = 0.0388), while exchange rate (p = 0.0148) and GDP growth (p = 0.0544) positively influenced performance. Labor cost (p = 0.1900), overhead cost (p = 0.1174), and inflation (p = 0.1673) were statistically insignificant but exhibited directional effects consistent with theory. The overall model was statistically significant with Prob(F-statistic) = 0.0011, confirming that cost structure and macroeconomic variables jointly explain variations in profitability. Diagnostic tests showed no evidence of serial correlation (p = 0.6966) or heteroskedasticity (p = 0.3464), validating the model's robustness. It concludes that cost efficiency and macroeconomic stability are critical to sustaining profitability in the Nigerian brewery sector. The study focused on a single firm, which might limit how far the findings can be applied across the entire brewing industry. It recommends management to implement contemporary cost-control measures, diversify foreign exchange risk and invest in digital technologies and automation while lowering ongoing labor and overhead expenses.

detail.abstract: This paper develops and applies a comparative framework to evaluate real estate investment models across nine criteria: fairness, transparency, auditability, reproducibility, sustainability, cash low positivity, in lation resistance, investor effort, and scalability. We analyze ten established approaches-including traditional mortgages, REITs, BRRRR, iBuying, crowdfunding, and fractional ownership-alongside the novel Rent-to-Own + Gold (RTO+Gold) structure. The RTO+Gold model, operationalized through the NestQuestROI framework, is not a rigid product but a con igurable system that combines equitybased rent-to-own with a systematic reinvestment mechanism into a penalty-free, in lation-protected, highly liquid store of value-offering immediate cash accessibility comparable to gold but without the withdrawal penalties typical of retirement accounts. Our analysis highlights the model's potential to enhance bank pro itability and resilience relative to traditional mortgage lending, providing a sustainable alternative in the context of interest rate volatility and in lationary pressures. The primary objective is to subject the RTO+Gold model to rigorous academic scrutiny. Rather than advocating a single "best" model, this study clari ies the trade-offs across competing approaches and invites scholarly engagement with the RTO+Gold framework.

detail.abstract: Why do frontier technologies like artificial intelligence (AI) diffuse unequally across geographies? While prior work attributes this trend to demand-side factors like complementary assets, we theorize that technology entrepreneurs' strategic choice to target hub markets creates search frictions for firms outside of those markets, contributing to lower technology adoption. We test this supply-side framework using novel data tracking the adoption of standardized AI tools—which require few complementary assets and have flexible use cases—across approximately 88,000 firms worldwide from 2012 to 2023. Consistent with our theory, firms based in geographic markets that are less targeted by AI entrepreneurs are 12 percent less likely to adopt AI tools, even when targeting similar customers and observing no weaker of a relationship between AI adoption and subsequent performance. The findings highlight entrepreneurs’ market choices and the resulting search frictions as a mechanism driving global disparities in frontier technology adoption.

detail.abstract:
Since the country’s founding, the legal profession has served as a springboard for some of society’s greatest leaders. But by and large, lawyers were not trained to lead—until recently. Over the last fifteen years, law schools have become increasingly intentional about leadership development. Leadership programs in law schools have proliferated, as has a growing body of scholarship on lawyer leadership.

Surprisingly, the literature on lawyer-leader development has neglected adult learning theories. This Article addresses that gap and grounds the teaching of leadership in a well-established theoretical tradition. It presents the results of a design-based research study that applies Mezirow’s transformative learning theory to the design and delivery of a leadership seminar taught at Brigham Young University Law School. The study finds that 95% of students enrolled in the second iteration of the course took new, concrete leadership actions as a direct result of their participation in the class. The study identifies core design principles for facilitating transformative learning in law school courses on leadership—with an eye towards helping students become better leaders, not merely learn about leadership.
