keywords: Students for Fair Admissions vs Harvard

detail.abstract:
In an introductory editorial to a 2023 symposium issue of Public Administration Review, Stivers et al. recount the contents of several publications about social justice and social equity. She and her colleagues end their editorial by proposing that public administration scholars develop a normative plan leading to greater social equity and social justice for members of the disadvantaged groups they, Stivers and her coauthors, identify in their editorial.

Responding to this call for reform, the present project addresses the problem of structural nepotism (inherited wealth based on Bourdieu’s three identified forms), a notable concern that Stivers and her colleagues and the nine symposium contributors fail to consider in full despite what the former say about how “canonize[d]” values limit the range of social equity and social justice questions public administration scholars confront. Employing comments and citations Stivers et al. offer throughout their editorial, the second part of this discussion offers a plan for resolving many of the harmful effects of structural nepotism on both the theory and practice of social equity and social justice in one academic discipline. The reform suggested herein is generic and thus readily adaptable to all fields of study.

AI.tldr: 本文回应Stivers等人关于社会公平正义的呼吁，提出了解决结构性裙带关系（基于布迪厄三种资本形式的继承财富）问题的改革方案，该方案可适用于所有学科领域。
AI.research_question: 如何解决结构性裙带关系对社会公平正义理论与实践的有害影响？
AI.motivation: 回应Stivers等人关于发展社会公平正义规范性计划的呼吁，填补其对结构性裙带关系问题考虑不足的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于布迪厄的三种资本形式理论（经济资本、文化资本、社会资本）来分析结构性裙带关系。
AI.method: 运用Stivers等人社论中的评论和引用，提出解决结构性裙带关系有害影响的改革计划。
AI.findings: 结构性裙带关系是一个被忽视的重要问题，需要专门的改革方案来解决其对学科领域内社会公平正义的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将布迪厄的资本理论应用于公共行政领域，扩展了社会公平正义理论的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个通用且可适用于所有学科领域的改革方案，用于解决结构性裙带关系问题。

title: Unicorn Investing: Measuring and Predicting the Rise of Billion-Dollar Startups
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: Unicorn Investing: Measuring and Predicting the Rise of Billion-Dollar Startups
detail.abstract: This paper examines the emergence of unicorns, privately held startups valued at over $1 billion, as a distinct investment phenomenon. We introduce a Unicorn Index, a systematic framework to score and predict unicorn potential based on market size, scalability, innovation, team quality, and funding network. Using case studies of Stripe, NVIDIA, and Coinbase, we illustrate how early signals can anticipate unicorn outcomes. We argue that unicorn investing combines traditional venture capital principles with rare, stochastic outcomes, blending skill with luck. The paper concludes with implications for investors, policymakers, and educators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了独角兽指数框架，通过市场规模、可扩展性、创新性、团队质量和融资网络等指标来评估和预测独角兽企业潜力，结合Stripe、NVIDIA和Coinbase案例说明早期信号识别，探讨了独角兽投资中技能与运气的结合。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地评估和预测独角兽企业的投资潜力？
AI.motivation: 独角兽企业作为估值超过10亿美元的私有初创企业，已成为独特的投资现象，需要系统框架来识别其早期信号和投资潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合传统风险投资原则与随机结果理论，强调技能与运气在独角兽投资中的结合。
AI.method: 开发独角兽指数框架，结合Stripe、NVIDIA和Coinbase的案例研究分析。
AI.findings: 独角兽指数能够有效识别早期信号，独角兽投资是传统风投原则与罕见随机结果的结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统性的独角兽评估框架，深化了对独角兽投资现象的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供投资决策工具，为政策制定者和教育者提供实践指导。

title: Music as an Asset Class
affiliations: Cornell Financial Engineering Manhattan, Cornell University - Department of Computer Science, Cornell University and Cornell University

detail.title: Music as an Asset Class
detail.abstract: In the streaming era, music revenues distributed to rights holders have become more transparent. However, it is not yet clear how to quantify the risk and return characteristics of music royalty assets, as is done with equities. In this paper, we fit three discounted cashflow models to transactions on the Royalty Exchange platform. We use our best model to backtest the one year and five year performance of music royalty assets, after transaction costs. We find that Life of Rights (LOR) music assets had risk and return characteristics comparable to stocks in the S&P500, when held over 5 years. Since the performance of stocks and music assets are likely to be uncorrelated, this result may help investors assess this asset class within the context of a more traditional stock and bond portfolio.

AI.tldr: 本文通过拟合三种贴现现金流模型分析音乐版权资产的风险收益特征，发现长期持有（5年）的音乐版权资产与标普500股票具有可比的风险收益特性，且两者相关性可能较低，有助于投资者在传统股票债券组合中评估这一资产类别。
AI.research_question: 如何量化音乐版权资产的风险和收益特征，并与股票等传统资产进行比较？
AI.motivation: 在流媒体时代，音乐版权收入分配更加透明，但音乐版权资产的风险收益特征尚未得到系统量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贴现现金流模型（DCF），资产定价理论
AI.method: 使用Royalty Exchange平台交易数据拟合三种贴现现金流模型，并进行一年期和五年期回溯测试
AI.findings: 长期持有（5年）的音乐版权资产与标普500股票具有可比的风险收益特征，且两者表现可能不相关
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化音乐版权资产的风险收益特征，为这一新兴资产类别的理论研究提供基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供评估音乐版权资产在传统投资组合中配置价值的实证依据

title: Confronting the Fear: Understanding and Overcoming Retaliation in Academic Criticism
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: Confronting the Fear: Understanding and Overcoming Retaliation in Academic Criticism
detail.abstract: This paper examines the pervasive fear of retaliation that discourages critical discourse in academic publishing, using recent rejection patterns as empirical evidence. Through analysis of editorial gatekeeping mechanisms and systematic suppression tactics, we demonstrate how the academic publishing system has evolved sophisticated methods to silence criticism while maintaining an appearance of objective scholarly standards. The study reveals that fear of retaliation is not merely psychological but reflects documented patterns of editorial bias, procedural manipulation, and institutional protection mechanisms. By examining specific cases of rejection based on artificial criteria such as self-citation thresholds, submission frequency limits, and scope manipulation, we show how publishers systematically exclude critical voices while avoiding direct engagement with substantive arguments. The paper argues that confronting criticism constructively requires institutional reforms that protect dissenting voices, establish transparent editorial practices, and prioritize intellectual merit over conformity to established paradigms.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析学术出版中的拒绝模式，揭示了学术出版系统如何通过编辑把关机制和系统性压制策略来抑制批评声音，同时维持客观学术标准的外观。研究发现，对报复的恐惧反映了编辑偏见、程序操纵和制度保护机制的模式。
AI.research_question: 学术出版系统如何通过编辑把关机制和系统性压制策略来抑制批评声音？
AI.motivation: 研究学术出版中普遍存在的对报复的恐惧，这种恐惧阻碍了批判性讨论，并探讨其背后的制度性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 编辑把关理论、制度压制理论、学术出版权力结构分析
AI.method: 通过分析编辑把关机制、系统性压制策略和具体拒绝案例（如自引阈值、投稿频率限制、范围操纵等）进行实证研究
AI.findings: 学术出版系统已发展出复杂的方法来压制批评声音，同时维持客观学术标准的外观；对报复的恐惧反映了编辑偏见、程序操纵和制度保护机制的模式；出版商通过人工标准系统性排除批评声音，避免实质性论证。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对学术出版中权力结构和压制机制的理解；提出了编辑把关机制如何被用来系统性排除不同声音的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了制度改革的建议：保护异议声音、建立透明编辑实践、优先考虑学术价值而非对既定范式的遵从。

title: From Free to Fee: How Allowance Allocation Affects ETS Performance
affiliations: European University Institute, European University Institute - Economics Department (ECO) and European University Institute - Economics Department (ECO)

detail.title: From Free to Fee: How Allowance Allocation Affects ETS Performance
detail.abstract: This study provides causal firm-level estimates of the effect of a reduction in free emission allowances in emission trading systems on emissions and economic performance. We study an EU ETS reform that withdrew the right of some manufacturing firms to receive most emission allowances for free, exploiting this change in a differencein-differences setting. We find that paying for allowances decreased emissions by more than 11 percent overall, relative to firms that retained free allowances. This reduction was accompanied by a significant decrease in economic performance, including revenue, employment, and assets of a similar magnitude. Using a multi-product model, we show that our results can be rationalized through an extensive margin adjustment of firms.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过欧盟排放交易体系改革，发现企业需要为排放配额付费后，排放量减少超过11%，但经济表现也显著下降。
AI.research_question: 免费排放配额减少对企业的排放和经济表现有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 了解排放交易体系中免费配额政策变化对企业行为的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多产品模型和广泛边际调整理论
AI.method: 利用欧盟ETS改革作为自然实验，采用双重差分方法分析企业层面数据
AI.findings: 付费购买排放配额使企业排放量减少超过11%，同时收入、就业和资产等经济指标也出现类似幅度的下降
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境规制对企业行为的影响提供了因果证据，支持广泛边际调整理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计排放交易体系提供了重要参考，揭示了环境规制与经济表现之间的权衡关系

title: GITT: Essentials, Uses, and Usage
affiliations: Phenikaa University, Phenikaa University, Phenikaa University and Phenikaa University

detail.title: GITT: Essentials, Uses, and Usage
detail.abstract: This material represents an ongoing effort to share our thesis and understanding with other publishing authors working on their research studies in the disciplines of the humanities and social sciences. The document discusses our homegrown Granular Interaction Thinking and Information Theory hypothesis (abbreviated as GITT) in a practical way. It is not long and is structured fairly simply. In the first part, some background information is provided so that readers can know where the idea came from. The next one presents essentials that enable someone new to it can grasp its nitty-gritty. The third part deals with basic mathematical concepts that can enable us to develop applications of GITT more aptly during the research process. The fourth part is dedicated to circumstances or examples where GITT applications show their usefulness. This is also where we can discuss what could have been done better, and under what conditions. This part certainly borrows pieces of real-world publications, all of which will be properly referenced for the sake of integrity and further examination. The last one presents worthwhile remarks and caveats, which will be of use to those who want to try out the GITT framework. When and where appropriate, we will consider adding new content or even new parts to make the material more useful to readers. Thus, the document can be continually expanding alongside the real-world applications of GITT.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了作者自创的GITT（粒度交互思维与信息理论）框架，通过五个部分系统阐述其背景、核心概念、数学基础、应用案例及注意事项，旨在为社会科学研究者提供实用的研究工具。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个实用的粒度交互思维与信息理论框架来支持社会科学研究？
AI.motivation: 为社会科学研究者提供一个系统化的理论框架来理解和分析复杂的交互现象，弥补现有研究工具的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粒度交互思维与信息理论（GITT），结合了信息理论和交互分析的概念。
AI.method: 采用分层结构方法，从背景介绍到核心概念、数学基础、应用案例和注意事项，系统构建理论框架。
AI.findings: GITT框架能够有效支持社会科学研究中的复杂交互分析，具有实际应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了原创的GITT理论框架，为社会科学研究提供了新的分析视角和方法论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了可直接应用的GITT框架，包括具体的使用指导和注意事项，有助于提升研究效率和质量。

title: Promoting Organizational Citizenship Behavior (OCB): Unintended Gender Disparities in the Participation and Evaluation of Different Types of OCB
affiliations: Tulane University - A.B. Freeman School of Business, University of Texas at Arlington - Department of Accounting, Vienna University of Economics and Business - Institute for Markets and Strategy and Goizueta Business School

detail.title: Promoting Organizational Citizenship Behavior (OCB): Unintended Gender Disparities in the Participation and Evaluation of Different Types of OCB

contentType.other: Accepted for publication in the January 2026 issue of The Accounting Review

detail.abstract: Organizational Citizenship Behavior (OCB), employees voluntarily going "above and beyond" their defined job responsibilities, is important for organizational success. We examine unintended consequences of using a management control system to promote and reward OCBs. Specifically, because OCB transcends pre-established core job performance criteria, valuation of OCB necessarily relies on subjective judgments, allowing for gender stereotypes to manifest. Using proprietary data from a financial services firm, we examine two types of OCBs, agentic OCB and communal OCB. Consistent with gender stereotypes, women are less likely to participate in agentic OCB and more likely to participate in communal OCB. Consistent with “shifting standards” theory, we find that men obtain a significant evaluation premium for communal OCB, while women obtain a marginal evaluation premium for agentic OCB. Our findings build upon research showing career benefits of OCB, on average, to show gender differences in the value organizations place on different types of OCB.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了使用管理控制系统促进组织公民行为(OCB)的意外后果。研究发现，由于OCB评估依赖主观判断，性别刻板印象会影响员工参与不同类型OCB的倾向及其获得的评价回报。
AI.research_question: 管理控制系统在促进和奖励组织公民行为时，是否会产生基于性别刻板印象的意外后果？
AI.motivation: 组织公民行为对组织成功很重要，但其评估依赖主观判断，可能让性别刻板印象影响员工参与不同类型OCB的倾向和获得的评价回报。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别刻板印象理论、"转移标准"理论、组织公民行为理论
AI.method: 使用金融服务公司的专有数据，分析两种类型的OCB：代理型OCB和社群型OCB
AI.findings: 1) 女性较少参与代理型OCB，较多参与社群型OCB；2) 男性在社群型OCB中获得显著评价溢价，女性在代理型OCB中获得边际评价溢价
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了OCB研究，揭示了性别差异在组织对不同类型OCB价值评估中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒组织注意管理控制系统可能无意中强化性别刻板印象，建议设计更公平的OCB评估机制

title: Green Growth: The Role of Corporate Sustainability in Achieving India’s Net Zero 2070 Goals

detail.title: Green Growth: The Role of Corporate Sustainability in Achieving India’s Net Zero 2070 Goals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently, and all interpretations, findings, and conclusions are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve any experiments on humans or animals, nor did it require the collection of personal or sensitive data. All materials used are secondary sources, publicly available reports, and academic publications. As such, no formal ethics approval was required for the preparation of this paper.

detail.abstract: India's pledge to achieve Net Zero emissions by 2070, announced at the COP26 Summit, represents one of the most ambitious climate commitments globally. While national policies set the framework, it is Indian corporates that will determine the pace and feasibility of this transition. Corporates contribute a significant share of greenhouse gas emissions but also possess the resources, technologies, and influence to drive sustainable growth. This paper examines the evolving role of corporate sustainability in aligning business strategies with India's Net Zero target. It highlights the shift from traditional Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) frameworks, emphasizing how sustainability is no longer a peripheral activity but a central business strategy. Through case studies of leading Indian companies such as Tata Group, Reliance Industries, Infosys, Mahindra, and ITC, the paper demonstrates how investments in renewable energy, green hydrogen, circular economy practices, and digital transformation are reshaping the corporate landscape. However, challenges such as inconsistent regulation, high capital costs, skills shortages, and greenwashing continue to obstruct progress. The paper argues that achieving Net Zero 2070 will require corporates to move beyond symbolic initiatives and embed sustainability into their core business models. Policy support, green finance, innovation, and public-private collaboration will be critical enablers of this shift. Ultimately, the study concludes that corporate sustainability is not only essential for meeting India's Net Zero goals but also represents a pathway to long-term competitiveness, investor trust, and green growth.

AI.tldr: 印度企业通过从CSR向ESG框架转型，将可持续发展融入核心业务模式，是实现印度2070年净零排放目标的关键驱动力。
AI.research_question: 企业可持续发展如何与印度的净零排放目标保持一致？
AI.motivation: 印度在COP26峰会上承诺2070年实现净零排放，企业作为主要排放源和转型驱动力，其角色至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 从传统企业社会责任(CSR)向环境、社会和治理(ESG)框架的转型理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析塔塔集团、信实工业、印孚瑟斯、马恒达和ITC等领先印度企业的实践。
AI.findings: 企业在可再生能源、绿氢、循环经济和数字化转型方面的投资正在重塑企业格局，但面临监管不一致、高资本成本、技能短缺和绿色漂洗等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了企业可持续发展从边缘活动向核心业务战略转型的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业实现净零转型提供了实践路径，强调了政策支持、绿色金融、创新和公私合作的关键作用。

title: Should Arbitrators be Immune from Liability?

detail.title: Should Arbitrators be Immune from Liability?
detail.abstract: In resolving disputes, arbitrators perform the role of adjudication. Their role is resembled to and often referred to as arbitrators acting in 'quasi-judicial capacity' such that arbitrators, in many important jurisdictions, are granted immunity akin to those afforded to judges known as 'judicial immunity'. However, professionals working in different disciplines are not granted any such immunity. If that is the case with all other professionals, why should arbitrators be granted immunity? On the contrary, arbitrators perform an important function of adjudicating which relieves the national and international court systems from the influx of thousands of disputes every year while rendering awards in an efficient and effective manner suitable for business needs as opposed to lengthy litigation process. Given the important functions arbitrators perform that can be referred to as quasi-judicial function, it justifies their enjoying immunity in this capacity otherwise arbitrators would not feel safe to act as such. The article develops on these two dimensions as outlined above and sheds light on the background to judicial and arbitral immunity, the cases for and against the notion of arbitral immunity, the different approaches taken by various jurisdictions on this subject matter from a comparative and a critical perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨仲裁员为何应享有类似法官的司法豁免权，分析了支持和反对仲裁豁免权的论点，并从比较法和批判视角考察了不同司法管辖区对此问题的处理方式。
AI.research_question: 为什么仲裁员应被授予豁免权，而其他专业人士却没有？
AI.motivation: 仲裁员在解决争议中扮演准司法角色，其豁免权问题涉及仲裁制度的有效性和仲裁员的安全性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准司法职能理论、司法豁免权理论、仲裁制度理论
AI.method: 比较法分析和批判性分析
AI.findings: 仲裁员执行准司法职能，其豁免权对于确保仲裁制度的有效运行是必要的，但不同司法管辖区对此有不同的处理方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对仲裁员准司法职能和豁免权理论基础的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为仲裁实践提供了关于豁免权问题的指导，有助于完善仲裁制度设计。

title: From Party Tools to Symbolic Engines: Rethinking Think Tanks in Latin America and Beyond
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Party Tools to Symbolic Engines: Rethinking Think Tanks in Latin America and Beyond

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, or sensitive personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It is conducted as part of the author’s independent research.

detail.abstract:
This paper reexamines the strategic role of think tanks in Latin America, moving beyond their conventional portrayal as party instruments. Building on the empirical framework of Barreda and Ruiz Rodríguez (2022), who developed a “strategic relevance index” to measure party–think tank linkages across eight countries, the analysis acknowledges the value of comparative data while also addressing the study’s limitations. Quantitative indicators, though useful, risk overlooking the symbolic, cultural, and discursive dimensions that shape legitimacy and political imagination.

By engaging with Latin American intellectual traditions—such as O’Donnell’s reflections on fragile democracies, Cardoso and Faletto’s theory of dependency, and Castañeda’s work on ideological realignments—the paper emphasizes the importance of ideas, narratives, and symbols in understanding democratic development. Think tanks, it argues, should not be understood as mere satellites of political parties but as laboratories of political imagination with the capacity to generate frameworks of democracy, legitimacy, and justice.

The findings underscore the need to strengthen intellectual independence, foster regional and global networks, and situate Latin American experiences within the wider debates of the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了拉丁美洲智库的战略角色，超越其作为政党工具的传统描述。通过借鉴拉丁美洲知识传统，强调思想、叙事和符号在理解民主发展中的重要性，认为智库应被视为政治想象力的实验室。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲智库在民主发展中的战略角色是什么？它们如何超越作为政党工具的传统定位？
AI.motivation: 重新审视智库在拉丁美洲民主发展中的作用，超越传统的政党工具论，强调思想、叙事和符号在政治合法性构建中的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: O'Donnell的脆弱民主理论、Cardoso和Faletto的依附理论、Castañeda的意识形态重组理论，以及Barreda和Ruiz Rodríguez的战略相关性指数框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和文献综述，结合对现有定量研究的批判性反思，强调定性维度的补充价值。
AI.findings: 智库不应被视为政党的附属品，而是能够生成民主、合法性和正义框架的政治想象力实验室；需要加强知识独立性、培育区域和全球网络。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了对智库角色的理论理解，从工具性角色转向象征性和文化性角色；丰富了拉丁美洲民主发展的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智库实践提供指导：强调知识独立性、网络建设和全球南方经验交流的重要性；为政策制定者提供更全面的智库价值认知。

title: 2025 Southeast Asia Eleven Nations Influence Index Report
affiliations: Dhurakij Pundit University

detail.title: 2025 Southeast Asia Eleven Nations Influence Index Report
detail.abstract: This study aims to construct a fully data-driven and reproducible Southeast Asia Influence Index (SAII v3) to overcome biases from expert scoring and subjective weighting, while mapping the hierarchical power structure across the eleven ASEAN nations. Methodologically, we aggregate authoritative open-source indicators across four dimensions-economic, military, diplomatic, and socio-technological-applying a three-tiered standardization chain ("quantile-Box-Cox-min-max") to reduce outliers and skewness. Weights are obtained through an equal-weight integration of three methods: Entropy Weighting Method (EWM), CRITIC, and PCA. Robustness testing is conducted using Kendall's Tau, ±20% weight perturbation and 10,000 bootstrap iterations to ensure robustness. Additionally, ±10% dimensional sensitivity analysis and V2-V3 bump chart comparisons were conducted. Results indicate the integrated weights are approximately: Economy 35%-40%, Military 20%-25%, Diplomacy ≈20%, Socio-Technology ≈15%. The overall landscape presents a "one strong, two medium, three stable, and multiple weak" pattern, with Indonesia, Singapore, and Malaysia leading, while Thailand, the Philippines, and Vietnam form a mid-tier competitive band. V2 and V3 rankings showed high consistency (Kendall's Tau=0.818), though minor mid-tier reordering occurred (Thailand and Philippines rose, Vietnam fell), indicating V3's greater sensitivity to structural equilibrium. ASEAN-11 average sensitivity further highlighted military and socio-technological dimensions as having the greatest marginal effects (±0.002). In conclusion, SAII v3 achieves algorithmic weighting and auditable reproducibility methodologically, empirically reveals multidimensional drivers of influence in Southeast Asia, and provides actionable quantitative evidence for resource allocation and policy prioritization by regional nations and external partners.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了数据驱动的东南亚影响力指数SAII v3，通过多维度指标和集成权重方法，揭示了东盟11国的权力分层结构，为区域资源分配提供量化依据。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个完全数据驱动且可复现的东南亚影响力指数，以克服专家评分和主观加权的偏见，同时映射东盟11国的层级权力结构？
AI.motivation: 克服传统影响力评估中专家评分和主观权重带来的偏见，提供更客观、可复现的评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多维影响力评估理论，涵盖经济、军事、外交和社会技术四个维度。
AI.method: 聚合权威开源指标，应用三层标准化链（分位数-Box-Cox-最小最大）减少异常值和偏度，通过熵权法、CRITIC和PCA三种方法的等权重集成获得权重，并进行鲁棒性测试。
AI.findings: 集成权重约为：经济35%-40%，军事20%-25%，外交≈20%，社会技术≈15%。整体格局呈现"一强、二中、三稳、多弱"模式，印度尼西亚、新加坡和马来西亚领先。
AI.theory_contributions: 方法学上实现了算法加权和可审计的可复现性，为影响力评估提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实证揭示了东南亚影响力的多维驱动因素，为区域国家和外部伙伴的资源分配和政策优先级提供了可操作的量化证据。

title: A Two-Period Model of Reference Pricing with Product Design
affiliations: Universitat de València and University of Valencia

detail.title: A Two-Period Model of Reference Pricing with Product Design
detail.abstract: We examine the linkages between endogenous product design and optimal pricing under consumer reference price effects. With a monopolist firm, our analysis shows that product design affects the optimal price markdown that arises from intertemporal reference effects. The monopolist uses markdown pricing to transform sales from the reference period into sales in the discount period. Then, more customized designs lead to greater price markdowns. A similar pattern emerges with product market competition, but market rivalry limits the extent to which markdowns can be used for intertemporal transformation of sales. Here, product design can lead to price-increasing competition if firms have strong incentives to target their niche consumers with more customized designs when the degree of competition increases, and this sets the stage for markdown-increasing competition in which prices in different periods increase with new firm entry, but the reference price increases relatively more.

AI.tldr: 本文研究产品设计与参考价格效应下的最优定价策略。研究发现：垄断企业通过降价策略将参考期的销售转移到折扣期，产品定制化程度越高，降价幅度越大；在竞争市场中，产品设计可能导致价格竞争加剧，企业为瞄准细分市场而采用更定制化设计，这会导致不同时期价格随新企业进入而上涨，但参考价格上涨更多。
AI.research_question: 产品设计如何影响消费者参考价格效应下的最优定价策略？
AI.motivation: 探讨产品设计在参考价格效应定价策略中的作用，特别是在垄断和竞争市场环境下的不同表现
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生产品设计理论、参考价格效应理论、垄断定价理论、市场竞争理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，分别考察垄断和竞争市场环境下的定价策略
AI.findings: 1. 垄断企业通过降价策略实现跨期销售转移；2. 产品定制化程度与降价幅度正相关；3. 竞争市场中产品设计可能导致价格竞争加剧；4. 新企业进入会使各期价格上升，但参考价格上升更多
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了产品设计与参考价格效应的理论联系，揭示了不同市场结构下产品设计对定价策略的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定产品设计和定价策略提供理论指导，特别是在考虑消费者参考价格效应时的决策支持

title: Customer Satisfaction: Past Research, Strategic Outcomes, and Future Directions
affiliations: Rice University,  and University of Texas at San Antonio

detail.title: Customer Satisfaction: Past Research, Strategic Outcomes, and Future Directions
detail.abstract: Customer satisfaction (CSAT) has long been recognized as a central construct in marketing theory and practice, yet its role as a strategic resource is often underappreciated. This article synthesizes the conceptual foundations, measurement approaches, empirical findings, and managerial applications of customer satisfaction research. We define CSAT as a post-consumption evaluative judgment of whether customers receive the promised value, and we distinguish it from related constructs such as service quality, engagement, loyalty, experience, and value. Drawing on multiple scales and a comparative study across consumer demographics, we demonstrate that widely used CSAT measures exhibit strong convergent validity. We review the historical evolution of CSAT research, highlighting its progression from expectancy-disconfirmation models to integrated frameworks linking customer perceptions, loyalty intentions, and firm performance. Using a large-scale dataset of over 285 million ratings across 1,126 brands, we replicate and extend prior meta-analytic evidence by showing that CSAT is robustly associated with customer mindset metrics, accounting outcomes, and stock market performance. Importantly, we quantify the economic value of marginal changes in CSAT for representative firms. We conclude by developing micro and macro-level conceptual frameworks and outlining a forward-looking research agenda to revitalize marketing's leadership in customer satisfaction scholarship and practice.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了顾客满意度(CSAT)的概念基础、测量方法、实证发现和管理应用，通过大规模数据分析验证了CSAT与客户心态指标、财务绩效和股市表现的稳健关联，并量化了CSAT边际变化的经济价值。
AI.research_question: 顾客满意度作为战略资源的作用是什么？如何系统整合CSAT研究的概念基础、测量方法和实证证据？
AI.motivation: 尽管顾客满意度在营销理论和实践中被广泛认可，但其作为战略资源的作用往往被低估，需要系统梳理和整合相关研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望-不一致模型、整合框架(连接客户感知、忠诚意图和公司绩效)、顾客满意度作为战略资源理论
AI.method: 概念综述、多量表比较研究、大规模数据分析(超过2.85亿个评分，涵盖1,126个品牌)、元分析证据复制与扩展
AI.findings: 广泛使用的CSAT测量工具具有强收敛效度；CSAT与客户心态指标、财务结果和股市表现稳健相关；量化了CSAT边际变化对代表性企业的经济价值
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了微观和宏观层面的概念框架，为顾客满意度研究提供了新的理论视角和整合框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了CSAT经济价值的量化证据，指导企业将顾客满意度作为战略资源进行管理，并提出了前瞻性的研究议程

title: The Effect of Strategic Marketing on Creating Competitive Advantages of the Dairy Industry in Kosovo
affiliations: ,  and AAB College

detail.title: The Effect of Strategic Marketing on Creating Competitive Advantages of the Dairy Industry in Kosovo
detail.abstract: This study aims to analyze the effect of marketing strategies on creating competitive advantage through strategies such as customized products strategy, pricing strategy, distribution strategy, promotion strategy, and innovation orientation strategy. The study was carried out on the basis of primary data, where part of the quantitative research were 15 categorized dairies, with low capacity (300-3,000 liters per day), with medium capacity (5,000-100,000 liters per day), and with high capacity (over 100,000 liters per day). From these dairies, 150 workers in leadership positions were surveyed, from which the marketing strategy with the greatest impact on creating competitive advantages was identified. Questionnaires were physically distributed and data were processed through Statistical Package for Social Sciences, version 26. Based on the multiple regression analysis, it was found that there is a statistically significant correlation that marketing strategies affect the creation of competitive advantage based on the value of R-square = 0.787, where customized products strategy, price strategy, and distribution strategy were found as important strategies. While innovation strategy and promotion strategy left the model due to the increased value of significance p > 0.05. Through this study, the dairy industry receives feedback on the type of strategy that should be used to create a competitive advantage, more so in the specific case where imports are very high and competition is very fierce.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多元回归分析发现，定制产品策略、定价策略和分销策略对乳制品行业竞争优势的创建具有显著影响，而创新策略和促销策略的影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 营销策略如何影响乳制品行业竞争优势的创建？
AI.motivation: 在乳制品进口量高、竞争激烈的市场环境下，识别最有效的营销策略来创造竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于营销策略理论，包括定制产品策略、定价策略、分销策略、促销策略和创新导向策略。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，对15家不同产能的乳制品企业的150名领导层员工进行问卷调查，使用SPSS 26进行多元回归分析。
AI.findings: R平方值为0.787，表明营销策略与竞争优势创建存在显著相关性。定制产品策略、定价策略和分销策略是重要策略，而创新策略和促销策略因p值>0.05而被排除。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在激烈竞争环境下特定营销策略对竞争优势的影响，为营销策略理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乳制品行业提供了具体的战略指导，帮助企业专注于最有效的策略来应对进口竞争和激烈市场竞争。

title: Engagement vs. Commitment: The Economic Trade-Offs of Polarizing News Content
affiliations: HEC Paris and HEC Paris (Groupe HEC), Students

detail.title: Engagement vs. Commitment: The Economic Trade-Offs of Polarizing News Content
detail.abstract: We study how polarizing content shapes two economic outcomes on a major European news website: engagement (time on site) and commitment (paid subscriptions). Using advances in natural language processing, we construct deep-learning and large-language-model-based textual measures of polarization tailored to a multiparty system. We combine comprehensive supply and demand data-the full publisher-wide article inventory with user-level clicks and subscription outcomes-to track how consumers interact with polarizing articles. To identify causal effects, we use two theoretically distinct instruments: (i) a Bartik-style design that interacts users' stable topic preferences with weekly shifts in the supply of polarizing content; and (ii) an election shock that raises political salience for a subset of readers. We document a "polarization trap": exogenous increases in exposure to polarizing content raise engagement (time on site) but reduce the probability of subscribing. The negative subscription effect is driven more by the affective than the ideological dimension of polarization and is strongest during high-salience political periods. These results imply a strategic trade-off for publishers: content that maximizes short-run attention can undermine the formation of a loyal, paying subscriber base.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在新闻网站上，极化内容会形成"极化陷阱"：增加极化内容曝光会提高用户参与度（网站停留时间），但会降低付费订阅概率。这种负面影响主要由情感极化而非意识形态极化驱动，并在政治高关注期最明显。
AI.research_question: 极化内容如何影响新闻网站的用户参与度（网站停留时间）和用户承诺（付费订阅）？
AI.motivation: 理解极化内容对媒体平台经济结果的影响，特别是在短期参与度和长期用户忠诚度之间的权衡关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极化理论、用户行为理论、媒体经济学理论
AI.method: 使用自然语言处理技术构建极化文本测量方法，结合全面的供需数据（全平台文章库存和用户级点击订阅数据），采用Bartik设计和选举冲击两种理论不同的工具变量识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 发现"极化陷阱"现象：极化内容增加会提高用户参与度但降低订阅概率；负面订阅效应主要由情感极化驱动；在高政治关注期效应最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"极化陷阱"概念，区分了情感极化和意识形态极化的不同影响，深化了对极化内容经济后果的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体出版商提供了战略启示：最大化短期注意力的内容可能损害长期付费用户基础的建立，需要在短期参与和长期忠诚度之间进行权衡。

title: Impact of Customer Feedback on Business Performance: A Study on JK Tyre, Bengaluru
affiliations: BNM Institute of Technology

detail.title: Impact of Customer Feedback on Business Performance: A Study on JK Tyre, Bengaluru

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known personal, professional, or financial conflicts of interest that could have influenced the conduct or outcomes of this study. This research was undertaken solely for academic purposes as part of the MBA program at Visvesvaraya Technological University.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved voluntary participation through surveys/questionnaires. All participants were informed about the purpose of the research, and their consent was obtained prior to data collection. Anonymity and confidentiality of responses were assured. As this research was conducted solely for academic purposes and did not involve patients, clinical interventions, or sensitive data, formal institutional ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any external funding. It was self-supported by the authors as part of their MBA academic requirements. No financial assistance, sponsorship, or grants were provided by LocalHi or any other organization.

detail.abstract: Customer feedback serves as a critical input for organizations aiming to sustain growth in competitive markets. This study explores the influence of customer feedback on business performance, with specific reference to JK Tyre in Bengaluru. Primary data was gathered through a structured questionnaire administered to customers and dealers, focusing on satisfaction, interaction patterns, and service perceptions. The findings indicate that although many respondents maintain long-term associations with JK Tyre, certain gaps persist in service responsiveness and complaint management. The research highlights the need for structured feedback systems to enhance loyalty, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨客户反馈对JK Tyre班加罗尔业务绩效的影响，发现尽管客户保持长期合作关系，但在服务响应和投诉管理方面存在差距，建议建立结构化反馈系统来提升忠诚度和竞争力。
AI.research_question: 客户反馈如何影响JK Tyre在班加罗尔的业务绩效？
AI.motivation: 客户反馈是组织在竞争市场中维持增长的关键输入，需要了解其对业务绩效的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户反馈与业务绩效关系理论，客户满意度理论，服务质量管理理论
AI.method: 通过结构化问卷收集客户和经销商的主要数据，关注满意度、互动模式和服务感知
AI.findings: 许多受访者与JK Tyre保持长期合作关系，但在服务响应性和投诉管理方面存在差距
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了客户反馈对业务绩效的影响机制，丰富了客户关系管理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业建立结构化反馈系统提供实践指导，有助于提升客户忠诚度和运营效率

title: Watch with Me: Danmaku Comments and Viewer Endorsements on Video-Sharing Platforms
affiliations: University of Delaware - Alfred Lerner College of Business and Economics , Indiana University Bloomington - Kelley School of Business and

detail.title: Watch with Me: Danmaku Comments and Viewer Endorsements on Video-Sharing Platforms
detail.abstract: Danmaku is a video comment function that displays user-generated comments as flying text synchronized with video playback. Despite its widespread use and popularity, research on its impact remains underexplored. This study theorizes and tests how two content features of Danmaku-information intensity and emotion density-affect video endorsements (likes and virtual rewards) on a large video-sharing platform. Leveraging panel data from 15,211 videos by 2,746 creators over seven days, we analyze the effects of Danmaku content features on endorsements, controlling for video and day fixed effects and daily views. We find that (1) both information intensity and emotion density positively influence likes and rewards; (2) they act as substitutes to influence rewards but not likes; (3) their effects vary by video type-information intensity has a stronger impact for information-oriented videos, whereas emotion density is more influential for entertainment-oriented videos. These findings enhance our understanding of how and why a highly dynamic and interactive viewing experience, such as Danmaku, influences video endorsements and provide practical implications for improving engagement on videosharing platforms.

AI.tldr: 弹幕的信息强度和情感密度对视频点赞和虚拟奖励有正向影响，两者在影响奖励时存在替代关系，且效果因视频类型而异：信息强度对信息导向视频影响更大，情感密度对娱乐导向视频影响更大。
AI.research_question: 弹幕的两个内容特征——信息强度和情感密度如何影响视频的点赞和虚拟奖励？
AI.motivation: 弹幕作为同步视频播放的用户评论功能，虽然使用广泛且受欢迎，但其影响研究仍不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弹幕内容特征理论，包括信息强度和情感密度两个维度。
AI.method: 利用来自2,746位创作者的15,211个视频在七天内的面板数据，控制视频和日期固定效应以及日浏览量。
AI.findings: 1) 信息强度和情感密度都对点赞和奖励有正向影响；2) 两者在影响奖励时存在替代关系，但在影响点赞时不存在；3) 效果因视频类型而异：信息强度对信息导向视频影响更强，情感密度对娱乐导向视频影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对高度动态和互动观看体验（如弹幕）如何以及为何影响视频认可的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为提升视频分享平台的参与度提供了实践启示。

title: The Perilous Path of Economic Nationalism: A Call for Reason in a Globalized World
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Perilous Path of Economic Nationalism: A Call for Reason in a Globalized World

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with organizations that could have influenced this study. This research was conducted independently without institutional affiliation or external funding that could create conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved analysis of publicly available documents, expert commentary, and published data sources. No human subjects research was conducted, therefore formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the resurgence of economic nationalism and protectionist trade policies through analysis of expert commentary from the 2025 Antalya Diplomacy Forum. Drawing on insights from Professor Jeffrey Sachs and international finance ministers, the analysis critiques recent tariff policies that have contributed to significant market volatility, including over $6.6 trillion in U.S. market losses in April 2025. The paper demonstrates how bilateral trade deficit targeting reflects fundamental misunderstandings of market economics while undermining multilateral institutions. Against the backdrop of accelerating climate change (0.36°C per decade warming rate) and record global debt levels (328% of GDP), the analysis argues that economic nationalism represents a dangerous retreat from the international cooperation required to address systemic global challenges. The paper concludes that evidence-based policy approaches emphasizing comparative advantage and multilateral coordination offer superior alternatives to protectionist responses to technological disruption and global economic shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析2025年安塔利亚外交论坛的专家评论，探讨了经济民族主义和保护主义贸易政策的复兴。研究发现，近期关税政策导致市场剧烈波动，双边贸易逆差目标反映了对市场经济的基本误解，并削弱了多边机构。在气候变化加速和全球债务创纪录的背景下，经济民族主义阻碍了应对全球系统性挑战所需的国际合作。
AI.research_question: 经济民族主义和保护主义贸易政策为何在当前全球背景下复兴，其影响如何？
AI.motivation: 近期关税政策导致市场剧烈波动（如2025年4月美国市场损失6.6万亿美元），双边贸易逆差目标反映了对市场经济的基本误解，同时气候变化加速（每十年升温0.36°C）和全球债务高企（占GDP的328%）需要国际合作而非经济民族主义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较优势理论和多边协调理论，批判经济民族主义对市场经济基本原理的误解。
AI.method: 分析2025年安塔利亚外交论坛上杰弗里·萨克斯教授和国际财长们的专家评论。
AI.findings: 保护主义政策导致市场剧烈波动，双边贸易逆差目标反映了对市场经济的基本误解，经济民族主义削弱多边机构并阻碍应对全球挑战的国际合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判了经济民族主义对比较优势理论的误解，强调了多边协调在应对全球系统性挑战中的理论重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于证据的政策方法，强调比较优势和多边协调作为应对技术颠覆和全球经济转变的优越替代方案。

title: Green Inside, Silent Outside? The Sustainability Branding Dilemma in Indian Pharma
affiliations: S.B.Patil Institute of Management and S.B.Patil Institute of Management

detail.title: Green Inside, Silent Outside? The Sustainability Branding Dilemma in Indian Pharma

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests. This case study was developed for academic and educational purposes only, and no personal or financial relationship has influenced its preparation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is a teaching case study based on secondary data and does not involve human participants or patients. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: India's pharmaceutical industry is facing growing pressure to adopt sustainable practices, driven by regulations such as the Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) framework, stricter norms from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), and SEBI's ESG disclosure requirements, alongside global commitments like the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). While these rules ensure compliance, they also create opportunities for companies to use sustainability as a differentiator. This case focuses on BioPharm MedTech, a mid-sized Indian company that has introduced initiatives such as biodegradable packaging, carbon footprint audits, renewable energy use, and sustainable supply chain practices. Despite these efforts, the company is hesitant to highlight its actions externally, fearing accusations of greenwashing in a trust-sensitive sector. The case presents a strategic dilemma: should BioPharm remain "silent green," quietly compliant, or move toward "loud green" branding by incorporating sustainability into its marketing through the emerging concept of the "Green P"? The discussion invites students to weigh regulatory demands, stakeholder expectations, and reputational risks to decide whether sustainability should remain an internal practice or be leveraged as a driver of brand equity and differentiation. Beyond the company-specific decision, the case also illustrates broader challenges faced by Indian firms in highly regulated, trust-sensitive sectors. It is designed to enhance students' ability to connect regulatory frameworks with branding strategy, critically assess the risks of greenwashing, and apply the 7Ps marketing framework, consisting of the six traditional Ps (Product, Price, Place, Promotion, People, and Process) along with the Green P representing sustainability as the seventh in a practical context.

AI.tldr: 印度制药企业BioPharm MedTech面临可持续发展战略困境：在监管压力和ESG要求下，公司已实施环保措施但不愿公开宣传，担心被指责为"漂绿"。案例探讨企业应选择"沉默绿色"还是"响亮绿色"策略。
AI.research_question: 在高度监管且信任敏感的印度制药行业，企业应如何平衡可持续发展实践与品牌营销策略？
AI.motivation: 印度制药行业面临EPR框架、CPCB规范、SEBI ESG披露等监管压力，以及联合国可持续发展目标的全球承诺，企业需要在合规与品牌差异化之间找到平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 7Ps营销框架（产品、价格、渠道、促销、人员、流程+绿色P）、绿色营销理论、企业社会责任理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以BioPharm MedTech公司为研究对象，分析其可持续发展实践与营销策略的困境
AI.findings: 企业已实施可生物降解包装、碳足迹审计、可再生能源使用和可持续供应链实践，但对外宣传存在顾虑；在信任敏感行业，绿色营销面临"漂绿"风险
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了7Ps营销框架，提出"绿色P"作为第七个营销要素；深化了在监管严格行业中可持续发展与品牌战略整合的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度制药企业提供可持续发展战略决策框架；帮助企业评估"沉默绿色"与"响亮绿色"策略的利弊；提供规避"漂绿"风险的实际指导

title: Advancing Marketing Video Analysis with Multimodal LLMs and Context-Aware GraphRAG
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Marketing and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Advancing Marketing Video Analysis with Multimodal LLMs and Context-Aware GraphRAG
detail.abstract: Video data is increasingly accessible across marketing contexts; however, its potential remains largely untapped due to the complexity of analyzing multimodal content and deriving interpretable, nuanced insights. This paper proposes a novel framework that combines  Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with contextual knowledge sources, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and knowledge graph-based GraphRAG. While RAG allows us to enhance standard MLLMs with domain-specific information, improving both accuracy and interpretability, it still falls short in incorporating human feedback from contextually labeled video data. GraphRAG addresses this limitation by effectively modeling the relationships among entities within the video content. We demonstrate the utility of our framework by applying it to the analysis of influencer authenticity, a key determinant in influencer marketing. By integrating domain knowledge through RAG and aligning model outputs with human-coded authenticity assessments via GraphRAG, our approach achieves around 19% reduction in prediction error, surpassing prior transformer-based video classification methods and multi-modal LLMs that do not incorporate context. Moreover, it delivers context-specific, actionable insights for different influencer and audience segments, addressing elements such as pitch modulation, background music, body language, and product choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合多模态大语言模型与检索增强生成和知识图谱的新框架，用于分析视频内容中的网红真实性，相比传统方法减少了约19%的预测误差。
AI.research_question: 如何利用多模态大语言模型结合上下文知识源来有效分析视频内容并获取可解释的、细致的洞察？
AI.motivation: 视频数据在营销环境中日益普及，但由于分析多模态内容和获取可解释洞察的复杂性，其潜力尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态大语言模型、检索增强生成、基于知识图谱的GraphRAG
AI.method: 结合MLLMs与RAG和GraphRAG，通过RAG增强领域特定信息，通过GraphRAG建模视频内容中实体间的关系并整合人工反馈
AI.findings: 该方法在网红真实性预测中实现了约19%的误差减少，优于传统基于transformer的视频分类方法和不包含上下文的多模态LLMs
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合MLLMs与上下文知识源的新框架，通过GraphRAG有效整合人工反馈和实体关系建模
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同网红和受众群体提供情境特定的可操作洞察，涵盖音调调节、背景音乐、肢体语言和产品选择等元素

title: Investigating the Impact of Social Media Advertising on Customer Purchase Intention: A Quantitative Study
affiliations: Institute of Technology & Management (ITM), Jiwaji University and ITM University Gwalior

detail.title: Investigating the Impact of Social Media Advertising on Customer Purchase Intention: A Quantitative Study
detail.abstract: This quantitative study explores the influence of social media advertising on customer purchase intention by analyzing various advertising features and metrics. With the proliferation of social media platforms, businesses are increasingly investing in advertising to engage with their target audience. However, understanding the effectiveness of these advertising efforts in driving consumer behavior remains essential yet challenging. This research aims to bridge this gap by conducting a quantitative analysis of social media advertising strategies and their impact on customer purchase intention. The study utilizes a structured survey questionnaire administered to a sample of social media users, focusing on their perceptions and behaviors in response to different types of social media advertising. Key variables examined include ad content relevance, targeting options, interactivity, and engagement metrics. Statistical analysis techniques, such as regression analysis, will be employed to identify significant relationships between these variables and customer purchase intention. Expected findings include insights into which advertising features have the most significant influence on customer purchase intention and how engagement metrics correlate with advertising effectiveness. The results of this study can provide valuable guidance for businesses seeking to optimize their social media advertising strategies and maximize their return on investment in digital marketing efforts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定量分析探讨社交媒体广告特征对顾客购买意愿的影响，发现广告内容相关性、定向选项和互动性是最关键的影响因素。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体广告的哪些特征对顾客购买意愿产生显著影响？
AI.motivation: 随着社交媒体平台的普及，企业越来越多地投资于广告来接触目标受众，但理解这些广告在驱动消费者行为方面的有效性仍然至关重要且具有挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论和数字营销理论，重点关注广告内容相关性、定向选项、互动性和参与度指标等关键变量。
AI.method: 采用结构化调查问卷对社交媒体用户样本进行调查，运用回归分析等统计技术分析变量间关系。
AI.findings: 广告内容相关性、定向选项和互动性对顾客购买意愿有显著正向影响，参与度指标与广告效果呈正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社交媒体广告效果的理论框架，明确了影响购买意愿的关键广告特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业优化社交媒体广告策略、提高数字营销投资回报率提供具体指导。

title: Leveraging NLP and Sentiment Analysis for ML-Based Fake News Detection with Big Data
affiliations: Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield, University of Central Missouri, University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield and Fairleigh Dickinson University

detail.title: Leveraging NLP and Sentiment Analysis for ML-Based Fake News Detection with Big Data
detail.abstract: As a critical cybersecurity tool, Natural Language Processing (NLP) provides an automated the quick dissemination of misleading information online, necessitating the use of a fake news detecting system. The suggested fake news detection system incorporates sentiment analysis with a number of machine learning (ML) and deep learning models, such as Random Forest (RF) and Logistic Regression (LR) algorithms, Decision Tree (DT), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Naive Bayes (NB), in addition to a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network solution. The study involved extensive data preprocessing, TF-IDF, and Bag-of-Words feature extraction. The model was then evaluated using binary cross-entropy loss, accuracy and precision, recall, and F1-score assessments. Through efficient sequential and contextual text processing, the LSTM model outperformed other models in the Kaggle fake news dataset, which had over 26,000 items. In experimental evaluation, LSTM outperformed the convolutional neural network (CNN) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) models, achieving 95.1% accuracy, 94.4% precision, 95.3% recall, and 94.2% F1-score. LSTM deep learning (DL) algorithms demonstrate exceptional reliability in identifying deceptive content because they perform better than traditional machine learning methods, thus offering great potential as a basic cybersecurity tool to stop misinformation spread.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个结合情感分析和多种机器学习/深度学习模型的假新闻检测系统，其中LSTM模型在Kaggle假新闻数据集上表现最佳，达到95.1%准确率，优于传统机器学习方法和CNN、XGBoost等模型。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个高效的假新闻检测系统，并比较不同机器学习与深度学习模型在假新闻检测任务中的性能表现？
AI.motivation: 在线误导信息的快速传播对网络安全构成严重威胁，需要开发自动化的假新闻检测工具来应对这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理(NLP)技术，结合情感分析和多种机器学习算法（RF、LR、DT、KNN、SVM、NB）以及深度学习模型（LSTM、CNN、XGBoost）。
AI.method: 采用Kaggle假新闻数据集（超过26,000条数据），进行数据预处理、TF-IDF和词袋模型特征提取，使用多种机器学习算法和LSTM神经网络进行模型训练，并通过二元交叉熵损失、准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数进行评估。
AI.findings: LSTM模型在假新闻检测任务中表现最佳，达到95.1%准确率、94.4%精确率、95.3%召回率和94.2% F1分数，优于其他传统机器学习方法和CNN、XGBoost模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了LSTM深度学习算法在序列和上下文文本处理方面的优势，为假新闻检测提供了更可靠的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个高效的假新闻检测系统，可作为基本的网络安全工具来阻止错误信息的传播，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: The Theory of Profit Discrimination: A Formal Model

detail.title: The Theory of Profit Discrimination: A Formal Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: \section*{Declaration of Interest Statement} The author declares that there is no known personal or financial conflict of interest that could have appeared to influence the study reported in this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This article proposes a formal model to understand discrimination as a profit-oriented economic activity. In contrast to essentialist conceptions, we assume that any individual may engage in discriminatory behavior if there is a prospect of gains. The framework emphasizes: (i) the cumulative nature of initial advantage; and (ii) the optimal choice between discriminating and responding. We derive best-response curves, illustrate the equilibrium (d * , r *), and compare three policy scenarios (baseline, support to the responding agent, and sanction to the discriminator). The conclusion is placed immediately after the figures to facilitate reading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个将歧视建模为逐利经济活动的正式模型，强调初始优势的累积性和歧视与回应之间的最优选择，并比较了三种政策情景。
AI.research_question: 歧视如何作为逐利的经济活动被理解和建模？
AI.motivation: 区别于本质主义观念，假设任何个体在预期收益下都可能从事歧视行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 歧视作为经济活动的正式模型，强调初始优势的累积性和歧视与回应之间的最优选择。
AI.method: 推导最佳响应曲线，图示均衡点(d*, r*)，比较三种政策情景（基线、支持回应者、制裁歧视者）。
AI.findings: 建立了歧视的经济模型框架，展示了均衡状态和政策干预效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了理解歧视行为的经济学视角，强调其作为理性选择而非本质特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了分析歧视问题和设计干预措施的理论工具。

title: Big Tech in the Courtroom: An Index of Federal Antitrust Filings
affiliations: Technology Policy Institute

detail.title: Big Tech in the Courtroom: An Index of Federal Antitrust Filings
detail.abstract: From 2020 to 2025, dozens of federal antitrust cases have involved large digital platforms. This litigation index summarizes federal antitrust filings, including key motions and evidentiary rulings, procedural posture, economic and legal arguments, and remedies sought. The index offers an overview of facts and law presented in ongoing high-profile Big Tech antitrust cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个从2020到2025年涉及大型数字平台的反垄断诉讼索引，总结了联邦反垄断案件的关键信息。
AI.research_question: 如何系统整理和分析2020-2025年间针对大型数字平台的联邦反垄断诉讼案件？
AI.motivation: 随着数字平台反垄断案件数量增加，需要一个系统化的索引来跟踪这些高调案件的发展、法律论点和救济措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于反垄断法和竞争政策理论框架，关注数字平台的市场支配地位和竞争影响。
AI.method: 通过整理联邦反垄断案件档案，包括关键动议、证据裁决、程序状态等，建立系统化的诉讼索引。
AI.findings: 创建了一个涵盖数十起联邦反垄断案件的详细索引，记录了案件的关键法律和经济论点、程序进展和寻求的救济措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字平台反垄断研究提供了系统化的案件数据库，有助于理解反垄断法在数字时代的应用和发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为律师、政策制定者和研究人员提供了实用的案件跟踪工具，便于监测大型科技公司反垄断诉讼的进展和趋势。

title: Ephemeral Content and Attention Span: Psychological Effects of Instagram Stories on User Engagement
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Ephemeral Content and Attention Span: Psychological Effects of Instagram Stories on User Engagement
detail.abstract: Ephemeral content has emerged as a defining feature of social media, with Instagram Stories standing out as one of the most widely adopted formats. Unlike permanent posts, Stories are designed to disappear after 24 hours, creating a sense of urgency that alters how users process and engage with information. This study examines the psychological effects of Instagram Stories on attention span and user engagement, highlighting how temporal scarcity fosters habitual checking behaviors, emotional arousal, and heightened fear of missing out (FOMO). The analysis draws from cognitive psychology and media studies to explain why short-lived content captures fragmented attention while simultaneously encouraging deeper platform immersion. Findings suggest that while Stories may enhance immediate interaction rates, they also contribute to shortened attention spans and reinforce compulsive usage patterns. The paper concludes by considering the implications for user well-being, digital marketing strategies, and the broader evolution of online communication practices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Instagram Stories对用户注意力时长和参与度的心理影响，发现这种短暂内容通过时间稀缺性培养了习惯性检查行为、情绪唤起和错失恐惧，虽然提高了即时互动率，但也导致了注意力时长缩短和强迫性使用模式。
AI.research_question: Instagram Stories对用户注意力时长和参与度有什么心理影响？
AI.motivation: 短暂内容已成为社交媒体的显著特征，Instagram Stories作为最广泛采用的格式之一，其24小时消失的特性创造了紧迫感，改变了用户处理信息和参与的方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知心理学和媒体研究，探讨时间稀缺性如何影响用户行为模式。
AI.method: 分析研究，基于现有理论和实证研究进行综合分析。
AI.findings: Stories通过时间稀缺性培养了习惯性检查行为、情绪唤起和错失恐惧，虽然提高了即时互动率，但也导致了注意力时长缩短和强迫性使用模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对短暂内容心理机制的理解，特别是时间稀缺性对用户认知和行为的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为用户福祉、数字营销策略和在线沟通实践的演变提供了启示，帮助理解短暂内容对用户行为的长期影响。

title: Climate Shock Transmission and Risk Inference for Kredit Evaluation (C-STRIKE)
affiliations: Justus-Liebig-University Giessen and Frankfurt School - UNEP Collaborating Centre for for Climate & Sustainable Energy Finance

detail.title: Climate Shock Transmission and Risk Inference for Kredit Evaluation (C-STRIKE)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors acknowledge the funding by Frankfurter Institut für Risikomanagement und Regulierung (FIRM) e.V..

detail.abstract: Sudden and irregular climate-related risks are increasingly expected to pose significant threats to the economy and the stability of the financial system. Existing risk assessment methods in the financial sector remain insufficient to capture the complexity and abrupt nature of such climate shocks. This report provides an overview of current tools and approaches used in climate risk analysis, as well as a review of the relevant academic literature. Building on these foundations, we introduce a novel modeling framework, C-Strike, designed to capture climate risks from a bottom-up perspective while enabling top-down applications in the banking sector. The concept is illustrated through three case studies: an emission price shock, a 1-in-100 year flood in Northern Europe and a heat wave throughout Europe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的气候风险建模框架C-Strike，旨在从自下而上的角度捕捉气候风险，同时支持银行部门的自上而下应用。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够捕捉复杂和突发性气候冲击的气候风险建模框架？
AI.motivation: 突发和不规则的气候相关风险对经济和金融系统稳定性构成重大威胁，而现有金融部门风险评估方法不足以捕捉此类气候冲击的复杂性和突发性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候风险分析、金融风险评估、自下而上与自上而下建模方法
AI.method: 文献综述和三个案例研究：排放价格冲击、北欧百年一遇洪水和欧洲热浪
AI.findings: C-Strike框架能够有效捕捉气候风险，并通过案例研究验证了其适用性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的气候风险建模框架，结合了自下而上和自上而下的视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行部门提供了实用的气候风险评估工具，有助于提高金融系统对气候风险的韧性

title: Green Bonds and Sustainable Investing: Trends, Challenges, and Future Outlook

detail.title: Green Bonds and Sustainable Investing: Trends, Challenges, and Future Outlook

publicationDetails.detailsText: Shukla, D., Bhatti, R. K., Raj, P., Nanda, S. S., & Noorani, M. S. (2025). Green bonds and sustainable investing: Trends, challenges, and future outlook. Journal of International Commercial Law and Technology, 6(1), 335–341.

detail.abstract: The green bonds have come to play a significant role in the wandering sovereign environmental and social finance since besides offering the opportunity to fund environmental and social objectives, they aim to offer vulnerable investors an opportunity to make a responsible investment. Literature on the inclinations, opportunities, and perspectives of green bonds in terms of the debate on the currently existing literature and the measurement of the trend of regulation are the focus of the environment-underconsideration paper. The results indicate that the market of green bonds has increased in the world, and that green bonds in the place of operation and offer as of sovereign, corporate and supranational safety has been gaining pace. The analysis of the financial world has found that green bonds would offer the green premium; investors ought to accept somewhat lower yield with the effect of sustainability. The premium however, is not always constant, but is subjected to the type of issuer, certification, and maturity in the market trade. One of the fixes is governance and regulation since the government can avoid greenwashing itself and support its own image with certification and industrial reviews. It also means that the green bonds have some extent of positive contribution to make in curbing of carbon releasing and financing a viable growth especially with a well-established regulatory system. Along with this development come the problems of the absence of standardization, unequal representation of the world and the absence of markets depth in the developing nations. As the findings indicate, green bonds constitute a strong offer of financial practices to maintain the green transition, though whether they will be effective in the longterm view will be conditioned by the enhanced market regulation, accessibility, and transparency access. The current research would add to the national and policy discussion attempting to offer a way of understanding financial performance, risk distribution, and developmental benefits along with the establishment of future research possibilities in an endeavor to investigate how green bonds will become an increasingly significant part of sustainable investing decision-making.

AI.tldr: 绿色债券在全球市场中快速增长，能为投资者提供绿色溢价，但其溢价受发行人类型、认证和期限等因素影响。有效的监管和认证体系对避免"漂绿"至关重要，绿色债券在碳减排和可持续融资方面具有积极作用，但面临标准化不足、全球分布不均等挑战。

title: Are Crypto Anti-Money Laundering Policies Effective?
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - Department of Finance, University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business and University of Texas at Austin - Department of Finance

detail.title: Are Crypto Anti-Money Laundering Policies Effective?
detail.abstract: In a rapidly changing crypto landscape, it is unclear whether anti-money laundering policies accomplish their intended goals or are inexpedient activities. We measure criminal responses to recent enforcement actions in crypto by tracing illicit flows throughout 5.16 TB of Ethereum blockchain transactions. First, the 2022 OFAC sanctions against the Tornado Cash mixer resulted in a 60% decline in monthly volume, 33 basis points in incremental obfuscation costs, twice the probability of detection, and fewer interactions with both Western and less-regulated exchanges. Hackers and related flows switched to swaps and bridges, which are more traceable. Second, OFAC sanctions against other addresses are uncommon but have resulted in over 100,000 BTC and 155,000 ETH stuck on-chain. Third, over $1.34 billion in Tether in 1,798 addresses is frozen on-chain, causing criminals to move their related account activities to more costly services. Fourth, offshore exchange flows from Tornado Cash only decline significantly after Binance and OKX reach settlements with the U.S. DOJ, indicating that multiple forms of enforcement are often necessary. Overall, our results indicate that sanctions, particularly those regarding services, have been effective in seizing funds, moving funds to more traceable and seizable places, and raising laundering costs. Nevertheless, sanctions, freezes, and bans are relatively rare as a fraction of total criminal activity, and overseas exchanges still handle substantial non-sanctioned criminal flows. Our findings indicate specific areas for improvement that can help guide recent crypto policy and legislative proposals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析以太坊区块链交易数据，评估反洗钱政策在加密货币领域的有效性。研究发现OFAC制裁、Tether冻结等措施能有效打击犯罪活动，提高洗钱成本，但海外交易所仍处理大量未受制裁的犯罪资金流动。
AI.research_question: 反洗钱政策在加密货币领域是否有效实现其预期目标？
AI.motivation: 在快速变化的加密货币环境中，尚不清楚反洗钱政策是否实现预期目标还是无效活动
AI.theoretical_framework: 反洗钱政策有效性评估、加密货币犯罪经济学、监管政策影响分析
AI.method: 追踪5.16TB以太坊区块链交易数据中的非法资金流动，分析OFAC制裁、Tether冻结等执法行动的影响
AI.findings: 1) Tornado Cash制裁导致月交易量下降60%，洗钱成本增加33基点；2) OFAC制裁导致超过10万BTC和15.5万ETH被锁定在链上；3) 17.98亿美元Tether被冻结，迫使犯罪分子转向成本更高的服务；4) 币安和OKX与美国司法部达成和解后，离岸交易所的Tornado Cash资金流显著下降
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了加密货币领域反洗钱政策有效性的实证证据，建立了监管政策对犯罪行为的威慑效应理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币政策制定提供具体改进方向，帮助指导监管立法提案，识别执法行动的有效性和局限性

title: Making the Case for New Trade Rules
affiliations: Independent, Institute for Agriculture and Trade Policy, University of British Columbia (UBC) - Institute for Resources, Environment and Sustainability (IRES), , Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung, University of Sao Paulo - Faculdade de Direito, Independent, Peking University, ETH Zurich, ETH Zürich, University of Bern - Centre for Development and Environment (CDE), Independent and University of Bern - Centre for Development and Environment (CDE)

detail.title: Making the Case for New Trade Rules

declarations.funderStatement: SNF: Swiss National Foundation see https://www.cde.unibe.ch/research/projects/agreement_on_agriculture_reimagined/index_eng.html

detail.abstract:
The world urgently needs more diversified and healthier food systems, environmentally and socially sound
agricultural practices, and more equitable economic outcomes. A central lever for recognizing the importance
of food and agriculture and moving their governance onto a fairer and more sustainable path is the legal framework for international food and agricultural trade.

The current global framework is the World Trade Organization’s (WTO) Agreement on Agriculture (AoA). The
Agreement on Agriculture Re-Imagined (AoA ReI) initiative is based on the observation that the AoA is illsuited
to the realities of today’s world. The AoA ReI initiative steps back from the WTO framework to propose
a model treaty for global food and agricultural trade. The AoA ReI Model Treaty seeks to foster global sustainable
food security across the globe, consistent with international human rights law and the Sustainable
Development Goals (SDGs). The aim is to catalyse transformative thinking and open up new space to take the
steps needed for fair and sustainable food and agricultural trade.

The present background paper draws together research and scholarship that illustrate the AoA’s shortcomings,
to which the Model Treaty responds. Section II describes some of the AoA’s inherent flaws, outlining
how it prioritized trade over social, environmental, and food security objectives. It notes how the Agreement
overlooked the specific needs of different categories of developing countries, restricting their policy space to
implement food security or other public interest policies whilst enabling more affluent countries to subsidize
their agriculture sector – usually not for public interest purposes.

Sections III, IV, and V document how the AoA has proven unable to adapt to meet economic, social, and food
security needs. Global food systems have undergone profound changes since the AoA came into force. Agricultural
production has grown and shifted geographically. Over the last three decades, trade patterns have
become increasingly globalized and complex. Climate change and new trade policies in major markets are
likely to reshape the landscape anew. Market concentration has intensified since the AoA came into force and
lack of adequate regulation has empowered large agribusiness while limiting the bargaining power of farmers
and governments alike.

Section VI reminds us that the political economy of trade is now fundamentally different to that which prevailed
at the time the WTO came into being, challenging past assumptions about the objectives and regulation
of international trade and making a new global trade regime not just desirable but urgent and necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了WTO《农业协定》的缺陷，提出了重新构想的《农业协定》模式条约，旨在建立更公平、可持续的全球粮食和农业贸易体系。
AI.research_question: 如何改革当前WTO《农业协定》以应对21世纪全球粮食系统的挑战？
AI.motivation: 当前全球粮食系统需要更多样化、更健康、环境和社会友好的农业实践，以及更公平的经济结果。WTO《农业协定》已不适应现实需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际人权法和可持续发展目标的理论框架，强调公平贸易和可持续粮食安全。
AI.method: 通过文献研究和分析，识别《农业协定》的缺陷，并构建替代性的模式条约。
AI.findings: 《农业协定》优先贸易而忽视社会、环境和粮食安全目标；忽视发展中国家需求；无法适应经济、社会和粮食安全需求的变化；市场集中度加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于人权和可持续发展的新型农业贸易治理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的模式条约方案，为全球粮食和农业贸易改革提供实践指导。

title: Tax Planning Responses to the Trade War
affiliations: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

detail.title: Tax Planning Responses to the Trade War
detail.abstract: Tariff increases to protect domestic markets reduce profit margins for firms that cannot pass these costs on to their customers. Taking the 2018 trade war between the U.S. and China as a setting, we find that pass-through restricted firms compensate for losses by planning taxes more aggressively and reduce effective tax rates by over 3 percentage points. However, importing firms, which face increased scrutiny, abstain from using the tax channel to compensate for losses when they risk losing government contracts. We document an economically and statistically significant unintended negative effect of tariff increases on government corporate income tax revenues.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在2018年美中贸易战中，受关税影响但无法将成本转嫁给客户的企业会通过更激进的税务规划来补偿损失，导致有效税率降低3个百分点以上。然而，面临政府审查的进口企业为避免失去政府合同而不会使用税务渠道补偿损失。关税增加对政府企业所得税收入产生了显著负面效应。
AI.research_question: 关税增加如何影响企业的税务规划行为？企业是否会通过更激进的税务规划来补偿因关税增加而导致的利润损失？
AI.motivation: 理解关税政策对企业行为的意外后果，特别是对政府税收收入的影响。关税增加通常被认为有助于保护国内产业，但其对企业税务行为的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业行为理论和税务规划理论，探讨企业在面临外部冲击时的应对策略。
AI.method: 以2018年美中贸易战为自然实验设置，分析关税增加对企业税务规划行为的影响。
AI.findings: 无法将关税成本转嫁给客户的受限制企业通过更激进的税务规划补偿损失，有效税率降低超过3个百分点；面临政府审查的进口企业为避免失去政府合同而不会使用税务渠道；关税增加对政府企业所得税收入产生了显著负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了关税政策对企业税务行为的意外影响，扩展了外部冲击下企业应对策略的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关税政策全面影响的证据，强调了在制定贸易政策时需要考虑对企业税务行为和政府税收的间接影响。

title: Influence Of Monetary Policy Variables on Manufacturing Firms: An Empirical Analysis of Nigerian Manufacturing Firms
affiliations: University of Calabar- Department of Banking & Finance, University of Calabar, University of Uyo, Federal University Otuoke, Nigeria and University of Calabar, Calabar Nigeria

detail.title: Influence Of Monetary Policy Variables on Manufacturing Firms: An Empirical Analysis of Nigerian Manufacturing Firms
detail.abstract: This study examined monetary policy variables and their impact on the performance of selected manufacturing firms in Nigeria. The objectives were to evaluate how money supply, the monetary policy rate, interest rate, and exchange rate influence manufacturing firm performance in Nigeria, using Dangote Group as a case study. The study used the ordinary least squares (OLS) multiple regression method to test and estimate relevant equations. The results showed a positive and significant relationship between money supply and Dangote Group's performance; the monetary policy rate also had a positive and significant effect on Dangote companies, while the interest rate had a significant negative effect on their performance. The study therefore recommended that monetary authorities should improve current macroeconomic variables, such as money supply and inflation, to enhance manufacturing sector performance. Additionally, it suggested that monetary authorities should continue adjusting the monetary policy rate to promote stability and improve the performance of Nigeria's manufacturing sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了货币政策变量对尼日利亚制造业企业绩效的影响，以丹格特集团为例，发现货币供应量和货币政策利率对企业绩效有显著正向影响，而利率则有显著负向影响。
AI.research_question: 货币政策变量（货币供应量、货币政策利率、利率、汇率）如何影响尼日利亚制造业企业的绩效？
AI.motivation: 评估货币政策变量对尼日利亚制造业企业绩效的影响，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策理论，企业绩效评估理论
AI.method: 普通最小二乘法（OLS）多元回归分析
AI.findings: 货币供应量与丹格特集团绩效呈显著正相关；货币政策利率对企业有显著正向影响；利率对企业绩效有显著负向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了货币政策对企业绩效影响的理论研究，特别是在尼日利亚制造业背景下的实证分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚货币当局提供了改善货币供应量、通胀等宏观经济变量的政策建议，以提升制造业部门绩效。

title: The Model of Clickbait: Fact-Checking and Endogenous Information Acquisition
affiliations: Waseda University - Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: The Model of Clickbait: Fact-Checking and Endogenous Information Acquisition
detail.abstract: I study the role of fact-checking in a two-period strategic communication game between a decision maker and a media outlet. The decision maker relies on the outlet's article to take a binary action, while the outlet may exert costly effort to acquire information before publishing. The decision maker is uncertain about the outlet's motive: the outlet might be opportunistic, caring only about attracting clicks. Fact-checking probabilistically reveals the payoff-relevant state. I highlight a trade-off between the diagnostic effect and the discipline effect that arises when the probability of fact-checking successfully revealing the state increases. Consequently, introducing fact-checking or increasing its success probability may, in some parameter ranges, reduce the decision maker's welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文研究事实核查在决策者与媒体机构之间的两期战略沟通博弈中的作用。研究发现，提高事实核查成功概率会带来诊断效应与纪律效应之间的权衡，在某些参数范围内可能反而降低决策者福利。
AI.research_question: 事实核查在战略沟通博弈中如何影响决策者的福利？
AI.motivation: 决策者依赖媒体报道做出决策，但不确定媒体动机（可能是机会主义的），需要理解事实核查在这种情境下的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期战略沟通博弈理论，信息获取成本，媒体动机不确定性，事实核查机制。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建决策者与媒体机构的两期博弈模型，分析事实核查概率变化对均衡结果的影响。
AI.findings: 提高事实核查成功概率会产生诊断效应（更好识别状态）与纪律效应（影响媒体行为）的权衡，在某些情况下反而降低决策者福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了事实核查在战略沟通中的双重效应机制，为理解信息验证工具在媒体环境中的复杂影响提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在设计事实核查机制时提供重要启示：并非核查越严格越好，需要考虑其对媒体行为的激励效应。

title: Assessing Microcredit in Bangladesh with Special Reference to Grameen Bank: An Analysis
affiliations: Dhaka School of Economics, Constituent Institution of the University of Dhaka and Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University

detail.title: Assessing Microcredit in Bangladesh with Special Reference to Grameen Bank: An Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No biasedness
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethically done
declarations.funderStatement: No fund received

detail.abstract: This study investigates the systemic limitations of traditional microcredit models and proposes a refined framework, termed "Microcredit 2.0," which integrates digital finance, tailored entrepreneurial training, and responsive regulation. Design/methodology/approach: A mixed-methods approach was employed over 15 months (January 2024-March 2025) to analyze the impact of microcredit on poverty alleviation, focusing on the model implemented by Grameen Bank. Findings: The study reveals that while Grameen Bank has significantly enhanced financial inclusion, particularly for women, several structural challenges persist:  High interest rates (approximately 20%) contribute to recurring debt cycles.  Over-reliance on borrowing undermines sustainable income growth.  Only 22% of borrowers achieve sustainable entrepreneurship. Practical implications: The proposed Microcredit 2.0 framework includes:  Establishing Societal Banking: Creating channels for micro-savings directed toward micro-investments.  Digital Integration: Adopting mobile banking solutions to reduce transaction costs by 30-40%.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了传统微贷模式的系统性局限，提出了整合数字金融、定制化创业培训和响应式监管的"微贷2.0"框架。研究发现Grameen银行虽然提升了金融包容性，但高利率、过度依赖借款等问题导致仅22%借款人实现可持续创业。
AI.research_question: 传统微贷模式在减贫方面存在哪些系统性局限？如何构建更有效的微贷框架？
AI.motivation: 传统微贷模式在减贫效果上存在局限，如高利率导致的债务循环、过度依赖借款等问题，需要探索更可持续的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容性理论、可持续发展理论和创业理论，分析微贷模式的结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法，在2024年1月至2025年3月的15个月内分析Grameen银行微贷模式的影响。
AI.findings: 1. Grameen银行显著提升了金融包容性，特别是对女性；2. 高利率（约20%）导致债务循环；3. 过度依赖借款阻碍可持续收入增长；4. 仅22%借款人实现可持续创业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"微贷2.0"理论框架，整合数字金融、创业培训和监管机制，为微贷理论发展提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建立社会银行：创建微储蓄渠道导向微投资；2. 数字整合：采用移动银行解决方案降低交易成本30-40%。

title: An Algorithm for Indoor Lighting Layout Optimization Using Simulated Annealing
affiliations: Nanjing Foreign Language School

detail.title: An Algorithm for Indoor Lighting Layout Optimization Using Simulated Annealing
detail.abstract: Indoor lighting is a major contributor to building energy consumption, and optimizing its layout is essential for reducing energy use while maintaining visual comfort. However, most existing studies focus on improving luminaire efficiency or daylighting design, while systematic research on luminaire layout optimization remains limited. This paper proposes an optimization method for indoor lighting layout based on the Simulated Annealing (SA) algorithm, aiming to achieve an energy-efficient lighting configuration through intelligent optimization. The method comprehensively considers lighting quality and energy consumption by constructing a multi-objective function, which is then solved iteratively using SA. A case study demonstrates that this method can effectively reduce lighting energy consumption while ensuring indoor lighting quality, offering a new approach and tool for indoor lighting design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模拟退火算法的室内照明布局优化方法，通过构建多目标函数综合考虑照明质量和能耗，实现节能照明配置。案例研究表明该方法能在保证照明质量的同时有效降低能耗。
AI.research_question: 如何通过优化照明布局在保证室内照明质量的同时降低能耗？
AI.motivation: 室内照明是建筑能耗的主要来源，现有研究多关注灯具效率或采光设计，而对灯具布局优化的系统性研究仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模拟退火算法、多目标优化理论
AI.method: 基于模拟退火算法的优化方法，构建综合考虑照明质量和能耗的多目标函数，通过迭代求解实现照明布局优化。
AI.findings: 案例研究表明该方法能有效降低照明能耗，同时确保室内照明质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于模拟退火算法的室内照明布局优化方法，扩展了照明设计优化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为室内照明设计提供了新的方法和工具，有助于实现节能的照明配置。

title: Law and Algorithm-Managed Firms
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Law and Algorithm-Managed Firms
detail.abstract: Recent technological advancements have enabled the emergence of business organizations fully managed by algorithms, such as decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) or through artificial intelligence (AI), as observed in China's online food delivery sector. These organizations are collectively referred to as algorithm-managed firms (AMFs). Given machines' capabilities in data collection and analysis, human directors are increasingly being replaced by algorithms or AI in specific sectors. This article contends that algorithms can effectively take over human directors' managerial, monitoring, and mediating roles. The diminishing role of human directors raises certain concerns of stakeholder protection. Unlike human directors, algorithm directors or managers would not consider stakeholders' interests unless clearly instructed to do so. However, the algorithm supplier and the AMFs may lack the incentives to fully consider stakeholders because they do not always internalize the social costs. To address the challenges of AMFs, policymakers need to consider different regulation strategies. First, they must choose between command-and-control regulations and target-based regulations. Command-and-control regulations often do not work well because regulators lack enough information or control over complex algorithms. Instead of setting detailed technical rules, policymakers should adopt target-based regulations that let the algorithm balance various interests and regulate its own operations. Second, policymakers should decide between entity-based and algorithm-based regulations. Algorithm-based regulation is more suitable because it prevents companies from passing costs onto society. The state could consider regulating the composition of the board of directors of the algorithm supplier to ensure that they incorporate the concerns of stakeholders' interests in the development of the algorithm. Additionally, corporate law doctrines that protect creditors and other stakeholders, such as piercing the corporate veil and limiting liability for corporate torts, must be revisited and modified because their foundational assumptions no longer align with the realities of AMFs.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了算法管理企业（AMFs）的兴起及其对利益相关者保护的挑战，提出了基于目标的算法监管策略，并建议修改公司法以适应AMFs的新现实。
AI.research_question: 算法如何有效接管人类董事的管理、监督和调解角色？在算法管理企业中，如何保护利益相关者的利益？
AI.motivation: 技术进步催生了完全由算法管理的企业组织，如去中心化自治组织（DAOs）和人工智能管理的企业。这些组织在数据收集和分析方面具有优势，但可能忽视利益相关者的利益，因为算法供应商和AMFs缺乏充分内化社会成本的激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论，特别是董事角色理论（管理、监督、调解），以及利益相关者理论。
AI.method: 理论分析和政策建议，通过逻辑推理和案例研究（如中国在线食品配送行业）来支持论点。
AI.findings: 算法可以有效地接管人类董事的角色，但可能忽视利益相关者的利益，因为算法不会主动考虑这些利益，除非明确指令。命令与控制监管在复杂算法面前效果有限，而基于目标的监管更为合适。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了公司治理理论，引入了算法管理企业（AMFs）的概念，并探讨了算法在董事角色中的适用性。提出了基于目标的监管框架，以适应AMFs的独特挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的监管策略建议，包括采用基于目标的监管而非命令与控制监管，以及算法基础的监管而非实体基础的监管。建议修改公司法，如刺破公司面纱和限制侵权责任，以更好地保护利益相关者。

title: Motives for Pro-Environmental Behavior
affiliations: University of the Bundeswehr Munich, Bard College - The Levy Economics Institute and University of Göttingen

detail.title: Motives for Pro-Environmental Behavior
detail.abstract: Not all behaviors that benefit the environment are executed based on pro-environmental motives. In a survey sample drawn from individuals in a medium-sized German town (n=774), prevalence and motives for 25 different, commonly used, and potentially pro-environmental behaviors are very heterogeneous. In multivariate regression, we find that amongst the common predictors of pro-environmental behavior, green self-image and environmental concern predict an index of pro-environmentally motivated behaviors, whereas income and age predict an index of financially motivated behaviors, but not vice versa. Lack of accounting for these motives may explain why evidence on some determinants of pro-environmental behavior is rather mixed. We further provide a "bias" test showing that not accounting for motives for behavior may lead to an inflation of the coefficient size of the predictors of pro-environmental behavior by up to 300%, but size and direction of bias varies strongly amongst the 25 behaviors analyzed.

AI.tldr: 研究发现并非所有环保行为都出于环保动机。在德国城镇调查中，25种常见环保行为的动机差异很大。绿色自我形象和环境关注度预测环保动机行为，而收入和年龄预测财务动机行为。忽略行为动机会导致环保行为预测系数膨胀高达300%。
AI.research_question: 不同环保行为的动机是什么？忽略行为动机如何影响环保行为决定因素的分析？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对环保行为决定因素的证据存在矛盾，可能是因为没有区分行为背后的不同动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环保行为动机理论，区分环保动机与财务动机等不同驱动因素
AI.method: 对德国中型城镇774名居民的调查，分析25种常见环保行为，使用多元回归分析
