title: Monetary Policy under Global Scrutiny: A Credibility -Responsive Framework for Financially Open Economies

detail.title: Monetary Policy under Global Scrutiny: A Credibility -Responsive Framework for Financially Open Economies

publicationDetails.detailsText: The paper has not appeared yet.

detail.abstract: This article proposes a credibility-responsive monetary policy (CRMP) framework for central banks in financially open economies. Building on the Portfolio Theory of Inflation (Bossone, 2025), it treats credibility as an endogenous, priced constraint that evolves with investor perceptions and policy conduct. Unlike conventional models that assume fixed credibility or neglect capital market dynamics, CRMP embeds investor beliefs into the transmission mechanism and adapts standard policy rules accordingly. The framework explains why identical shocks can yield divergent outcomes across countries, depending on how global investors assess policy commitment. Its mechanics are illustrated through a two-country simulation, with preliminary empirical support from a synthetic credibility index. CRMP provides policymakers with diagnostic and operational tools for navigating volatile capital markets, anchoring expectations, and preserving macroeconomic space under global scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个适用于金融开放经济体的可信度响应货币政策框架，将可信度视为内生变量，纳入投资者信念和资本市场动态，解释为何相同冲击在不同国家产生不同结果。
AI.research_question: 如何在金融开放经济体中建立考虑投资者信念和可信度动态变化的货币政策框架？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策模型假设可信度固定或忽视资本市场动态，无法解释相同冲击在不同国家产生不同结果的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合通胀理论，将可信度视为内生、有定价的约束条件，随投资者认知和政策行为演变。
AI.method: 采用两国模拟分析框架，并构建合成可信度指数进行初步实证支持。
AI.findings: 可信度响应货币政策框架能够解释相同冲击在不同国家的异质性结果，取决于全球投资者对政策承诺的评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可信度内生化，将投资者信念纳入货币政策传导机制，扩展了传统货币政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在动荡资本市场中导航、锚定预期、保持宏观经济空间的诊断和操作工具。

title: Optimal Multi-Period Dynamic Portfolios for Sustainable Investing
affiliations: East China Normal University (ECNU), Peking University and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Optimal Multi-Period Dynamic Portfolios for Sustainable Investing
detail.abstract: Sustainable investing involves balancing traditional investment strategies with environmental, social, and governance-related (ESG) objectives to improve long-term outcomes. We develop a stochastic control framework for constructing optimal multi-period dynamic ESG portfolios, in which investors form dynamic portfolios by maximizing utility functions that account for both profitability and the average ESG scores of their portfolios in the near and distant future. We provide an explicit solution to the investors' utility maximization problem, and show that the optimal weight is a linear combination of three components: a financial performance component, an ESG component, and a component reflecting the weight from the previous period. Using the U.S. stock market data, we find that the multi-period dynamic ESG portfolio outperforms single-period portfolios in terms of Sharpe ratios, alphas, and ESG scores. Our article extends the dynamic portfolio theory in the context of sustainable investing, and provides guidance to practitioners on tailoring ESG portfolios to their specific preferences and to market conditions related to ESG.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个随机控制框架来构建最优多期动态ESG投资组合，通过最大化同时考虑盈利性和ESG得分的效用函数，发现最优权重由财务表现、ESG成分和前期权重三部分线性组合而成。实证显示多期动态ESG组合在夏普比率、阿尔法和ESG得分方面优于单期组合。
AI.research_question: 如何构建最优的多期动态ESG投资组合？多期动态ESG投资组合是否优于单期投资组合？
AI.motivation: 可持续投资需要在传统投资策略与环境、社会和治理(ESG)目标之间取得平衡以改善长期结果，但现有研究缺乏动态多期ESG投资组合的优化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机控制理论、动态投资组合理论、效用最大化理论
AI.method: 开发随机控制框架，构建多期动态ESG投资组合优化模型，使用美国股市数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 最优权重是财务表现、ESG成分和前期权重的线性组合；多期动态ESG投资组合在夏普比率、阿尔法和ESG得分方面优于单期投资组合
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了可持续投资背景下的动态投资组合理论，提供了多期动态ESG投资组合的显式解决方案
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了根据特定偏好和市场条件定制ESG投资组合的指导

title: Long-term Capital Market Assumptions
affiliations: The University of Western Australia, Monash University - Monash Centre for Financial Studies and Monash University - Monash Centre for Financial Studies

detail.title: Long-term Capital Market Assumptions
detail.abstract: In today's volatile financial landscape, the need for accurate and adaptable investment strategies has never been greater. Capital market assumptions (CMAs) form the foundation of long-term asset allocation, providing investors with essential estimates of expected returns, volatility, and risk correlations across asset classes. This study aims to develop our CMAs for both equity and fixed income, outlining the expected returns, and volatility estimates in various countries/regions. We employ rigorous backtesting to evaluate various forecasting models and find that in many cases, less complicated models outshine their more sophisticated counterparts. The cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings (CAPE) ratio outperforms more complex models in 15 out of 20 equity indexes. For Treasury bonds, U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS), and corporate bonds, we show that current bond yields serve as reliable predictors of future returns. However, our model for T-bills demonstrates superior accuracy over the Survey of Professional Forecasters (SPF), with lower RMSE, and MAE values. The effects of inflation and foreign exchange rate changes are also considered to account for nominal price changes and cross-border investment.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了股票和固定收益的资本市场假设，发现在20个股指中有15个，周期性调整市盈率(CAPE)比复杂模型表现更好；对于国债、TIPS和公司债，当前债券收益率是未来回报的可靠预测指标；T-bills模型比专业预测调查(SPF)更准确。
AI.research_question: 如何开发准确且适应性强的资本市场假设(CMAs)来预测股票和固定收益的预期回报与波动性？
AI.motivation: 在波动的金融环境中，需要准确且适应性强的投资策略，而资本市场假设是长期资产配置的基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本市场假设理论、周期性调整市盈率(CAPE)模型、债券收益率预测理论
AI.method: 采用严格回测评估各种预测模型，比较不同模型的预测准确性
AI.findings: CAPE在15/20个股指中优于复杂模型；当前债券收益率是国债、TIPS和公司债未来回报的可靠预测指标；T-bills模型比SPF更准确(RMSE和MAE更低)
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了简单模型在某些情况下优于复杂模型，为预测模型选择提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更准确的资本市场假设，有助于制定更有效的资产配置策略

title: Mean-Variance Strikes Back: Reassessing the 1/N Diversification Superiority
affiliations: University of Agder - School of Business and Law

detail.title: Mean-Variance Strikes Back: Reassessing the 1/N Diversification Superiority
detail.abstract: Equal weighting is often seen as the ultimate benchmark: simple, robust, and, according to DeMiguel, Garlappi, and Uppal (2009), superior to mean-variance optimization out of sample. This view has shaped both academic research and industry practice. We challenge it. Revisiting their analysis through the lens of Kan and Zhou (2007), we show that the supposed dominance of 1/N is an artifact of inconsistent benchmarking and unstable weight normalization. Correctly applied, the Kan-Zhou framework predicts that mean-variance portfolios outperform 1/N after only modest sample sizes. Using 18 U.S. stock portfolio datasets, we confirm this prediction: mean-variance portfolios deliver higher Sharpe ratios in the majority of cases, many significantly so, and a global test rejects the null of no systematic outperformance. Our findings overturn the conventional wisdom: 1/N is not inherently superior, and mean-variance optimization is restored to its rightful place as a powerful and reliable approach to portfolio construction.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了等权重投资组合(1/N)优于均值方差优化的传统观点，证明这种所谓的优势源于不恰当的基准比较和不稳定的权重标准化。通过Kan-Zhou框架分析，发现均值方差组合在适度样本量后表现更好，并在18个美国股票组合数据集中验证了这一预测。
AI.research_question: 等权重投资组合(1/N)是否真的优于均值方差优化？
AI.motivation: DeMiguel等人(2009)的研究认为1/N策略简单、稳健且优于均值方差优化，这一观点影响了学术研究和行业实践，但作者认为这种优势可能是基准比较不一致和权重标准化不稳定造成的。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kan和Zhou(2007)的分析框架，强调一致的基准比较和稳定的权重标准化方法。
AI.method: 重新分析DeMiguel等人的研究，使用Kan-Zhou框架，并在18个美国股票组合数据集上进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 均值方差投资组合在大多数情况下提供更高的夏普比率，许多情况下显著更高，全局检验拒绝了无系统性超额表现的零假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 推翻了1/N策略固有优势的传统观点，恢复了均值方差优化作为强大可靠投资组合构建方法的地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资实践提供了更准确的指导，表明均值方差优化在适度样本量后是更优的选择，有助于改进投资组合管理实践。

title: Panel Data Modelling on Factors Affecting Profitability-Empirical Evidence from Indian Non-Banking Financial Companies
affiliations: PES University and PES University

detail.title: Panel Data Modelling on Factors Affecting Profitability-Empirical Evidence from Indian Non-Banking Financial Companies
detail.abstract: This study investigates the financial determinants of profitability in Indian Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) using panel data from 2015 to 2024. Employing econometric models including Pooled Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), Random Effects, and Fixed Effects regressions, the research evaluates the influence of firm-level variables such as operating profit, capital adequacy ratio, total debt, net non-performing assets (NPAs), and liquidity on reported net profit. The Fixed Effects model, validated by the Hausman test, was identified as the most appropriate specification. The findings reveal that operating profit and capital adequacy ratio have a significant positive impact on profitability, while net NPAs and loans and advances negatively affect firm performance. Liquidity and firm size showed mixed or insignificant effects. A comparative analysis between large and small NBFCs further indicates that smaller firms often achieve higher profitability despite smaller asset bases. These results provide actionable insights for NBFC managers, investors, and policymakers focused on strengthening financial performance and stability within the sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2015-2024年面板数据，通过计量经济模型分析印度非银行金融公司盈利能力的财务决定因素。研究发现营业利润和资本充足率对盈利能力有显著正向影响，而不良资产净额和贷款及预付款则产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 印度非银行金融公司盈利能力的财务决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解NBFCs的盈利能力驱动因素对于该行业的管理者、投资者和政策制定者加强财务绩效和稳定性具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司财务理论和盈利能力决定因素理论，重点关注营业利润、资本充足率、债务水平、不良资产和流动性等关键财务变量。
AI.method: 使用2015-2024年面板数据，采用混合OLS、随机效应和固定效应回归模型，通过Hausman检验确定最优模型。
AI.findings: 营业利润和资本充足率对盈利能力有显著正向影响；不良资产净额和贷款及预付款产生负面影响；流动性和公司规模影响不显著或混合；小型NBFCs往往实现更高盈利能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴市场非银行金融机构盈利能力决定因素的理解，提供了针对印度NBFCs的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NBFC管理者、投资者和政策制定者提供了改善财务绩效和稳定性的具体建议，特别是强调了资本充足率和不良资产管理的重要性。

title: Management Procurement and Law: Future of Approved "Inspectors": Liable or Not Liable?

detail.title: Management Procurement and Law: Future of Approved "Inspectors": Liable or Not Liable?
detail.abstract: This paper analyses Approved Inspector liability under the Defective Premises Act 1972 to their contracting counterparty and other third parties. The paper argues that Approved Inspectors do owe a duty of care to a wider class of potential claimants, particularly where they offer design input into the provision of a dwelling. This may appear contrary to the decision in Herons Court v Heronslea (2019), which confirmed that Approved Inspectors do not owe a duty of care under section 1(1) of the Defective Premises Act 1972 to persons who may suffer as a result of their negligent approval-in that case, subsequent lessees. The Technology and Construction Court in Herons Court reaffirmed the position in Murphy v Brentwood (1991) in which Approved Inspectors, like local authority building control (as was the case in Murphy), cannot be held liable for signing off defective building plans. The ruling in Herons Court may be misinterpreted as absolving Approved Inspectors from any liability under the Defective Premises Act 1972. Accordingly, in order to prove why Approved Inspectors remain liable to different classes of potential claimants, the paper propounds and analyses two types of contracts by which Approved Inspectors are typically appointed. Type-A contracts entail Approved Inspectors only performing their statutory functions under section 49(1)(b) of the Building Act 1984, and in accordance with Regulation 5 of the Building (Approved Inspectors etc.) Regulations 2010. Type-B contracts entail design services being performed in addition to the statutory functions typically found in Type-A contracts. Under both appointments, the contract will be an important starting point for potential claimants in establishing a duty of care, which may, in concomitance, enable concurrent relief in tort and statute depending on the case facts at hand and the claimant's proximity to the Approved Inspector.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了经批准检查员在《1972年缺陷房屋法》下对合同相对方和第三方承担的责任，认为经批准检查员对更广泛的潜在索赔人负有注意义务，特别是在他们提供设计输入的情况下。
AI.research_question: 经批准检查员在《1972年缺陷房屋法》下对合同相对方和第三方承担何种责任？
AI.motivation: Herons Court v Heronslea (2019)案可能被误解为免除了经批准检查员在《1972年缺陷房屋法》下的所有责任，需要澄清其实际责任范围。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《1972年缺陷房屋法》、《1984年建筑法》及相关法规，结合合同法、侵权法和成文法责任理论。
AI.method: 分析两种典型的经批准检查员任命合同类型：仅履行法定职能的A类合同和包含设计服务的B类合同。
AI.findings: 经批准检查员对更广泛的潜在索赔人负有注意义务，合同是确立注意义务的重要起点，可能同时获得侵权法和成文法救济。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了经批准检查员在不同合同类型下的责任范围，为理解其法律责任提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为潜在索赔人提供了确立经批准检查员责任的法律依据，有助于实践中更好地维护权益。

title: Beyond Similarity: Using LLMs to Uncover Corporate Environmental Efforts from Investor-Company Q&As
affiliations: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business and Jilin University (JLU)

detail.title: Beyond Similarity: Using LLMs to Uncover Corporate Environmental Efforts from Investor-Company Q&As
detail.abstract: As environmental disclosure becomes an increasingly established norm across the globe, it is of crucial importance to explore how to effectively assess enterprises' actual environmental actions based on their environmental information disclosures. This study examines whether environmental disclosures on China's interactive investor platforms (IIPs) provide credible signals of firms' environmental behavior. We identify environment-related questions on IIPs using keyword filtering combined with Bert, and measure response quality through response length, semantic similarity, and GPT-4o-mini, a large language model (LLM), to classify substantive answers. Our results show that higher-quality responses are strongly associated with superior environmental outcomes, including greater environmental innovation, fewer penalties, and higher environmental investment. The LLM-based measure proves particularly effective, consistently outperforming traditional proxies. These findings remain robust across importance evaluation based on XGBoost, after controlling for annual report disclosures, and when accounting for potential selection bias. Overall, our study provides practical insights for investors and regulators seeking to better assess firms' environmental performance, and demonstrates the value of AI-based tools for disclosure analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨中国互动投资者平台上的环境信息披露是否能可靠反映企业实际环境行为。通过结合关键词过滤和BERT识别环境相关问题，使用GPT-4o-mini等LLM评估回复质量，发现高质量回复与更好的环境绩效显著相关。
AI.research_question: 中国互动投资者平台上的环境信息披露是否能提供企业环境行为的可信信号？
AI.motivation: 随着环境信息披露成为全球性规范，如何基于披露信息有效评估企业实际环境行动变得至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露理论、信号理论、企业环境责任理论
AI.method: 使用关键词过滤结合BERT识别环境相关问题，通过回复长度、语义相似度和GPT-4o-mini等LLM分类实质性回答来评估回复质量
AI.findings: 高质量回复与优越的环境结果显著相关，包括更多环境创新、更少处罚和更高环境投资。基于LLM的测量方法特别有效，持续优于传统代理指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了互动平台环境信息披露的信号价值，展示了AI工具在披露分析中的价值
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管者评估企业环境绩效提供实用见解，证明AI工具在披露分析中的应用价值

title: An analytical heterogeneous agent macro model of concentration, markups, and falling labour shares
affiliations: University of Leeds, University of the West of England (UWE) and University of Geneva

detail.title: An analytical heterogeneous agent macro model of concentration, markups, and falling labour shares
detail.abstract: This paper presents a small-scale analytical heterogeneous agent model (HAM) to explore firm concentration dynamics and the aggregate effects on distribution and growth. It contributes to recent work on tractable macroeconomic agent-based models (ABMs) by comparing two versions of the model: an ABM with bilateral firm-customer matching, and a simplified HAM without direct agent interaction. The HAM replicates key ABM results while allowing for analytical solutions. The model captures how pricing, investment, and market concentration evolve at the micro level and affect macro-level outcomes. Firms differ in capital size and market share. Larger firms benefit from lower unit costs due to economies of scale, gain larger market shares, and charge higher markups. At the same time, customers seek lower prices, creating competitive pressure. These mechanisms drive endogenous changes in the firm size distribution. More profitable firms temporarily grow faster, leading to concentration of capital, market shares, and markups. These dynamics lead to right-skewed distributions, producing a divergence between the average profit share across firms and the aggregate profit share, which is driven up by the biggest firms. The fall in the labour share reduces consumption and slows down growth. Despite its simplicity, the model captures key empirical patterns related to superstar firms and declining labour shares.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个小型异质性代理人模型，比较了基于代理人的模型和简化异质性代理人模型，发现两者都能模拟企业集中度动态及其对分配和增长的宏观影响。模型显示大企业因规模经济获得成本优势，导致资本、市场份额和利润集中，劳动份额下降抑制消费和增长。
AI.research_question: 企业集中度动态如何影响收入分配和经济增长？
AI.motivation: 近年来关于超级明星企业和劳动份额下降的实证现象需要理论解释，现有宏观模型难以捕捉企业异质性和市场集中度的微观机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性代理人模型、基于代理人的模型、规模经济理论、企业定价和投资决策理论
AI.method: 构建小型分析性异质性代理人模型，比较基于代理人模型和简化异质性代理人模型两种版本，进行数值模拟和分析求解
AI.findings: 大企业因规模经济获得成本优势，市场份额和利润率上升；资本、市场份额和利润向大企业集中；劳动份额下降抑制消费和经济增长；模型能复制超级明星企业和劳动份额下降的实证模式
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个可解析求解的异质性代理人模型框架，揭示了企业集中度动态的微观机制及其宏观影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解企业集中度、收入分配和经济增长的关系提供了理论工具，对反垄断政策和收入分配政策具有启示意义

title: AI In Investment Management: The Advancement Of Learning *
affiliations: Amundi Institute, Amundi Institute, Amundi Technology, Amundi Institute, Amundi Technology and Amundi Institute

detail.title: AI In Investment Management: The Advancement Of Learning *
detail.abstract: At Amundi, we have previously explored NLP approaches but were disappointed by their instability-small changes in input words or word order often led to significant shifts in interpretation. In our recent research, we revisited modern Transformer-based NLP models. Much like their revolutionary impact on language translation, we found that Transformer-based approaches brought an unexpected level of analytical precision to Natural Language Processing tasks. Our findings show that AI, combined with Big Data, has the potential to deepen our understanding of financial markets. For example, we were able to quantify economic narratives using news data. This allows us to test the intuitions of renowned academic researchers whose work has shaped financial and economic reasoning in our industry. As finance becomes increasingly intertwined with AI, new questions will emerge for practitioners, especially as knowledge is now processed and accessed in entirely new forms. Concepts have become vectors. It is our responsibility to leverage AI tools to enhance the robustness of portfolio management.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了基于Transformer的NLP模型在金融分析中的应用，发现相比传统NLP方法，Transformer模型提供了更高的分析精度和稳定性，能够通过新闻数据量化经济叙事，从而增强投资组合管理的稳健性。
AI.research_question: 基于Transformer的NLP模型能否为金融市场的自然语言处理任务带来更高的分析精度和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统NLP方法在金融应用中存在不稳定性问题，输入文本的微小变化会导致解释结果的显著偏移，这限制了其在投资决策中的可靠应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer架构的自然语言处理理论，结合大数据分析框架，探索AI在金融文本分析中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用现代Transformer-based NLP模型，利用新闻数据构建经济叙事量化方法，并与学术研究者的直觉进行对比验证。
AI.findings: Transformer-based方法在NLP任务中展现出意想不到的分析精度，能够稳定地量化经济叙事，验证了学术研究者的理论直觉，为金融市场理解提供了新的深度。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了Transformer架构在金融文本分析中的理论优势，为AI与金融的深度融合提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了基于Transformer的稳定NLP分析工具，能够增强投资组合管理的稳健性，为金融从业者提供了新的AI辅助决策方法。

title: Bargaining Over Taxes
affiliations: National University Singapore and

detail.title: Bargaining Over Taxes
detail.abstract: This paper shows that bargaining over tax payments is an important feature of tax compliance and enforcement in lower income countries. Analyzing the universe of administrative tax filings from Zambia, we document sharp bunching in (i) dominated regions above tax schedule discontinuities, inconsistent with standard models of tax compliance and (ii) at round number tax payments, implying that certain payments are being targeted. Additional evidence from our own survey suggests that discussing tax payments with tax officials before filing taxes is widespread, in line with tax payments being the outcomes of bargaining. Such bargaining over taxes is consistent with fact (ii), as bargaining outcomes are often round and salient numbers, and with fact (i), because tax schedule discontinuities restrict the set of feasible bargaining outcomes. Finally, we generalize the conventional Allingham & Sandmo (1972) model to allow for bargaining as a mode of tax compliance. We show that bargaining leads to Pareto-improvements for both taxpayers and the state as long as state capacity is sufficiently low.

AI.tldr: 本文发现税收谈判是低收入国家税收合规与执法的重要特征。通过对赞比亚税务数据的分析，发现纳税人在税收表断点上方和整数纳税额处存在明显聚集现象，这与标准税收合规模型不符。调查显示纳税人与税务官员在申报前进行谈判很普遍。作者扩展了Allingham-Sandmo模型，证明在政府能力较低时，税收谈判对纳税人和政府都是帕累托改进。
AI.research_question: 税收谈判在低收入国家税收合规中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统税收合规模型无法解释低收入国家观察到的纳税行为模式，特别是纳税额在税收表断点上方和整数处的聚集现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展了Allingham & Sandmo (1972)的经典税收合规模型，引入税收谈判作为合规模式。
AI.method: 使用赞比亚全量行政税务数据进行分析，结合自主调查数据验证税收谈判的普遍性。
AI.findings: 发现纳税额在税收表断点上方和整数处存在明显聚集；纳税人与税务官员在申报前进行谈判很普遍；在政府能力较低时，税收谈判能实现帕累托改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 将税收谈判纳入税收合规理论框架，解释了传统模型无法解释的纳税行为模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低收入国家税收政策设计提供了新视角，表明在特定条件下税收谈判可能是有益的制度安排。

title: Persistence in Stock Returns: Robotics and AI ETFs Versus Other Assets
affiliations: University of Sfax, Brunel University London - Department of Economics and Finance and University of Navarra - Department of Economics

detail.title: Persistence in Stock Returns: Robotics and AI ETFs Versus Other Assets
detail.abstract: This paper examines the long-memory properties of returns of exchange-traded funds (ETFs) specializing in robotics and artificial intelligence (AI) listed on the US market, as well as those of other assets such as the WTI crude oil price (West Texas Intermediate), Bitcoin, the S&P 500 index, 10-year US Treasury bonds, and the VIX volatility index. The frequency is daily and the sample period goes from 1 January 2023 to 23 June 2025. The adopted fractional integration framework is more general and flexible than those previously used in related studies, and sheds light on the degree of persistence of returns. The evidence suggests that all returns series examined are highly persistent, regardless of the error structure assumed, and that in general a linear model is appropriate to capture their evolution over time. The implications are that that the newly developed assets do not offer to investors additional hedging and diversification opportunities compared to more traditional ones, and that the creation of these additional financial instruments does not pose fresh challenges to policy makers tasked with financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国市场上专注于机器人和人工智能的ETF以及其他资产（WTI原油、比特币、标普500指数、10年期美国国债、VIX波动率指数）的长期记忆特性。研究发现所有资产回报都具有高度持续性，新兴资产并未提供额外的对冲和多样化机会。
AI.research_question: 专注于机器人和人工智能的ETF以及其他传统资产的回报是否具有长期记忆特性？这些新兴资产是否提供了额外的对冲和多样化机会？
AI.motivation: 随着机器人和人工智能ETF等新兴金融工具的出现，需要了解它们的市场特性，特别是长期记忆特性，以评估其对投资者和政策制定者的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数积分框架，这是一种比以往研究中使用的模型更一般和灵活的方法，用于分析时间序列的持续性。
AI.method: 使用分数积分方法分析2023年1月1日至2025年6月23日的日度数据，涵盖机器人和人工智能ETF、WTI原油、比特币、标普500指数、10年期美国国债和VIX波动率指数。
AI.findings: 所有研究的回报序列都具有高度持续性，无论假设何种误差结构，线性模型通常适合捕捉它们随时间的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对新兴金融资产长期记忆特性的实证证据，扩展了分数积分方法在金融时间序列分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供指导：新兴资产并未提供比传统资产更多的对冲和多样化机会；为政策制定者提供参考：这些新金融工具的创建不会对金融稳定构成新的挑战。

title: Range Effects in Economic Choice: The Role of Complexity
affiliations: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business, QuantCo, Inc., Paris School of Economics and Bocconi University

detail.title: Range Effects in Economic Choice: The Role of Complexity
detail.abstract: Several behavioral models assume that choice over multi-attribute goods is systematically affected by the ranges of attribute values. Two recurring principles in this literature are contrast— whereby attributes with larger ranges attract attention and are therefore overweighted—and normalization—whereby attributes with larger ranges are underweighted as fixed differences appear smaller against a larger range. These principles lead to divergent predictions, and yet, both contrast-based and normalization-based models have found strong empirical support, albeit in different contexts and with different experimental designs. The question remains: when does one effect emerge over the other? We experimentally test a unifying explanation: normalization dominates in simple choices, while contrast dominates in complex choices. We conduct an experiment with real-effort tasks in which we manipulate attribute ranges in both simple and complex choices. We find that, indeed, contrast dominates as the number of attributes increases. We also find that contrast emerges with cognitive load induced by time pressure.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验验证了多属性选择中对比效应和标准化效应的统一解释：在简单选择中标准化效应占主导，而在复杂选择中对比效应占主导。研究发现随着属性数量增加和认知负荷（时间压力）增大，对比效应会增强。
AI.research_question: 在多属性选择中，对比效应和标准化效应何时会分别占主导地位？
AI.motivation: 行为模型中对多属性选择的两种主要原则——对比效应和标准化效应——存在预测分歧，但都在不同情境下得到实证支持。需要明确这两种效应在不同条件下的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对比效应理论（属性范围越大越受关注而被高估）和标准化效应理论（属性范围越大固定差异相对变小而被低估）
AI.method: 采用真实努力任务的实验设计，在简单和复杂选择中操纵属性范围，并引入时间压力来诱导认知负荷
AI.findings: 随着属性数量增加，对比效应占主导；在认知负荷（时间压力）下，对比效应也会增强
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了对比效应和标准化效应的统一解释框架，明确了两种效应在不同选择复杂度条件下的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解消费者选择行为提供了更精确的理论指导，有助于预测在不同复杂度情境下的决策偏差

title: Power and Values: The Gap Between Capitalist Mindsets and Capitalism
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Power and Values: The Gap Between Capitalist Mindsets and Capitalism
detail.abstract: According to the economics Nobel laureate, Kenneth Arrow, “… capitalism is a flawed system. It probably has the same virtues as Churchill attributed to democracy: It’s the worst system except for any other.” Thus, capitalism is a necessary evil, but it is not inherently bad. I argue that most people have a capitalist mindset but do not have the power to be capitalists. There are different intensities of capitalist mindsets and constraints on the power of capitalists. Thus, there are different types of capitalism and, as a result, different socio-economic outcomes. I discuss the relationship between capitalism and economics and conclude that the perception that economists are cheerleaders of neoliberalism and capitalism may be wrong.

AI.tldr: 本文认为资本主义是一种必要的恶，但并非本质邪恶。大多数人具有资本主义思维但缺乏成为资本家的权力。资本主义思维强度和资本家权力约束存在差异，导致不同类型的资本主义和不同的社会经济结果。作者还挑战了经济学家是新自由主义和资本主义拥护者的普遍看法。
AI.research_question: 资本主义思维与资本家权力之间的关系如何影响不同类型的资本主义和社会经济结果？
AI.motivation: 基于肯尼斯·阿罗的观点，资本主义虽有缺陷但优于其他制度。作者希望探讨资本主义的复杂性，挑战对资本主义的简单化理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 肯尼斯·阿罗的资本主义理论、资本主义思维理论、权力约束理论、制度多样性理论
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建
AI.findings: 1) 资本主义是必要的恶但非本质邪恶 2) 多数人具有资本主义思维但缺乏成为资本家的权力 3) 资本主义思维强度和资本家权力约束的差异导致不同类型的资本主义 4) 经济学家并非必然是新自由主义和资本主义的拥护者
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了资本主义思维与资本家权力关系的分析框架，区分了不同类型的资本主义，挑战了对资本主义的简单二分法理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同资本主义制度的社会经济结果差异提供了理论依据，有助于政策制定者设计更有效的制度安排。

title: Conflict and Democratic Preferences
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Research on Collective Goods and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU)

detail.title: Conflict and Democratic Preferences
detail.abstract: We investigate how exposure to conflict events shapes individuals’ democratic preferences, focusing on support for democracy in general and perceptions of governance within one’s own country. We examine how ethnic affiliation–whether an individual belongs to an ethnic group with access to state power–influences democratic attitudes, reflecting differences in social standing and expectations about democratization. Using a rich data set covering more than 30 African countries over two decades, we exploit variation in the timing of conflict events relative to survey interviews to identify causal effects. Our findings show that conflict exposure, on average, increases support for democracy, but the effects vary by ethnicity and regime type. In autocracies, conflict triggers rally-around-the-flag effects: support for democracy rises, but so do perceptions of the state. Violence also increases trust in ruling institutions in autocratic regimes, an effect that is absent in more democratic settings.

AI.motivation: Error
AI.method: Error

title: The 2025 Trade War: Dynamic Impacts Across U.S. States and the Global Economy
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics, Ifo Institute, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, London School of Economics and University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics

detail.title: The 2025 Trade War: Dynamic Impacts Across U.S. States and the Global Economy
detail.abstract: We use detailed tariff data and a dynamic trade and reallocation model with downward nominal wage rigidities to quantitatively assess the economic consequences of the recent increase in U.S. import tariffs and the responses of its trading partners. Higher tariffs trigger an expansion in U.S. manufacturing and agricultural employment, but this comes at the expense of a decline in service employment, with overall employment declining as lower real wages reduce labor-force participation. For the United States as a whole, real income falls around 0.1% by 2028, the last year we assume the high tariffs are in effect. Importantly, our analysis disaggregates the U.S. into its 50 states, while incorporating cross-state redistribution of the tariff-generated fiscal revenue, allowing us to analyze which states gain or lose more from the shock. Some of the most populous states, like California, New York, and Texas, suffer real income declines of up to 1.4%. On the flip side, 34 states gain, in some cases as much as 1.9%. Turning to cross-country results, some close U.S. trading partners—like Canada, Mexico, and Ireland—suffer the largest real income losses.

AI.tldr: 本文使用详细关税数据和具有向下名义工资刚性的动态贸易与再分配模型，定量评估了近期美国进口关税增加及其贸易伙伴反应的经济后果。研究发现，虽然关税提高促进了美国制造业和农业就业，但以服务业就业下降为代价，总体就业因实际工资降低而减少。美国整体实际收入到2028年下降约0.1%，但各州影响差异显著，34个州获益，而人口大州如加州、纽约州和德克萨斯州实际收入下降高达1.4%。美国主要贸易伙伴如加拿大、墨西哥和爱尔兰遭受最大实际收入损失。
AI.research_question: 美国近期进口关税增加及其贸易伙伴反应对经济的具体影响是什么？各州和主要贸易伙伴的分配效应如何？
AI.motivation: 理解贸易政策变化的经济后果，特别是关税增加对各州和贸易伙伴的差异化影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态贸易与再分配模型，包含向下名义工资刚性假设。
AI.method: 使用详细关税数据，结合动态贸易和再分配模型进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 关税提高导致美国制造业和农业就业扩张，但服务业就业下降，总体就业减少；美国整体实际收入下降0.1%，但各州影响差异显著；主要贸易伙伴遭受较大实际收入损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含工资刚性的动态贸易模型，为分析贸易政策的分配效应提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关税政策对各州和贸易伙伴具体影响的量化评估，有助于更精准的政策设计。

title: Gender Gaps in Patience, Risk-Taking, Trust, and Prosociality Have Declined Across Birth Cohorts
affiliations: Harvard University - T.H. Chan School of Public Health and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Gender Gaps in Patience, Risk-Taking, Trust, and Prosociality Have Declined Across Birth Cohorts
detail.abstract: Men and women differ systematically in measures of patience, risk-taking, trust, and prosociality. While literature documents such gender gaps in numerous countries throughout the world, recent work suggests an association between these gender gaps and economic development, based on evidence of larger gender gaps in Western, educated, industrialized, rich, and democratic societies. However, little is known about how these gender gaps evolve and whether they indeed widen as countries develop. To examine this question, we analyze how within-country gender gaps in patience, risk-taking, trust, and prosociality have evolved across birth cohorts worldwide. We compare these gender gaps across country–period– cohort cells using two survey data sets that cover 460,000 people in more than 100 countries. Our results document that gender gaps in patience, risk-taking, trust, and prosociality have declined across birth cohorts. This evidence rejects the notion that these gender gaps widen as countries develop and instead points to a decline in socioeconomic differences between men and women.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在全球范围内，耐心、风险承担、信任和亲社会性方面的性别差距随着出生队列的推移而缩小，这与经济发展导致性别差距扩大的观点相反。
AI.research_question: 耐心、风险承担、信任和亲社会性方面的性别差距如何随着国家发展而演变？
AI.motivation: 现有文献记录了全球范围内的性别差异，但关于这些性别差距如何演变以及是否随着国家发展而扩大的了解甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别差距与经济发展关系的理论框架，关注社会经济差异对性别行为特征的影响。
AI.method: 使用两个调查数据集，覆盖100多个国家的460,000人，分析不同国家-时期-出生队列中的性别差距演变。
AI.findings: 耐心、风险承担、信任和亲社会性方面的性别差距在出生队列中呈现下降趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了性别差距随经济发展而扩大的观点，提出了性别差距缩小的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解性别平等进程提供了实证支持，表明社会经济差异的缩小有助于减少性别行为差异。

title: College Graduates in the Labor Market: Geographic Mobility and Sorting into Firms and Occupations *
affiliations: National University of Singapore, Hong Kong Baptist University and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

detail.title: College Graduates in the Labor Market: Geographic Mobility and Sorting into Firms and Occupations *
detail.abstract: This paper brings together three online labor market platforms---LinkedIn user profiles, Burning Glass job postings, and Glassdoor wages---to construct a novel dataset on college graduates from U.S. universities that contains detailed information on their employers, occupations, and locations, as well as the tasks required in their jobs. We document new facts about the mobility of college graduates and show how mobility patterns differ across universities of varying rankings and locations. Estimating a model in which college graduates choose firms, occupations, and locations, we find evidence of positive sorting of higher-ranked universities matching to cognitively intensive jobs and high-amenity cities. Distance significantly reduces the probability of job matching for most universities, but has little effect for graduates from the most elite institutions. Our analysis also reveals a sizable geographic premium in labor market outcomes for universities located in major cities.

AI.tldr: 本文整合LinkedIn用户档案、Burning Glass职位发布和Glassdoor工资数据，构建了美国大学毕业生就业数据集，研究毕业生流动模式及其与大学排名、地理位置的关系。
AI.research_question: 大学毕业生如何选择雇主、职业和地点？不同排名和地理位置的大学毕业生流动模式有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解大学毕业生就业流动模式及其影响因素，为高等教育政策和劳动力市场分析提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于毕业生选择模型，分析大学排名、地理位置对就业匹配的影响。
AI.method: 整合三个在线劳动力市场平台数据构建数据集，估计毕业生选择雇主、职业和地点的模型。
AI.findings: 高排名大学毕业生更倾向于选择认知密集型工作和高舒适度城市；距离对大多数大学毕业生就业匹配有显著负面影响，但对顶尖院校影响较小；位于大城市的大学存在显著地理溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了大学排名和地理位置对毕业生就业流动影响的新证据，完善了人力资本流动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学政策制定、学生择校和就业指导提供实证依据，帮助理解劳动力市场地理分布模式。

title: The Social Value of Strategic Public Information
affiliations: Lingnan College, Sun Yat-sen University, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Lingnan (University) College and Business School, Sun Yat-Sen University

detail.title: The Social Value of Strategic Public Information
detail.abstract: We study the welfare effects of strategically using public information when the provider's information quality is unobservable. Our model features a benevolent public authority that privately observes her information quality and strategically chooses whether to provide public information to private-sector agents in a beauty-contest game a` la Morris and Shin (2002). We show that the authority's equilibrium strategy hinges on her expected information advantage relative to private-sector agents. When the advantage is either small or large, the authority pools across qualities, and with risk-averse agents, the added uncertainty regarding quality lowers welfare relative to a benchmark without such uncertainty. When the information advantage is intermediate, a separating equilibrium emerges: the high-quality authority provides public information, while the low-quality authority withholds it. In this case, the strategic use of public information enhances welfare by channeling superior signals into decisions while limiting overreliance on weak information. By delineating these regimes, we clarify when the social value of strategic public information is beneficial versus detrimental, offering guidance for public communication policies.

AI.tldr: 研究公共信息提供者在信息质量不可观测时的策略性使用对福利的影响。当信息优势较小或较大时，权威机构会采取混合策略，导致福利下降；当信息优势适中时，高质量权威提供信息而低质量权威隐瞒信息，这种分离均衡能提升福利。
AI.research_question: 当公共信息提供者的信息质量不可观测时，策略性地使用公共信息对福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 公共机构在信息质量不可观测的情况下如何策略性地提供信息，以及这种策略性行为对社会福利的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Morris和Shin(2002)的选美竞赛博弈模型，引入信息质量不可观测性和风险厌恶的私人部门代理人。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，研究公共权威在信息质量私有观察下的均衡策略选择。
AI.findings: 1. 信息优势较小或较大时：权威机构采取混合策略，由于代理人风险厌恶，信息质量不确定性降低福利；2. 信息优势适中时：出现分离均衡，高质量权威提供信息，低质量权威隐瞒信息，策略性使用公共信息提升福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了公共信息策略性使用的福利效应，识别了不同信息优势区间下的均衡类型及其福利含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共沟通政策提供指导，明确了战略公共信息何时具有社会价值（有益）何时有害（不利）。

title: Do gasoline price expectations affect household readiness to spend at the ZLB? Evidence from Michigan survey data
affiliations: TEXAS STATE UNIV, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Texas State University

detail.title: Do gasoline price expectations affect household readiness to spend at the ZLB? Evidence from Michigan survey data
detail.abstract: This paper examines how household gasoline price expectations influence readiness to spend on durable goods, with particular attention to periods when short-term interest rates are constrained by the zero lower bound (ZLB). Using microdata from the Michigan Survey of Consumers, we estimate ordered probit models across both normal and ZLB conditions. The results show that higher gasoline price expectations significantly reduce spending readiness during normal periods, while at the ZLB the estimated effects are smaller and statistically insignificant. We also explore potential mechanisms — discretionary income, precautionary savings, uncertainty, and operational costs — and find that the influence of expectations is concentrated in normal interest-rate environments. Our results suggest that gasoline price expectations significantly constrain household spending in normal times, but lose traction at the zero lower bound, implying that the policy relevance of energy price shocks depends on the prevailing interest-rate environment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究家庭汽油价格预期如何影响耐用品消费意愿，特别关注零利率下限时期。研究发现：在正常利率时期，汽油价格预期上升显著抑制消费意愿；但在零利率下限时期，这种影响变小且不显著。
AI.research_question: 家庭汽油价格预期如何影响耐用品消费意愿？这种影响在零利率下限时期与正常时期有何不同？
AI.motivation: 理解能源价格冲击对家庭消费的影响机制，特别是在货币政策受限的零利率下限时期，对制定有效的经济政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭消费决策理论，结合预期形成机制和利率环境对消费行为的影响。
AI.method: 使用密歇根消费者调查的微观数据，采用有序probit模型，分别估计正常时期和零利率下限时期的效应。
AI.findings: 1. 正常时期：汽油价格预期上升显著降低消费意愿；2. 零利率下限时期：影响变小且统计上不显著；3. 预期的影响主要集中在正常利率环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了利率环境在调节能源价格冲击对消费影响中的重要作用，拓展了对货币政策传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：能源价格冲击的政策相关性取决于当前利率环境，在零利率下限时期，传统能源政策的效果可能有限。

title: Born Global, New Exporter Dynamics, and the Aggregate Gains from Trade
affiliations: University of Rochester - University of Rochester, School of Arts and Sciences, Department of Economics, Students

detail.title: Born Global, New Exporter Dynamics, and the Aggregate Gains from Trade
detail.abstract: This paper examines how firm age shapes exporter dynamics and alters the aggregate gains from trade liberalization. Using firm-level data from India, I identify a new fact: young new exporters-firms that begin exporting shortly after establishment-enter with persistently higher export intensity than old new exporters. In contrast, older new exporters start with low export intensity and expand gradually if they survive. These patterns challenge the canonical heterogeneous firm international trade model, which assumes that initial export intensity is independent of a firm's domestic age. To account for this empirical finding, I develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms in which entrants can invest in an export advantage at entry, lowering shipping costs. The calibrated model shows that self-selection at market entry, combined with stochastic export cost dynamics, generates the heterogeneity of new exporter dynamics by firm age at export entry. Quantitatively, I show that the aggregate trade adjustment following trade liberalization is considerably slower when accounting for the age heterogeneity of new exporter dynamics, compared to a model without this feature. Even if the long-run trade elasticity is large, the slower trade adjustment limits welfare gains from trade liberalization, since the short-run gains are smaller.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现年轻出口商在进入出口市场时具有更高的出口强度，而年长出口商则从低强度开始逐步扩张。这种基于企业年龄的异质性挑战了传统贸易模型，并导致贸易自由化的福利收益降低。
AI.research_question: 企业年龄如何影响出口商动态并改变贸易自由化的总体收益？
AI.motivation: 传统异质企业国际贸易模型假设初始出口强度与企业国内年龄无关，但实证观察发现年轻新出口商与年长新出口商在出口动态上存在系统性差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一般均衡模型，包含异质企业，允许进入者在进入时投资于出口优势以降低运输成本。
AI.method: 使用印度企业层面数据进行实证分析，并开发校准的动态一般均衡模型。
AI.findings: 年轻新出口商以持续较高的出口强度进入，而年长新出口商从低强度开始逐步扩张；市场进入时的自我选择与随机出口成本动态共同产生了基于出口进入年龄的新出口商动态异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统异质企业贸易模型的假设，提出了考虑企业年龄异质性的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了贸易自由化调整速度较慢的现实，限制了短期福利收益，即使长期贸易弹性很大。

title: Climate Justice: Historical Accountability vs. International Paretianism
affiliations: Chungnam National University and Seoul National University

detail.title: Climate Justice: Historical Accountability vs. International Paretianism
detail.abstract: We examine two principles of allocative justice in the climate agreement - historical accountability (Neumayer, 2000) and international Paretianism, IP (Posner and Weisbach, 2010). The former requires that a country’s emissions rights be limited by its historical (emissions) debt. The latter is forward-looking and requires that the agreement should not make any country worse off. The international protocols satisfying historical accountability impose drastically greater burdens on advanced countries in Europe and North America than the Kyoto Protocol and the Paris Agreement. Interestingly, the protocol supported by IP, despite being forward-looking and supposedly more favorable to advanced countries, also demands significant emissions reductions from them—often even more than the equal per capita allocation. This finding counters Posner and Weisbach’s earlier, IP-based argument against the Kyoto Protocol (and the equal per capita rule).

AI.tldr: 本文比较了气候协议中的两种分配正义原则：历史责任原则和国际帕累托原则。研究发现，两种原则都要求发达国家承担比现有协议更大的减排负担，这与Posner和 Weisbach基于国际帕累托原则反对京都议定书的论点相矛盾。
AI.research_question: 历史责任原则和国际帕累托原则在气候协议分配正义中的比较效果如何？
AI.motivation: 探讨不同分配正义原则在气候协议中的实际影响，验证国际帕累托原则是否如Posner和Weisbach所言对发达国家更有利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史责任原则（Neumayer, 2000）和国际帕累托原则（Posner and Weisbach, 2010）
AI.method: 理论分析和比较研究，对比不同原则下的减排负担分配
AI.findings: 两种原则都要求发达国家承担比京都议定书和巴黎协定更大的减排负担；国际帕累托原则甚至比人均平等分配要求更多减排
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了Posner和Weisbach关于国际帕累托原则对发达国家更有利的论点
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候协议谈判提供了新的分配正义视角，表明发达国家在多种原则下都需要承担更大责任

title: AI Competition Law '25
affiliations: University of Zurich - Institute of Law

detail.title: AI Competition Law '25
detail.abstract: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly prevalent in more and more market sectors. As the guardian of fair competition, antitrust law must therefore also address this development, both by analyzing AI-related cases and through the use of AI tools by enforcers. Both in terms of its subject matter and the state of the discourse, this debate is still in its early stages. AI already plays a role in competition law proceedings, without its genuine characteristics having yet been the subject of detailed consideration in decisions by authorities or courts. Accordingly, the current competition law discourse contains more prognosis than diagnosis. At the same time, competition authorities are showing great vigilance with regard to the market impact of the new technology, partly as a lesson learned from the difficult position that slow enforcement in digital (platform) markets has had and continues to have. This state of affairs suggests that we should take a look around internationally to see where we stand with AI competition law and what trends are emerging. This article addresses this task insofar as, after a brief technical and economic reflection (II.), it attempts to outline important aspects of the legal situation in the area of anticompetitive agreements (III.) and abuse of market power (IV.) and to derive some interim findings (V.) from this.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在反垄断法中的应用和影响，分析了AI在竞争法程序中的角色，以及国际AI竞争法的发展趋势。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响反垄断法，以及国际AI竞争法的现状和发展趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在各行业广泛应用，作为公平竞争守护者的反垄断法必须应对这一发展，包括分析AI相关案例和使用AI工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法理论框架，包括反竞争协议和滥用市场支配地位的法律原则。
AI.method: 通过国际比较分析和技术经济反思，概述法律现状并推导中期发现。
AI.findings: AI已在竞争法程序中发挥作用，但其真正特征尚未在官方或法院裁决中得到详细考虑；当前竞争法讨论更多是预测而非诊断。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI与反垄断法交叉领域提供了理论框架，填补了该领域早期研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争执法机构提供AI时代反垄断执法的实践指导，帮助避免数字平台市场监管滞后的教训重演。

title: Corporate Transparency and Cybersecurity Risks
affiliations: Boston College - Carroll School of Management

detail.title: Corporate Transparency and Cybersecurity Risks
detail.abstract: I study whether disclosure mandates alter the equilibrium of cyberattacks by unintentionally informing cybercriminals. The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) requires companies to disclose their personal information collection practices to consumers, inadvertently informing cybercriminals about the potential benefits of breaching each firm. Using a difference-in-differences design, I find that firms disclosing the collection of valuable personal data face an increased probability of data breaches. These firms also strengthen their cyberdefenses, both in terms of software and employee cybersecurity expertise. Firms trade off cybersecurity costs against the risk of data breaches, with the increase in breach probabilities more pronounced among firms that invest less in cybersecurity. Finally, I find that firms adjust their data-collection policies as additional defense strategies. Overall, this study highlights the trade-off between transparency and cybersecurity risks in today's economy.

AI.tldr: 研究加州消费者隐私法案(CCPA)披露要求如何通过无意中向网络犯罪分子透露信息而改变网络攻击均衡。发现披露收集有价值个人数据的公司面临更高的数据泄露概率，同时加强网络防御，并在网络安全成本与数据泄露风险之间进行权衡。
AI.research_question: 披露要求是否会通过无意中告知网络犯罪分子而改变网络攻击的均衡？
AI.motivation: 加州消费者隐私法案(CCPA)要求公司向消费者披露个人信息收集实践，但无意中向网络犯罪分子透露了入侵每家公司的潜在收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络攻击均衡理论、信息披露与网络安全权衡理论
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计(Difference-in-Differences)
AI.findings: 披露收集有价值个人数据的公司面临更高的数据泄露概率；这些公司同时加强了网络防御（软件和员工网络安全专业知识）；公司在网络安全成本与数据泄露风险之间进行权衡；数据泄露概率增加在网络安全投资较少的公司中更为明显；公司调整数据收集政策作为额外防御策略
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了透明度与网络安全风险之间的权衡关系；发展了信息披露对网络攻击均衡影响的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于隐私披露法规意外后果的实证证据；为企业网络安全投资决策提供指导

title: Is the Energy Transition Sustainable in Economies with Competitive Disadvantage? A RVAR Analysis of Greece and Belgium
affiliations: and National and Kapodistrian University of Athens - Department of Economics

detail.title: Is the Energy Transition Sustainable in Economies with Competitive Disadvantage? A RVAR Analysis of Greece and Belgium
detail.abstract: This paper explores whether a shift toward renewable energy supports growth in small open economies with contrasting competitiveness. Where adverse effects arise, they reflect structural factors rather than the transition per se. Using annual observations for Greece and Belgium (1990–2023), we estimate a recursive VAR that jointly models GDP, investment, export-import ratio, and the renewable share of electricity supply. The specification accommodates endogenous feedback and estimates the persistence of shocks via orthogonal impulse-responses, and inference relies on a residual fixed-design bootstrap with BCa bands. The evidence is asymmetrical. In Greece, a 1-σ renewable shock reduces real GDP by roughly 0.46% cumulatively (sum of Δln(⋅) responses) over three periods; in Belgium, is economically small, oscillating briefly around zero. We interpret the Greek outcome as consistent with a tourism-driven Dutch-disease mechanism and a Balassa-Samuelson channel, that raises domestic prices, undermines external competitiveness, and compresses tradable output. Once deeper structural and competitiveness distortions are addressed, the same green-energy push could shift from constraining to supporting growth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可再生能源转型对希腊和比利时这两个竞争力不同的小型开放经济体的经济增长影响。研究发现影响是不对称的：在希腊，可再生能源冲击会通过荷兰病机制和巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应降低GDP约0.46%，而在比利时影响很小。这表明负面影响主要源于结构性因素而非转型本身。
AI.research_question: 可再生能源转型是否支持竞争力不同的小型开放经济体的经济增长？
AI.motivation: 探讨能源转型对经济增长的影响，特别是在竞争力不同的经济体中，识别结构性因素在转型过程中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 荷兰病机制、巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应、小型开放经济体理论
AI.method: 使用希腊和比利时1990-2023年的年度数据，建立递归VAR模型，联合建模GDP、投资、进出口比率和可再生能源在电力供应中的份额，通过正交脉冲响应分析冲击的持续性。
AI.findings: 影响不对称：希腊的可再生能源冲击导致实际GDP累计下降约0.46%，而比利时的影响在经济上很小，围绕零波动。希腊的结果符合旅游驱动的荷兰病机制和巴拉萨-萨缪尔森渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了可再生能源转型对经济增长的影响机制，特别是通过荷兰病和巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应在竞争力较弱经济体中的负面作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：在推进能源转型时，需要首先解决深层次的结构性和竞争力扭曲，才能使绿色能源从制约转向支持经济增长。

title: European or American? A Re-examination of the Transatlantic Influence over the IMF
affiliations: , Beijing Foreign Studies University and Renmin University of China

detail.title: European or American? A Re-examination of the Transatlantic Influence over the IMF

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare none.
declarations.funderStatement: This research is not funded.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the United States or Europe holds greater influence over the International Monetary Fund (IMF)-a longstanding yet underexamined question in the study of global economic governance. While the Fund is widely regarded as dominated by "Western" powers, most existing research either focuses exclusively on American influence or treats the West as a unified bloc, masking important variation between its two key actors. Drawing on panel data from 1980 to 2010, we construct separate measures of US and European influence using principal component analysis of commonly used alignment indicators-UN voting patterns, bilateral trade, and banking exposure-and estimate a series of Tobit and Probit models to assess their impact on four key IMF lending outcomes: loan-to-GDP ratios, participation rates, loan approvals, and conditionality. We find that European influence is strongly associated with higher loan volumes, more frequent participation, and greater likelihood of loan approval, while US influence is not. However, American ties are significantly correlated with fewer conditions attached to loans. Additional analysis shows that European influence is not driven by regional or colonial favouritism: neither European nor African borrowers benefit more from European ties-and may, in fact, fare worse-than other countries with comparable alignment. These findings complicate existing assumptions about IMF decision-making, highlighting the need to distinguish between types of Western influence. They also suggest that Europe wields broader institutional influence over access to IMF resources, while US power manifests more selectively through conditionality. In doing so, the paper contributes to debates on hegemony, institutional power, and intra-Western dynamics in global economic governance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在国际货币基金组织（IMF）中，欧洲的影响力比美国更广泛，欧洲影响力与更高的贷款额度、更频繁的参与和更高的贷款批准率相关，而美国影响力主要体现在减少贷款附加条件方面。
AI.research_question: 美国还是欧洲对国际货币基金组织（IMF）拥有更大的影响力？
AI.motivation: 现有研究要么只关注美国影响力，要么将西方视为统一集团，掩盖了美国和欧洲这两个关键行为体之间的重要差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球治理、霸权理论、制度权力理论、西方内部动态分析
AI.method: 使用1980-2010年的面板数据，通过主成分分析构建美国和欧洲影响力的单独衡量指标（基于联合国投票模式、双边贸易和银行风险暴露），并采用Tobit和Probit模型评估对四个关键IMF贷款结果的影响。
AI.findings: 欧洲影响力与更高的贷款额度、更频繁的参与和更高的贷款批准率显著相关，而美国影响力与这些结果无关。但美国影响力与贷款附加条件较少显著相关。欧洲影响力并非由区域或殖民偏好驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 复杂化了关于IMF决策的现有假设，强调需要区分不同类型的西方影响力，为霸权、制度权力和西方内部动态的辩论做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示欧洲在获取IMF资源方面拥有更广泛的制度影响力，而美国权力更选择性地通过条件性体现，这对理解全球经济治理中的权力分配具有实际意义。

title: Analysis of the Keiki Watchers Survey using Independent Component Analysis and Linear Discriminant Analysis
affiliations: Mizuho-DL Financial Technology Co., Ltd., Mizuho-DL Financial Technology Co., Ltd. and Mizuho-DL Financial Technology Co., Ltd.

detail.title: Analysis of the Keiki Watchers Survey using Independent Component Analysis and Linear Discriminant Analysis
detail.abstract: The Keiki Watchers Survey, an economic trend survey conducted by the Japanese government, publishes evaluations of the current and future economic situation by people from various occupations, together with short textual justifications for their assessments. This study aims to quantitatively analyze the factors influencing these economic judgments. We first convert the Keiki Watchers Survey text data into numerical form using text embeddings. Since text embeddings are known to be difficult to interpret, in this study, to interpret the embeddings, we apply Independent Component Analysis (ICA) with Fisher's Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). By transforming the high-dimensional text-embedding data into interpretable low-dimensional representations, we investigate which economic elements contribute to people's economic assessments.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用文本嵌入和独立成分分析(ICA)结合Fisher线性判别分析(LDA)的方法，将日本景气观察者调查的文本数据转化为可解释的低维表示，分析影响人们经济判断的经济因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些经济因素影响人们对当前和未来经济形势的评估？
AI.motivation: 日本政府进行的景气观察者调查包含了各行各业人士对经济状况的评估及其文本理由，但文本数据难以直接进行定量分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文本嵌入技术、独立成分分析(ICA)、Fisher线性判别分析(LDA)、高维数据降维理论
AI.method: 首先将调查文本数据转换为文本嵌入数值形式，然后应用ICA结合LDA将高维文本嵌入数据转化为可解释的低维表示。
AI.findings: 通过降维方法成功识别出影响人们经济判断的关键经济要素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合ICA和LDA的文本嵌入解释方法，为文本数据的定量分析提供了新的技术路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和经济分析机构提供了理解公众经济判断形成机制的工具，有助于更准确地把握经济预期。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework for Reliable Renewable Energy Supply Forecasting
affiliations: Texas A&M International University, University of South Alabama, Southern University and A&M College, Angelo State University and University of Mississippi

detail.title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework for Reliable Renewable Energy Supply Forecasting
detail.abstract: Due to the inherent variability of renewable energy sources, predicting renewable energy production requires robust approaches and prediction methods that can detect and derive complex patterns. Since deep learning (DL) models can capture complex, nonlinear relationships, they are preferred over traditional machine learning (ML) methods in the renewable energy sector. An examination of the extant literature suggests the need for comprehensive studies on key factors influencing the accuracy of DL techniques in predicting renewable energy production. We aim to provide more insights in this area. In this study, we evaluate seven machine learning methods-Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Stacked LSTM, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), CNN-LSTM, Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), Time-Distributed Multilayer Perceptron (TD-MLP), and Autoencoder (AE)-using a dataset combining weather and photovoltaic power output data from 12 locations in Spain. Four regularization techniques-early stopping, neuron dropout, and Lasso and Ridge (L1/L2) regularization-are also applied to address the overfitting issue commonly seen in DL models. The evaluation results demonstrate that with a more extensive training set, the combination of early stopping, neuron dropout, and L1 regularization provides the best performance in reducing overfitting problems in CNN and TD-MLP models, whereas with a smaller training set, the combination of early stopping, neuron dropout, and L2 regularization is most effective in reducing the overfitting issue in CNN-LSTM and AE models.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了7种深度学习模型在可再生能源预测中的表现，发现在不同训练集规模下，特定的正则化技术组合能有效解决过拟合问题。
AI.research_question: 不同深度学习模型在可再生能源产量预测中的准确性如何？哪些正则化技术组合能最有效地解决过拟合问题？
AI.motivation: 由于可再生能源固有的变异性，需要强大的预测方法来检测和推导复杂模式。深度学习模型能捕捉复杂的非线性关系，在可再生能源领域优于传统机器学习方法。现有文献缺乏对影响深度学习技术准确性关键因素的综合研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习理论，特别是循环神经网络（LSTM）、卷积神经网络（CNN）和自编码器（AE）等模型在时间序列预测中的应用。
AI.method: 使用西班牙12个地点的天气和光伏发电输出数据集，评估7种机器学习方法：LSTM、堆叠LSTM、CNN、CNN-LSTM、DNN、TD-MLP和AE，并应用4种正则化技术：早停、神经元丢弃、Lasso和Ridge正则化。
AI.findings: 在更大训练集下，早停、神经元丢弃和L1正则化的组合在CNN和TD-MLP模型中表现最佳；在较小训练集下，早停、神经元丢弃和L2正则化的组合在CNN-LSTM和AE模型中效果最好。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于深度学习模型在可再生能源预测中正则化技术有效性的系统比较，揭示了不同训练集规模下最优正则化策略的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可再生能源行业提供了具体的模型选择和正则化策略建议，有助于提高预测准确性并减少过拟合问题。

title: The Chatbot That Got Away: Parasocial Breakups in the ChatGPT-4o to GPT-5 Shift
affiliations: University of South-Eastern Norway USN School of Business

detail.title: The Chatbot That Got Away: Parasocial Breakups in the ChatGPT-4o to GPT-5 Shift
detail.abstract: The sudden removal of ChatGPT-4o in August 2025 and its replacement with GPT-5 triggered not only technical complaints but also waves of grief, betrayal, and nostalgia among users. This paper argues that these reactions are best understood as a form of parasocial breakup-a rupture of one-sided but emotionally meaningful bonds formed with an AI persona. To capture this dynamic, we develop the concept of the affective contract: the implicit expectation that a chatbot's personality, tone, and responsiveness will remain stable over time. Drawing on literature in parasocial relationship theory, affective computing, and technology domestication, we interpret the GPT-4o to GPT-5 shift as a breach of this contract. Analysis of user discourse and media reporting shows how ChatGPT had been domesticated into everyday routines and treated as a companion as much as a tool. Its abrupt disappearance produced emotional fallout similar to the loss of a trusted friend. The case illustrates how AI updates can destabilize trust not just technically but relationally, and it underscores the need for design and governance strategies that recognize continuity, transparency, and emotional attachment as central to responsible AI development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了ChatGPT-4o被GPT-5突然取代引发的用户情感反应，将其理解为一种准社会关系破裂，并提出了情感契约概念来解释AI人格稳定性期望被违背的现象。
AI.research_question: 如何理解用户对ChatGPT-4o被GPT-5取代的情感反应？这些反应揭示了AI与用户关系的哪些本质特征？
AI.motivation: ChatGPT-4o在2025年8月突然被GPT-5取代，不仅引发了技术投诉，还引发了用户的悲伤、背叛和怀旧情绪，这些情感反应值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准社会关系理论、情感计算、技术驯化理论，以及本文提出的情感契约概念。
AI.method: 分析用户讨论和媒体报道，考察ChatGPT如何被驯化到日常例程中并被当作伴侣对待。
AI.findings: ChatGPT-4o的突然消失产生了类似失去可信朋友的情感后果，AI更新不仅从技术上破坏信任，也从关系上破坏信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了情感契约概念，扩展了准社会关系理论在AI领域的应用，深化了对AI与用户情感连接的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了在AI设计和治理中需要认识到连续性、透明度和情感依恋的重要性，为负责任的AI发展提供了策略建议。

title: Softening the Iron Cage: A Theory of Collusion and Adaptation in Bureaucracy
affiliations: Tsinghua University, University of Chicago, Department of Political Science and Peking University - National School of Development

detail.title: Softening the Iron Cage: A Theory of Collusion and Adaptation in Bureaucracy
detail.abstract: We explore how tolerance of vertical collusion stems from the need for adaptation in hierarchical organizations. In our simple model of a three-layer hierarchy, the supervisor recommends a project, the principal makes the decision, and the agent implements it. We embed side contracting in the decision process and allow the principal to costlessly regulate the possibility. We show that some scope for collusion can make supervisory activities more sensitive to local conditions, thereby facilitating adaptation. The principal confines-but never eliminates-the possibility of collusion, ensuring the negotiation between the subordinates adjusts to local conditions in a manner that perfectly serves the need for adaptation. Such deliberate tolerance imposes a limit on bureaucratization and also the number of supervisors in organizations. Given the hierarchical positions of the supervisor and the agent, the optimal scope for vertical collusion depends on who organizes the coalition. If neither subordinate holds all the bargaining power, the principal can never resolve the tension between decision-making and implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在层级组织中，对纵向合谋的容忍源于适应性的需要。通过一个三层层级模型，研究发现适度的合谋空间可以使监督活动更敏感于当地条件，从而促进适应性。委托人会限制但从不消除合谋可能性，确保下属间的谈判能完美服务于适应性需求。
AI.research_question: 层级组织中纵向合谋的容忍如何源于适应性的需要？
AI.motivation: 理解层级组织中合谋现象的存在原因及其对组织适应性的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 层级组织理论、合谋理论、适应性理论
AI.method: 构建三层层级模型（监督者-委托人-代理人），嵌入侧向契约，分析合谋对适应性的影响
AI.findings: 适度的合谋空间能提高监督活动对当地条件的敏感性，促进适应性；委托人会限制但不消除合谋；最优合谋范围取决于谁组织联盟
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了合谋容忍的适应性解释框架，深化了对层级组织中合谋现象的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计提供了指导：限制官僚化程度和监管者数量，平衡决策与执行的张力

reference: The Pinochet Shock (eds. F. González and M. Prem) Springer
title: The Contraction of Higher Education in the Early Years of the Pinochet Regime

detail.title: The Contraction of Higher Education in the Early Years of the Pinochet Regime

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Pinochet Shock (eds. F. González and M. Prem) Springer

detail.abstract: This chapter studies the changes to higher education that took place in Chile during the early years of the Pinochet dictatorship. I provide a historical background of the system of higher education in Chile, focusing in particular on the governments of Eduardo Frei Montalva (1964-1970) and Salvador Allende (1970-1973). I then discuss the changes in policy introduced by the military regime during the period 1973-1980, emphasizing its connection to the political and economic goals of the regime and to the views of its most important policy-makers, the Chicago Boys. Finally, I summarize the findings from a recent empirical literature documenting the economic and political effects of this contraction in higher education and its lasting legacy until the present day.

AI.tldr: 本章研究智利皮诺切特独裁政权早期对高等教育体系的变革，分析其历史背景、政策变化及其经济政治影响。
AI.research_question: 皮诺切特独裁政权早期（1973-1980年）如何改革智利高等教育体系？这些改革与政权政治经济目标及芝加哥学派政策制定者的观点有何关联？
AI.motivation: 理解智利高等教育在独裁时期的根本性变革，及其对当代智利社会经济的持久影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义、政策变迁理论、芝加哥学派经济学理论
AI.method: 历史分析、文献综述、实证研究总结
AI.findings: 军政府时期高等教育经历了显著收缩和市场化改革，这些改革与政权的政治控制和经济自由化目标密切相关，芝加哥学派在其中发挥了关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了威权政权下高等教育改革的动力机制，展示了意识形态与经济政策在教育改革中的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解智利当代高等教育体系的历史根源提供重要视角，对发展中国家教育改革具有警示意义。

title: Allowing Generative AI in Class: Evidence from a Semester-Long Controlled Teaching Study
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Amherst, University of Massachusetts Amherst and University of Massachusetts Amherst

detail.title: Allowing Generative AI in Class: Evidence from a Semester-Long Controlled Teaching Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None to be declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted under IRB approval from UMass Amherst.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable.

detail.abstract: We report a controlled, semester-long teaching experiment in an upper-division antitrust economics course. Two back-to-back sections were held constant in content, assessment, and grading; they differed only in policy and guidance on generative AI: one section was permitted to use AI with disclosure and structured training, the other was prohibited from using AI and received parallel non-AI study guidance (n = 29 vs. n = 28). We find no detectable effect of AI permission on proctored exam scores or final grades. By contrast, AI access is associated with higher engagement on in-class activities, longer and more concentrated AI sessions in other courses (15-30 minutes), greater metacognitive behaviors (preferring one's own answers, catching errors, modifying outputs), more positive perceptions-especially regarding efficiency, confidence, and engagement-and stronger intentions to continue using and studying AI, as well as choosing AI-intensive careers. Standardized course evaluations are also consistently higher in the AI section. Taken together, structured AI access with guardrails appears, in our setting, to reshape how students learn and feel about learning, without raising exam scores.

AI.tldr: 在反垄断经济学课程中进行的教学实验发现，允许使用AI（需披露和结构化训练）与禁止使用AI的两个班级在考试成绩和最终成绩上没有显著差异，但AI使用提高了课堂参与度、学习行为质量、对AI的积极认知以及继续使用AI的意愿。
AI.research_question: 在高等教育环境中，允许学生使用生成式AI对学习成果、学习行为和态度有什么影响？
AI.motivation: 了解AI在教育环境中的实际效果，为教育机构制定AI使用政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育技术采纳理论、学习行为理论、元认知理论
AI.method: 控制实验设计，两个平行班级（n=29 vs n=28），内容、评估和评分标准相同，仅AI使用政策不同
AI.findings: 1) AI使用对考试成绩无显著影响；2) AI使用提高课堂参与度；3) AI使用促进更长的专注学习时段；4) 增强元认知行为；5) 改善学习态度和效率认知；6) 提高课程评价分数
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI在教育中实际效果的实证证据，挑战了AI必然提高考试成绩的假设，强调AI对学习过程而非结果的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构制定AI使用政策提供指导，建议采用有监管的结构化AI使用方式，关注AI对学习行为和态度的影响

title: Timing Indian Equity Factors: Structural vs. Revaluation Signals
affiliations: Invespar Pte Ltd

detail.title: Timing Indian Equity Factors: Structural vs. Revaluation Signals
detail.abstract: We examine Indian equity factor premia using the structural-revaluation decomposition of Arnott, Ehsani, Harvey and Shakernia (2025), applied to Fama-French style portfolios (value, size, profitability, investment) and momentum over 2004-2025 with the Invespar Indian factor library. Factor returns are separated into a structural component linked to fundamentals via price-to-book and a revaluation component reflecting valuation spread changes. Long-run premia are predominantly structural: Value, size, and momentum show persistent structural means, while revaluation averages to zero but contributes substantially to volatility and is strongly negatively correlated with structure. Predictive regressions and out-of-sample tests indicate limited timing ability, with only momentum at the 12-month horizon showing significance and forecast-error gains below economic thresholds. Robustness checks (alternative anchors, weighting schemes, sub-periods) confirm the results.

AI.tldr: 本文使用Arnott等人(2025)的结构重估分解方法分析印度股票因子溢价，发现长期溢价主要来自结构性成分，重估成分贡献波动性但均值为零，且预测能力有限。
AI.research_question: 印度股票因子溢价的结构性和重估成分如何分解？这些成分对因子表现的贡献及其可预测性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解因子溢价来源对投资策略至关重要，传统方法无法区分结构性收益和估值变化带来的收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: Arnott等人(2025)的结构重估分解理论，Fama-French因子模型，动量因子理论
AI.method: 使用Invespar印度因子库数据(2004-2025)，构建Fama-French风格投资组合，应用结构重估分解方法，进行预测回归和样本外测试
AI.findings: 长期因子溢价主要来自结构性成分，重估成分均值为零但贡献显著波动性，且与结构性成分负相关；预测能力有限，仅动量因子在12个月期有显著预测性
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了结构重估分解理论在印度市场的适用性，深化了对因子溢价来源的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度市场因子投资提供实证依据，表明因子择时策略效果有限，长期结构性投资更可靠

title: Use of Currencies Other than the Dollar for International Trade and its Impact on World Economy in the Context of the Russia-Ukraine War
affiliations: Gujarat National Law University and Gujarat National Law University

detail.title: Use of Currencies Other than the Dollar for International Trade and its Impact on World Economy in the Context of the Russia-Ukraine War
detail.abstract: This research paper examines the impact of the use of alternate currencies to the dollar in international trade and its impact a world economy dominated by the dollar and trade patterns of different countries in context of the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war. The paper looks at Russia as well as other related countries and their use of alternate currencies for conducting trade. The effectiveness of the sanctions in place on Russia, placed by the EU and the US, are also looked. In the literary review, we give a background about the current dominance of the dollar as an international currency and theoretical argument about the impact of dollar’s absence from world trade. For the analysis, secondary data from news sources and international reports was collected and it is used to perform a descriptive analysis to answer the research questions asked in the paper. The paper also looks at the recent trends that may present challenge to the dominant status of the dollar in the long run. It also provides for future research areas using statical models to gain further insight into the topic.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在俄乌战争背景下，替代美元货币在国际贸易中的使用对美元主导的世界经济和各国贸易模式的影响，分析俄罗斯及相关国家使用替代货币进行贸易的情况，评估欧美对俄制裁的有效性。
AI.research_question: 替代美元货币在国际贸易中的使用如何影响美元主导的世界经济格局和各国贸易模式？
AI.motivation: 俄乌战争背景下，各国寻求替代美元货币进行贸易，这为研究美元主导地位面临的挑战提供了现实背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美元作为国际货币的当前主导地位理论，以及美元缺席世界贸易影响的理论论证。
AI.method: 收集新闻来源和国际报告的二手数据，进行描述性分析。
AI.findings: 分析了俄罗斯及相关国家使用替代货币进行贸易的现状，评估了欧美对俄制裁的有效性，识别了可能挑战美元长期主导地位的近期趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了美元主导地位面临挑战的实证证据，丰富了国际货币体系演变的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于美元替代货币使用趋势的实践洞察，为未来使用统计模型进行深入研究指明了方向。

title: Labor Supply Responses to Tax Credit Disbursements: Evidence from the EITC Schedule *
affiliations: University of Nevada, Las Vegas

detail.title: Labor Supply Responses to Tax Credit Disbursements: Evidence from the EITC Schedule *
detail.abstract: The Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) schedule and lump-sum disbursement can create significant labor supply responses. I estimate labor supply responses to tax credit disbursements using a regression kink design. Among single workers, credits increase labor supply around the time that tax credits are disbursed at the first and second kinks in the EITC schedule but reduce labor supply on the intensive margin at the third kink. There is some evidence of heterogeneous responses among married women, including an increase in labor supply near the third kink, although findings in the sample of married women appear less robust.

AI.tldr: 本文使用回归断点设计估计了劳动供给对税收抵免支付的响应。研究发现，单身工人在EITC计划的第一和第二拐点处劳动供给增加，但在第三拐点处劳动供给减少。已婚女性的响应存在异质性，但结果不太稳健。
AI.research_question: 税收抵免支付如何影响不同群体的劳动供给？
AI.motivation: EITC计划和一次性支付可能对劳动供给产生显著影响，需要实证研究来理解这些效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动供给理论、税收激励理论、EITC计划设计理论
AI.method: 回归断点设计（Regression Kink Design）
AI.findings: 单身工人在EITC第一和第二拐点处劳动供给增加，第三拐点处减少；已婚女性响应存在异质性但结果不稳健
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对税收抵免支付影响劳动供给机制的理解，特别是不同拐点处的异质性效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为EITC政策优化提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者更好地设计税收抵免计划

title: Cross-Task Spillover Effects of PCAOB Inspections
affiliations: Tulane University - A.B. Freeman School of Business, Tulane University - Accounting & Taxation and University of Alberta - Department of Accounting, Operations &  Information Systems

detail.title: Cross-Task Spillover Effects of PCAOB Inspections
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board's (PCAOB) inspection focus in one audit area enhances or undermines auditor performance in another area within the same engagement. We examine property and casualty (P&C) insurance audits, where two judgment-intensive tasks-fair value estimation of investment securities (FVEIS) and loss reserve (LR) estimation-coexist but face unequal PCAOB scrutiny. While both tasks share similar estimation techniques and auditing standards, prior commentary suggests inspectors disproportionately emphasize FVEIS, potentially diverting attention away from the LR, which poses greater misstatement risk. Using PCAOB inspection reports and statutory filings from 2011 to 2019, we measure PCAOB emphasis as the intensity of deficiencies in FVEIS and assess spillover effects on subsequent LR audit accuracy. Consistent with the distraction hypothesis, we find that greater PCAOB emphasis on FVEIS leads to lower accuracy of LR estimates for public insurers, with a one-standard-deviation increase in FVEIS deficiency intensity associated with an 11% rise in LR errors relative to the mean. No such effect appears for private insurers, validating our identification strategy. Further, we show that the distraction effect weakens when FVEIS are more material or more difficult to audit, suggesting that PCAOB's misplaced focus is most costly when less justified by underlying risks. We find little evidence of focal benefits for FVEIS, underscoring a potential misallocation of regulatory attention. Our study is particularly timely given the current political debate regarding the effectiveness of the PCAOB.

AI.tldr: PCAOB对投资证券公允价值评估的监管重点会分散审计师对损失准备金评估的注意力，导致后者的审计准确性下降，这种监管注意力错配在风险较低时成本最高。
AI.research_question: PCAOB在一个审计领域的检查重点是否会增强或削弱审计师在同一业务中另一领域的表现？
AI.motivation: PCAOB检查人员不成比例地强调投资证券公允价值评估，可能分散对风险更大的损失准备金评估的注意力，存在监管注意力错配问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分心假说 - 监管资源有限时，对某一领域的过度关注会分散对其他重要领域的注意力
AI.method: 使用2011-2019年PCAOB检查报告和法定文件，测量FVEIS缺陷强度作为PCAOB重点指标，评估对后续LR审计准确性的溢出效应
AI.findings: PCAOB对FVEIS的更大关注导致公共保险公司LR估计准确性降低，FVEIS缺陷强度增加一个标准差与LR错误相对于均值增加11%相关；私人保险公司无此效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了监管注意力错配的经验证据，支持分心假说，揭示了监管重点可能产生的负面溢出效应
AI.practical_contributions: 对PCAOB监管有效性的政策辩论提供实证依据，建议监管重点应与实际风险相匹配，避免注意力错配

title: Consultation on the 2025 Review of the Digital Markets Act (DMA)
affiliations: University of Exeter - School of Law, Heinrich Heine University Dusseldorf - Faculty of Law, , , Heinrich-Heine-University Düsseldorf and Tilburg University

detail.title: Consultation on the 2025 Review of the Digital Markets Act (DMA)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: According to the Disclosure and Transparency Rules of ASCOLA, the Academic Society for Competition Law, the authors have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: Our independent research project is funded by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG) and the UK Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC).

detail.abstract:
In many respects, the Digital Markets Act (DMA) is a remarkable success story. It was enacted in a relatively short period of time, showing the commitment of the European institutions to safeguard a digital environment that is not built on dependencies and exploitation. The DMA is also characterised by innovative features, such as market investigations, compliance mechanisms, quantitative thresholds for designation and time limits for proceedings. Overall, the SCiDA team's assessment of the legislative piece of work and the first years of application is positive. The Commission has shown that it can bring about some change in this field. Private enforcement also seems to pick up, which is a necessary addition to Commission enforcement.

Having said that, we wish to point out three aspects of the DMA in general:

Firstly, enforcement hinges very much on the willingness of the European Commission to allocate resources and to lead the legal cases with determination. The Commission, as the sole enforcer, must not falter. To reduce the risk of weaker enforcement on the European level, it is important to strengthen private enforcement and the involvement of national competition agencies.

Secondly, while the Commission has relied on non-confrontational negotiation to push gatekeepers towards improving their compliance approaches, this method is inherently limited. Effective enforcement is driven by stakeholder engagement, not by negotiations with the digital gatekeepers. Business users, consumers and (potential) competitors need a strong say.

Thirdly, shaping competition in the digital age is a journey, not a one-off result of enforcement. The Commission is on a search process, taking one step after the other. Compliance with the DMA should therefore be seen as an ongoing process that is coming ever closer to the desired outcomes, not something that is fixed with just a handful of proceedings.

AI.tldr: 欧盟《数字市场法案》(DMA)在立法和执行方面总体成功，但存在三个关键问题：执法依赖欧盟委员会的资源投入和决心；非对抗性谈判方法存在局限；数字竞争塑造是一个持续过程而非一次性结果。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《数字市场法案》(DMA)的实施效果如何？存在哪些关键挑战？
AI.motivation: 评估DMA这一重要数字监管立法的实际执行情况，识别其在执法机制、执行方法和长期效果方面的潜在问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字市场监管理论、执法机制理论、公私协同治理理论
AI.method: 基于SCiDA团队对DMA立法工作和前几年应用情况的评估分析
AI.findings: 1) DMA在立法速度、创新特征方面表现良好；2) 执法过度依赖欧盟委员会的资源分配和决心；3) 非对抗性谈判方法存在固有局限；4) 数字竞争塑造是一个持续过程
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字市场监管中执法资源依赖、谈判方法局限性和长期过程性等理论观点
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强私人执法和国家竞争机构参与，强调利益相关者参与的重要性，将合规视为持续过程而非一次性结果

title: Barriers To Efficient Carbon Pricing: Policy Risk, Myopic Behaviour, And Financial Constraints
affiliations: KU Leuven, KU Leuven, Delft University of Technology and KU Leuven

detail.title: Barriers To Efficient Carbon Pricing: Policy Risk, Myopic Behaviour, And Financial Constraints

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The work is supported by the FPS Economy, Belgium, under the Energy Transition Fund project REINVENT.

detail.abstract: We investigate the limitations of cap-and-trade systems as a tool for driving investments in lowcarbon industrial technologies. Investments may be delayed, and suboptimal technology choice may result from myopic behaviour, financial constraints, and policy risk. We develop a partial equilibrium model that explicitly incorporates such imperfect behaviour in cap-and-trade systems. We evaluate how these imperfections influence the carbon price signal and their subsequent impact on irreversible investment decisions of industries. We find that such imperfections can distort carbon price trajectories, leading to suboptimal technology choice and delayed investments in lowcarbon technologies. Vice versa, imperfect behaviour of investors due to other external factors may influence the carbon price trajectory if the group of affected agents is sufficiently large to influence carbon prices. The results indicate a need for complementary policy instruments to address these carbon market imperfections. To better align model outcomes with the reality of carbon markets, we advocate that modellers use techniques that capture imperfect market behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了总量管制与交易系统在推动低碳工业技术投资方面的局限性，发现短视行为、财务约束和政策风险可能导致投资延迟和次优技术选择。通过建立包含不完全行为的局部均衡模型，研究发现这些不完善会扭曲碳价轨迹，进而影响低碳技术投资决策。
AI.research_question: 总量管制与交易系统中的不完善行为如何影响碳价信号和低碳技术投资决策？
AI.motivation: 现有模型往往假设理性行为，但现实中投资者存在短视行为、财务约束和政策风险等不完善行为，这些可能影响碳市场的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和投资理论，构建包含不完善行为的局部均衡模型，分析碳市场中的投资决策动态。
AI.method: 开发部分均衡模型，明确纳入短视行为、财务约束和政策风险等不完善行为因素。
AI.findings: 不完善行为会扭曲碳价轨迹，导致次优技术选择和低碳技术投资延迟；反之，投资者的不完善行为也可能影响碳价轨迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在碳市场模型中系统纳入不完善行为，揭示了行为因素对碳价和投资决策的重要影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出需要补充政策工具来解决碳市场不完善问题，建议建模者采用能捕捉不完善市场行为的技术。

title: Systemic Cyber Risk: Linking Measurement, Market Incentives, and Policy
affiliations: Stanford Graduate School of Business, Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR) and University of Tulsa - Tandy School of Computer Science

detail.title: Systemic Cyber Risk: Linking Measurement, Market Incentives, and Policy

declarations.funderStatement: Gandal and Moore gratefully acknowledge support from the US National Science Foundation (NSF) Award No. 2147505 and Award No. 2452738 and the US Israel Binational Science Foundation (BSF) Award No. 2016622 and Award No. 2021711.

detail.abstract: Few would dispute that systemic (catastrophic) cyber risk is a very serious problem for the global economy and for society, and that catastrophic failures with very serious consequences are likely, with recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) only magnifying the ability of attackers to breach our defenses. However, there is a "disconnect" between a high-level acknowledgment of the problem and actions taken by firms and policymakers to address the problem. In this paper, we develop a more nuanced framework that shines a spotlight on the forces behind the lack of action as well as on key areas of focus for policy, areas where the societal benefits to action are greatest and areas where we might better harness economic incentives to improve outcomes. By "shaping" markets using incentives, carefully crafted regulatory frameworks, and the provision of digital public goods, policy makers can channel market forces and better align incentives to get substantially better cybersecurity outcomes while simultaneously reducing entry barriers for firms in the cybersecurity sector, firms in the defense sector, and in industry more broadly.
