title: Economic integration in the XXI century

detail.title: Economic integration in the XXI century
detail.abstract:
The study carried out a historical analysis of international cooperation, which revealed a constant need for the economic expansion to new regions. It was proved that since the end of the 19th century, there has been a tendency to abandon violent expansion in favor of international cooperation, which is beneficial not so much due to military-political factors as due to building an effective system of economic penetration into new markets and mutual dependence. The paper examines in detail the differences between integration and close international economic cooperation. It has been established that economic cooperation develops into integration only when regional ties become comparable in importance to national ones. 

An analysis of the practice of international cooperation within the framework of existing integration associations (EU, MERCOSUR, APEC, ASEAN, EAEU, etc.) revealed an increase in attention to the issues of economic security of the integrating countries. This is especially clearly demonstrated by the official documents of the USMCA and the initiatives being implemented within the framework of the SCO. It was found that after the triumph of the ideas of economic integration in the second half of the twentieth century, the ideas of protecting own national interests are more in demand today. In scientific discourse, this concept is commonly referred to as Homeland Economics.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过历史分析发现，19世纪末以来国际扩张方式从暴力转向合作，经济合作发展为整合需要区域联系重要性达到国家级别。分析现有整合组织实践显示，经济安全议题日益重要，体现了从经济整合向保护国家利益（国土经济学）的转变。
AI.research_question: 国际合作的演变趋势是什么？经济合作如何发展为整合？当前国际合作中经济安全议题的重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解国际合作从暴力扩张向经济合作的转变过程，以及当前国际合作中经济安全议题的兴起。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际合作理论、经济整合理论、国土经济学（Homeland Economics）
AI.method: 历史分析、现有整合组织（欧盟、南方共同市场、亚太经合组织、东盟、欧亚经济联盟等）的实践分析
AI.findings: 1. 19世纪末以来放弃暴力扩张转向国际合作；2. 经济合作发展为整合需要区域联系重要性达到国家级别；3. 当前国际合作中经济安全议题日益重要；4. 从经济整合理念转向保护国家利益的国土经济学概念
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了经济合作与整合的区别标准；2. 提出了国际合作从经济整合向国土经济学的理论转变；3. 丰富了国际合作理论的发展脉络
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国际合作政策制定提供历史经验；2. 为各国在国际合作中平衡经济整合与国家利益提供参考；3. 帮助理解当前国际合作中经济安全议题的重要性

title: Managing Competing Demands: Coping With the Inclusiveness–Efficiency Paradox in Cross-Sector Partnerships
affiliations: Radboud University Nijmegen, Copenhagen Business School and University of Witten/Herdecke

detail.title: Managing Competing Demands: Coping With the Inclusiveness–Efficiency Paradox in Cross-Sector Partnerships
detail.abstract: This article discusses how cross-sector partnerships (CSPs) for sustainability manage the paradoxical tension between stakeholder inclusiveness and administrative efficiency. Drawing on qualitative data from a case study of a CSP focused on urban sustainability, we show how the inclusiveness–efficiency paradox unfolded throughout the studied collaboration. We discuss how the paradox reemerged in a different guise within each phase of the partnership and how three practices of paradox management helped actors to cope with the tension: “customized inviting” (during the formation phase), “sequential including” (during the preparation phase), and “tailored instructing” (during the implementation phase). On the basis of these findings, we argue that (a) the paradox reoccurred throughout the phases of the CSP because the three paradox management practices accentuated boundaries, thereby helping to resolve the paradox temporarily while at the same time creating grounds for the paradox to resurface, and (b) that the three paradox management practices can be theorized as a special type of boundary work that “plays up” relevant differences between actor groups and thereby ensures collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了可持续性跨部门合作(CSPs)如何管理利益相关者包容性与行政效率之间的悖论张力。通过城市可持续性CSP案例研究，展示了包容-效率悖论如何在合作过程中展开，并识别了三种悖论管理实践：定制邀请(形成阶段)、顺序包含(准备阶段)和定制指导(实施阶段)。研究发现这些边界工作实践暂时解决悖论的同时也为悖论重现创造了条件。
AI.research_question: 可持续性跨部门合作(CSPs)如何管理利益相关者包容性与行政效率之间的悖论张力？
AI.motivation: 跨部门合作面临既要广泛包容利益相关者又要保持行政效率的矛盾需求，这种包容-效率悖论在可持续性合作中尤为突出，需要深入理解其动态管理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 悖论理论、边界工作理论、跨部门合作理论
AI.method: 定性案例研究，基于城市可持续性跨部门合作的数据
AI.findings: 包容-效率悖论在合作各阶段以不同形式重现；三种悖论管理实践(定制邀请、顺序包含、定制指导)通过强调边界暂时解决悖论，但也为悖论重现创造条件；这些实践可理论化为一种特殊的边界工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 将悖论管理实践理论化为边界工作；揭示了悖论在合作过程中的动态重现机制；深化了对跨部门合作中悖论管理的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨部门合作管理者提供了具体的悖论管理实践指导；帮助合作组织更好地平衡包容性与效率需求；为可持续性合作的设计和实施提供实践启示。

title: A Contextual Note on the Contribution of Bourdieu’s Theory to Social Development
affiliations: Gandhigram Rural Institute

detail.title: A Contextual Note on the Contribution of Bourdieu’s Theory to Social Development
detail.abstract: The Bourdieu's theory uniquely demonstrates the three pillars, namely Habitus, Capital, and Field, with their interrelationships , and how they impact on social development. In this context, this paper objectively attempts to structure a mind-map in relation to livelihood, social cohesion, and poverty, by citing a possible postwar situation in general. Indicatively, this paper explores the key concepts such as development and its various types, relational aspects of development, civil war, postwar development, livelihoods, social cohesion, poverty, culture, habitus, and the field. This paper effectively highlights the major development-oriented core aspects and variables within a postwar situation, and presents a potential mind-map for future studies, in consideration of Bourdieu's theory as the most suitable framework for exploring their relationships.

title: Macroprudential Policy, Household Credit and House Prices
affiliations: VU University Amsterdam, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics and VU University Amsterdam

detail.title: Macroprudential Policy, Household Credit and House Prices
detail.abstract: The paper looks at how changes in credit availability affect house prices. It finds that when lending standards are relaxed, household credit increases, which leads to higher transaction prices, more overbidding (both in number and amount), and faster property sales. As the housing boom progresses, the effect on prices grows because more households take on credit. The impact is especially strong in areas with limited housing supply and low affordability, among buyers who have limited cash but can still access credit, and for more expensive homes. These results support the idea that household demand is driven by credit, and they show that macroprudential policy helps manage systemic risk not only by lowering household debt, but also by slowing house price growth during the economic cycle.

title: Lights Out, Crime Up? Evidence from National Power Outages Data
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology

detail.title: Lights Out, Crime Up? Evidence from National Power Outages Data
detail.abstract: Power outages affect the average US electric customer for eight hours annually. Despite their effects on ambient light and routine activities, no research has identified their effects on public safety. This paper provides the first national-level evidence of power outages' effects on crime using high-resolution outage and crime data from 2018-2023. Exploiting county-day variation in outages and including high-dimensional fixed effects, I find outages increase theft by 0.71%, while reducing assault by 0.72%. This asymmetry reflects mobility shifts in response to outages where residents leave their homes, creating opportunities for property crime while reducing chances of domestic violence.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供了全国层面的证据，显示停电对犯罪的影响：停电使盗窃增加0.71%，同时使袭击减少0.72%。这种不对称性反映了居民在停电期间离开住所的流动性变化，创造了财产犯罪机会，同时减少了家庭暴力机会。

title: Belief Elicitation as Behavioral Design: Forecasting Others' Actions Reduces Moral Wiggle Room
affiliations: University of California, Merced - Department of Economics

detail.title: Belief Elicitation as Behavioral Design: Forecasting Others' Actions Reduces Moral Wiggle Room
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether eliciting beliefs about others' behavior can reduce the use of moral wiggle room-the justifications that allow individuals to act selfishly while maintaining a positive self-image. Across two incentivized experiments, a moral wiggle room game and a dice-rolling task, belief elicitation reduced information avoidance, dishonesty, and opportunistic behavior. While participants often reported self-serving beliefs after acting selfishly, their appropriateness evaluations remained unchanged, suggesting that belief elicitation does not correct biased expectations but instead preempts their formation by activating latent social norms-contrary to Bayesian models of belief updating. By heightening social image concerns at the moment of choice, belief elicitation constrains moral wiggle room and shifts behavior toward prosocial outcomes. These findings clarify how norms influence ethical decision-making and position belief elicitation as a scalable, low-cost behavioral design tool for curbing opportunism where monitoring is limited.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，通过引导个体表达对他人行为的信念，可以有效减少道德回避行为（即允许个体自私行事同时保持积极自我形象的借口）。在两个激励实验中，信念引导减少了信息回避、不诚实和机会主义行为。
AI.research_question: 引导个体表达对他人行为的信念是否能减少道德回避行为的使用？
AI.motivation: 理解如何减少个体利用道德借口来合理化自私行为，同时保持积极自我形象的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德回避理论、社会规范理论、贝叶斯信念更新模型
AI.method: 两个激励实验：道德回避游戏和掷骰子任务，采用信念引导干预
AI.findings: 信念引导减少了信息回避、不诚实和机会主义行为；参与者自私行为后仍报告自我服务的信念，但适当性评价未改变；信念引导通过激活潜在社会规范而非纠正偏见预期来发挥作用

title: "FOOD FOR PEACE?" CAMBODIA'S 1970S DEBTS TO THE UNITED STATES
affiliations: University of North Carolina School of Law, University of Virginia School of Law and Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies (IHEID) - Department of Economics

detail.title: "FOOD FOR PEACE?" CAMBODIA'S 1970S DEBTS TO THE UNITED STATES

publicationDetails.detailsText: UNC Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of North Carolina Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This is the story of three loans that were made by the United States in the 1970s, under the Food for Peace program, to the embattled Lon Nol regime in Cambodia. Cambodia has since argued the loans were tainted by the United States' bombardment of Cambodian territory and support for Lon Nol's illegitimate regime. It has refused to pay, invoking the international law doctrine of odious debt, asserting the right to disavow this "dirty" debt. The United States, by contrast, maintains that no such legal doctrine exists and that Cambodia must first acknowledge the obligation and begin repayment before any modification can be discussed. Despite this insistence, the United States has never attempted to enforce its claims. The result has been a stalemate, which for many years neither side seemed eager to resolve. In mid 2025 though, a confluence of events has raised the possibility of a shift in the impasse. This case offers an opportunity to test the boundaries of legal doctrines like odious debt and war debt. Mostly, we just think this is a fascinating story.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国在1970年代向柬埔寨朗诺政权提供的三笔贷款，探讨了柬埔寨以"可憎债务"为由拒绝偿还的法律争议，以及2025年僵局可能被打破的前景。
AI.research_question: 美国在1970年代向柬埔寨朗诺政权提供的贷款是否构成可憎债务？这些贷款的法律地位和偿还义务如何？
AI.motivation: 柬埔寨声称这些贷款因美国轰炸柬埔寨领土和支持朗诺非法政权而受到污染，拒绝偿还；美国则坚持要求柬埔寨承认债务义务。这一法律僵局为检验可憎债务和战争债务等法律学说的边界提供了机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法中的可憎债务学说、战争债务理论、国家责任原则
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过具体的历史贷款案例来检验法律学说的适用性
AI.findings: 柬埔寨以可憎债务为由拒绝偿还贷款，美国坚持要求承认债务义务但从未强制执行，双方陷入长期僵局；2025年可能出现转机
AI.theory_contributions: 为可憎债务和战争债务等国际法理论提供了实证检验案例，探讨了这些学说在实践中的适用边界
AI.practical_contributions: 为类似国际债务纠纷提供参考，有助于理解国家在政权更迭后对前政权债务的责任问题

title: Innovations and Enterprises Performance in Transition Countries, with Special Emphasis on Kosovo: CDM Model Approach
affiliations: University of Kadri Zeka, AAB College and

detail.title: Innovations and Enterprises Performance in Transition Countries, with Special Emphasis on Kosovo: CDM Model Approach
detail.abstract: The main aim of this study is to analyze the impact of innovation and enterprise performance in the transition countries with special emphasis in the case of Kosovo. The innovations play a crucial impact on firm development, especially for small and medium-sized enterprises in countries in transition. This study uses primary data with a specific sample thus the enterprises that operate in Kosovo in order to analyze the relationship between innovations and firm performance. This study was conducted within a six-month period, specifically January 2022-June 2022. The research sample consists of 400 Kosovar enterprises. These enterprises are from different economic sectors, such as production, services, and in terms of size, 80% of them are SMEs. The study used the CDM (Crépon, Duguet and Mairesse) model which includes the fourth phase. The first phase of this model is about the tendencies of enterprises to carry out innovative activities, the second phase is about the enterprises that invested in research and development, the third stage of the model, the conversion of inputs into outputs is analyzed. In the end, the impact of innovation outputs on the performance of the analyzed enterprises is investigated. The study concludes that enterprises that export to the EU and the Western Balkans region are significant, so this positively affects the tendencies of these enterprises for innovative activities, whereas enterprises that are oriented only to the local market, do not present significance and even have a negative relationship with the enterprises' tendencies for innovations. A large part of the enterprises think that innovations have high costs and are even unaffordable therefore this represents a big obstacle for the development of innovations. The lack of qualified personnel and the lack of knowledge about markets and technology represent a big obstacle to the development of innovations, and it even negatively affects the decisions of these enterprises about innovations.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了创新对企业绩效的影响，特别关注科索沃的转型国家案例。研究发现，出口到欧盟和西巴尔干地区的企业对创新活动有显著积极影响，而仅面向本地市场的企业则与创新倾向呈负相关。创新成本高、缺乏合格人员以及市场和技术知识不足是创新发展的主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 创新对转型国家（特别是科索沃）企业绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 创新在企业发展中起着关键作用，特别是对于转型国家的中小企业而言。科索沃作为转型国家的案例具有特殊研究价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用CDM（Crépon, Duguet and Mairesse）四阶段模型：1）企业进行创新活动的倾向；2）企业研发投资；3）投入转化为产出；4）创新产出对企业绩效的影响。
AI.method: 使用2022年1月至6月收集的400家科索沃企业的原始数据，涵盖生产和服务等不同经济部门，其中80%为中小企业。
AI.findings: 出口到欧盟和西巴尔干地区的企业对创新活动有显著积极影响；仅面向本地市场的企业与创新倾向呈负相关；创新成本高、缺乏合格人员以及市场和技术知识不足是主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了CDM模型在转型国家背景下的适用性，深化了对出口导向与创新倾向关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃及其他转型国家的政策制定者提供了关于如何促进企业创新的具体建议，特别是针对出口导向和人才培养方面。

title: How do Developing Country Governments Finance Healthcare while Respecting Fiscal Constraints?

detail.title: How do Developing Country Governments Finance Healthcare while Respecting Fiscal Constraints?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based on secondary data and publicly available sources only.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Developing countries often face a big challenge: how to expand access to good quality healthcare while also working with very limited budgets. The purpose of this paper is to look at how governments can finance healthcare without creating fiscal problems. To do this, I use a comparative analysis of four countries: Rwanda, Ghana, Thailand, and Mexico. The study is based on the idea of "fiscal space for health" and the three main functions of health financing: revenue collection, pooling of risks, and purchasing of services. In this work, I review traditional methods such as taxation, social health insurance, and out-of-pocket payments, and I also look at more innovative solutions like "sin" taxes, public-private partnerships, external aid, debt swaps, and digital financial inclusion. The results suggest that no single method is enough by itself. Instead, success depends on combining several strategies, such as expanding the tax base while protecting the poor, improving pooling to avoid catastrophic payments, and strengthening governance to make health spending more efficient. The paper concludes by showing that financing healthcare in developing countries is not only an economic problem but also a political one, and that sustainable solutions must be adapted to each country's context.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较卢旺达、加纳、泰国和墨西哥四个国家的案例，探讨发展中国家如何在预算有限的情况下为医疗保健融资而不引发财政问题。研究发现单一融资方法不足，成功需要结合多种策略，包括扩大税基、改善风险池、加强治理等，并强调医疗融资既是经济问题也是政治问题。
AI.research_question: 政府如何在预算有限的情况下为医疗保健融资而不引发财政问题？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家面临扩大优质医疗服务覆盖范围与有限预算之间的挑战
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"医疗财政空间"概念和医疗融资三大功能：收入筹集、风险池化和服务购买
AI.method: 对卢旺达、加纳、泰国和墨西哥四个国家进行比较分析
AI.findings: 单一融资方法不足，成功需要结合多种策略，包括扩大税基同时保护贫困人口、改善风险池化以避免灾难性支付、加强治理以提高医疗支出效率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出医疗融资不仅是经济问题也是政治问题，可持续解决方案必须适应各国具体国情
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供了具体的医疗融资策略组合，包括传统方法（税收、社会医疗保险、自付费用）和创新方案（罪恶税、公私合作、外部援助、债务互换、数字金融包容）

title: Transforming Traditional Business into Online: The Impact of Covid-19 Pandemic on Consumer Behavior
affiliations: AAB College, University of Prizren "Ukshin HOTI",  and Aleksandër Moisiu University of Durrës

detail.title: Transforming Traditional Business into Online: The Impact of Covid-19 Pandemic on Consumer Behavior
detail.abstract: COVID-19 pandemic well-known worldwide for its serious health consequences is having a profound effect on every sphere of life. Taking into consideration that COVID-19 is harming the labor market and economic activity in general, we also consider that this situation is affecting the personal consumption expenditures in case of Kosovo (Ziberi, Rexha, & Gashi, 2021). The main aim of this paper is to analyze how the customers’ behavior will shift the traditional business to an online one in case of Western Balkan countries with special emphasis on Kosovo, North Macedonia and Albania. The study considered the mixed methods using the questionnaire as a method for primary data collection in a random sample of citizens from countries in the analysis. The questionnaire was distributed online using social media in a sample of 1250 respondents. The paper uses the SPSS software for data analysis and hypotheses testing. The study comes to the conclusion that buying behavior is changing due to the imposed measures by governance due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Thus, the confidence in online shopping has increased significantly which is a good base for further recommendations for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to start reworking selling strategies and to shift their activity from purely traditional to hybrid one — traditional and online — promoting so better the traditional business. Our findings also are in line with a study by Bytyçi (2020) who stated that the consumers in case of the Republic of Kosovo prefer online shopping for one main reason — time loss reduction.

AI.tldr: COVID-19疫情期间，西巴尔干国家（特别是科索沃、北马其顿和阿尔巴尼亚）的消费者行为从传统购物转向在线购物，为中小企业提供了转向混合商业模式的机会。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情期间，西巴尔干国家消费者的行为如何从传统商业转向在线商业？
AI.motivation: COVID-19对劳动力市场和经济活动造成严重冲击，影响个人消费支出，特别是在科索沃等地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为转变理论，在线购物偏好理论（如Bytyçi的时间损失减少理论）。
AI.method: 混合方法研究，使用问卷调查收集主要数据，样本为1250名受访者，通过社交媒体在线分发问卷，使用SPSS软件进行数据分析和假设检验。
AI.findings: 由于COVID-19疫情期间政府实施的措施，购买行为发生变化，对在线购物的信心显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了消费者行为在危机期间的转变理论，支持了Bytyçi关于在线购物偏好（时间损失减少）的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业提供了重新制定销售策略的建议，推动从纯传统商业模式转向混合模式（传统和在线），以更好地促进传统业务。

title: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor, University Bonn, Deutsche Bundesbank, Deutsche Bundesbank, University Tuebingen and National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

detail.title: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
detail.abstract: We exploit Germany's temporary three-percentage-point VAT cut in the second half of 2020 to study the spending response to unconventional fiscal policy. We use survey and scanner data on household consumption expenditures and their perceived pass-through of the tax change into prices, and a RANK model to quantify the effects of this VAT policy. The survey and scanner data show that the temporary VAT reduction led to a relative increase in durable and, to a lesser extent, semidurable spending for individuals with high perceived pass-through. According to the RANK model, the VAT policy increased total aggregate consumption spending by 4.4 percent on impact.

AI.tldr: 利用德国2020年下半年临时增值税削减政策，研究非常规财政政策对消费支出的影响。结合调查数据、扫描数据和RANK模型分析，发现增值税削减显著提高了耐用消费品支出，对总消费支出有4.4%的即时促进作用。
AI.research_question: 临时增值税削减政策如何影响家庭消费支出？
AI.motivation: 研究非常规财政政策（如临时增值税削减）对消费的实际影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: RANK模型（理性预期新凯恩斯模型）
AI.method: 结合家庭消费支出调查数据、扫描数据以及RANK模型进行量化分析
AI.findings: 临时增值税削减导致耐用消费品支出相对增加，对半耐用消费品影响较小；高感知价格传导的个体反应更明显；总消费支出即时增长4.4%
AI.theory_contributions: 为非常规财政政策的有效性提供实证支持，深化对税收政策传导机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定临时税收刺激政策提供决策参考，有助于优化财政政策设计

title: Indexical Collapse: Reference Disappears, Authority Remains in Predictive Systems
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: Indexical Collapse: Reference Disappears, Authority Remains in Predictive Systems
detail.abstract: This article introduces the concept of Indexical Collapse, the disappearance of reference in predictive systems. Indexical such as pronouns, demonstratives, and tenses presuppose a contextual anchor, yet predictive language models reproduce them without connection to reality. The outcome is a collapse of reference that paradoxically produces authority effects in law, medicine, and governance. By analyzing judicial transcripts, medical reports, institutional records, and chatbot interactions generated by AI, the paper proposes a framework for pragmatic auditing of predictive outputs. It establishes thresholds for acceptable referential absence in critical domains, positioning Indexical Collapse as a central category for evaluating the legitimacy of predictive discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"索引崩溃"概念，指预测系统中指称消失的现象。虽然代词、指示词和时态等索引词预设语境锚点，但预测语言模型在脱离现实连接的情况下复制它们，导致指称崩溃，却在法律、医疗和治理领域产生权威效应。通过分析AI生成的司法记录、医疗报告、机构文件和聊天机器人互动，本文提出了预测输出的语用审计框架，为关键领域设定了可接受指称缺失的阈值。
AI.research_question: 预测系统中的索引崩溃现象如何影响关键领域的权威性和合法性？
AI.motivation: 预测语言模型在缺乏现实连接的情况下复制索引词，导致指称消失，却在法律、医疗和治理等关键领域产生权威效应，这引发了对其合法性的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 索引崩溃理论、语用学理论、预测系统评估框架
AI.method: 分析AI生成的司法记录、医疗报告、机构文件和聊天机器人互动，建立语用审计框架
AI.findings: 预测系统在脱离现实语境的情况下复制索引词，导致指称崩溃，但在关键领域仍能产生权威效应；需要建立可接受指称缺失的阈值标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"索引崩溃"作为评估预测话语合法性的核心范畴，建立了预测系统语用审计的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律、医疗和治理等关键领域提供了预测输出评估的具体标准和阈值，有助于确保AI生成内容的合法性和可靠性。

title: Untangling Privacy and Competition
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - School of Law and

detail.title: Untangling Privacy and Competition
detail.abstract:
This Article argues that competition law, contrary to the hopes of policymakers and scholars that it offers a powerful tool to combat privacy harms, operates as an anti-privacy framework. Far from a means to address widespread surveillance by market-dominant platforms and other data-intensive firms that monetize the collection and analysis of personal information, competition law’s analysis systematically privileges corporate interests at the expense of consumer protection.

This analysis proceeds in two parts. First, the Article identifies the specific competition law concerns raised in recent regulatory enforcement actions and private litigation involving Big Tech, as well as leading scholarship, regarding the ways in which large technology firms secure, enhance, and exploit market power through collection and use of personal data. It then provides an analytic framework that identifies circumstances in which competition concerns align with privacy concerns, pointing in the same regulatory and logical direction, and other circumstances in which those two sets of concerns misalign: where remedies for one might harm the other. Our framework untangles these two sets of concerns and reveals that a majority of competition arguments misalign with privacy. In some misalignment scenarios competition concerns are merely orthogonal to those of privacy, but there is every reason to expect that privacy will be harmed rather than promoted. In others, competition and privacy directly conflict, meaning that promoting competition directly degrades privacy.

Second, the Article reveals two fundamental analytic errors that regulators, courts, and commentators make about privacy in a market setting. These errors dictate privacy-destroying outcomes, even in the instances in which privacy and competition concerns do align.

In the first error, regulators adopt a cramped understanding of the right to privacy as either a superficial concept limited to issues like consent, consumer choice, or data security, or as a means to broader economic goals rather than an essential value on its own terms. Thus, they fail to comprehend privacy as freedom from surveillance. In the second error, competition regulators prioritize markets for surveillance over markets for privacy, either through an agnosticism regarding the substance of the market and a resulting choice to promote the more lucrative and thriving market for surveillance; or through a conceptual confusion between surveillance and privacy markets that obscures the surveillance market’s privacy harms.

These errors combine, we show, in a harsh outcome: that privacy concerns are credited in competition analysis only when doing so promotes the health and competitiveness of privacy-eviscerating surveillance markets. The resulting regulatory imbalance ultimately reinforces the dominance of surveillance-driven business models at the expense of consumer and civil rights.

This analysis underscores the conclusion that privacy cannot be effectively regulated through the back door of competition. Rather, the market for personal data should be regulated directly, as we do in other contexts plagued by market failures and harmful underlying behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文论证竞争法实际上是一个反隐私框架，而非保护隐私的工具。它系统地偏袒企业利益，损害消费者保护，甚至在竞争与隐私利益一致时也会因分析错误导致隐私破坏性结果。
AI.research_question: 竞争法是否能够有效解决由市场主导平台和其他数据密集型公司通过收集和分析个人信息获利所造成的大规模监控问题？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者和学者希望竞争法能够成为对抗隐私损害的有力工具，但本文认为竞争法实际上运作成一个反隐私框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提供了一个分析框架，识别竞争关切与隐私关切在何种情况下一致或不一致，并揭示了监管机构在市场竞争环境中对隐私的两个根本性分析错误。
AI.method: 分析最近的监管执法行动、涉及大型科技公司的私人诉讼以及领先学术研究，识别竞争法关注的具体问题，并提供分析框架来理清竞争与隐私关切的关系。
AI.findings: 大多数竞争论点与隐私不一致；竞争法分析系统性地偏袒企业利益；监管机构对隐私存在两个根本性分析错误，导致隐私破坏性结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了竞争法与隐私保护之间的根本冲突，提出了识别竞争与隐私关切一致性和冲突的分析框架，批判了通过竞争法后门监管隐私的方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出隐私应直接监管，而非通过竞争法间接监管；为政策制定者提供了识别竞争与隐私冲突的分析工具；揭示了当前监管实践中的系统性缺陷。

title: Shortage, Liquidity, and the Effectiveness of Monetary Policy: Evidence from the U.S. Commodity Futures Markets
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration and

detail.title: Shortage, Liquidity, and the Effectiveness of Monetary Policy: Evidence from the U.S. Commodity Futures Markets
detail.abstract: This paper is the first to document that monetary policy shocks do not significantly affect commodity futures markets when they are in backwardation, that is, when futures prices fall below spot prices. Since backwardation is a market-based signal of supply constraints, reflecting a premium for immediate delivery due to tight supply or low inventories, this finding suggests a new channel for understanding the effects of monetary policy under supply shortages. We emphasize the role of the basis by extending the inventory-arbitrage channel of monetary policy proposed by Frankel (2008). Under backwardation, producers maintain minimal buffer stocks and little incentive to accumulate inventories, given that front-month futures trade above deferred contracts. By contrast, under contango, monetary tightening may lead producers to secure selling prices in advance and release inventories before the anticipated spot price decline is priced into futures. Consistent with this, we find that monetary policy shocks are significant only under contango. This main result also holds when we extend our analysis to aggregated macroeconomic price indicators such as the Personal Consumption Expenditures Index and the Producer Price Index. To further demonstrate the link between the basis and supply constraints, we construct an Inventory Constraint Index, defined as the cross-sectional mean of the basis. Our food-specific index closely tracks the U.S. Stocks-to-Use Ratio from the World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates. We also evaluate an alternative mechanism, namely the turnover-liquidity channel documented by Lagos and Zhang (2020), as well as the illiquidity premium. Our findings are consistent with the existence of an illiquidity premium, as more illiquid commodities are more susceptible to monetary policy shocks. Yet even after controlling for liquidity, the distinction between contango and backwardation continues to play a significant role.

AI.tldr: 本文首次发现当商品期货市场处于现货溢价（期货价格低于现货价格）时，货币政策冲击不会显著影响商品期货市场。现货溢价是供应约束的市场信号，反映了由于供应紧张或库存低导致的即时交割溢价。研究发现货币政策冲击仅在期货溢价（期货价格高于现货价格）状态下显著。
AI.research_question: 货币政策冲击如何影响不同基差状态（现货溢价与期货溢价）下的商品期货市场？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注货币政策对商品价格的总体影响，但忽略了基差状态（现货溢价/期货溢价）作为供应约束信号的重要作用。现货溢价反映了供应紧张和低库存状况，可能改变货币政策传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Frankel（2008）提出的库存套利渠道，强调基差在货币政策传导中的作用。在现货溢价下，生产者维持最低缓冲库存且缺乏积累库存的动机；在期货溢价下，货币政策紧缩可能促使生产者提前锁定销售价格并释放库存。
AI.method: 实证分析货币政策冲击在不同基差状态下的影响，构建库存约束指数（基差的横截面均值），并控制流动性等其他机制。
AI.findings: 货币政策冲击仅在期货溢价状态下显著影响商品期货市场，在现货溢价状态下不显著。库存约束指数与USDA的库存使用比高度相关。流动性较差的商品对货币政策冲击更敏感，但基差状态的影响在控制流动性后仍然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于基差状态的货币政策传导新渠道，扩展了库存套利理论，强调了供应约束在货币政策效应中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在供应约束时期评估货币政策效果的新视角，帮助投资者理解不同市场条件下货币政策对商品市场的影响差异。

title: The Rule of Thumb: Private Consumption as A Driving Force of the Economic Growth of Western Balkan Countries
affiliations: AAB College,  and AAB College

detail.title: The Rule of Thumb: Private Consumption as A Driving Force of the Economic Growth of Western Balkan Countries
detail.abstract: Private consumption is considered one of the main drivers of economic growth in Western Balkan countries. The main aim of this study is to estimate the impact of private consumption on the economic growth of the Western Balkans, including the North Macedonia, Kosovo, Albania, Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Serbia. Housing wealth was even the main driver of total private consumption in the European Union (EU) countries as a whole (Barradas, 2017). Based on an extensive literature review for panel data, this study uses econometric models with fixed effect, random effect, and Hausman-Taylor test. The data are taken from the World Development Indicators by country (The World Bank, n.d.) and cover the period 2010–2019. Based on the Hausman-Taylor test, the model that fits a small sample as in our case is chosen as the fixed effect. The results of the estimator show that a 1% increase in final consumption leads to a 0.43% increase in gross domestic product (GDP) growth and that, on the other hand, a 1% increase in the employment rate increases GDP by 0.11%. The most important domestic factor continues to be private consumption, driven by record levels in the labour market and further strengthening of household purchasing power (Bank of Slovenia, 2020). The study concludes that private consumption is the main driver of economic growth and sustainability in the case of the Western Balkans.

AI.tldr: 本研究估计了私人消费对西巴尔干国家经济增长的影响，发现私人消费是经济增长的主要驱动力。使用2010-2019年面板数据，通过固定效应模型分析显示，最终消费每增加1%会导致GDP增长0.43%，就业率每增加1%会使GDP增长0.11%。
AI.research_question: 私人消费对西巴尔干国家经济增长的影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: 私人消费被认为是西巴尔干国家经济增长的主要驱动力之一，住房财富在欧盟国家中是私人消费的主要推动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于面板数据的计量经济学理论，包括固定效应、随机效应模型和Hausman-Taylor检验。
AI.method: 使用2010-2019年世界银行发展指标的面板数据，采用固定效应、随机效应模型和Hausman-Taylor检验进行计量分析。
AI.findings: 最终消费每增加1%会导致GDP增长0.43%，就业率每增加1%会使GDP增长0.11%。私人消费是经济增长的主要驱动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在西巴尔干国家背景下私人消费对经济增长的重要作用，为相关理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西巴尔干国家的政策制定者提供了关于促进私人消费以推动经济增长的政策依据，强调了劳动力市场和家庭购买力的重要性。

title: The Illusion of Foresight: Macroeconomic Indicators, Predictive Power, and Misinterpretation Pitfalls
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: The Illusion of Foresight: Macroeconomic Indicators, Predictive Power, and Misinterpretation Pitfalls

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper No. 5551159
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the predictive power of macroeconomic indicators in forecasting financial market performance, emphasizing the distinction between economic and market forecasting. Drawing on insights from financial practitioners and academic literature, we analyze which indicators hold predictive value and highlight common fallacies that investors and analysts encounter, particularly those related to low sample sizes and reliance on unreliable or misinterpreted data. Key findings suggest that while certain indicators, such as yield curve inversions, exhibit some predictive reliability, their utility is limited by broad time horizons and market-specific dynamics. The paper also critiques the pervasive tendency to overfit narratives to macroeconomic data, leading to flawed conclusions. We advocate for a disciplined approach that prioritizes market fundamentals, such as earnings per share reactions and return on invested capital over sensationalized or poorly substantiated data. By addressing these issues, we aim to provide a framework for investors to navigate the noise of macroeconomic forecasting and focus on actionable, evidence-based insights.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨宏观经济指标在预测金融市场表现方面的预测能力，强调经济预测与市场预测的区别。研究发现虽然某些指标如收益率曲线倒挂具有一定预测可靠性，但其效用受限于宽泛的时间范围和市场特定动态。论文批判了将叙事过度拟合到宏观经济数据的普遍倾向，并提倡优先考虑市场基本面的方法。
AI.research_question: 哪些宏观经济指标对金融市场表现具有预测能力？如何区分经济预测与市场预测的有效性？
AI.motivation: 投资者和分析师在宏观经济预测中经常遇到样本量不足、依赖不可靠或被误解数据等常见谬误，导致预测结果不准确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融从业者和学术文献的见解，区分经济预测与市场预测的理论框架，强调市场基本面分析的重要性。
AI.method: 分析宏观经济指标的预测价值，识别常见预测谬误，评估指标的实际效用和局限性。
AI.findings: 收益率曲线倒挂等某些指标具有一定预测可靠性，但受限于宽泛的时间范围和市场特定动态；过度拟合叙事到宏观经济数据会导致错误结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了区分经济预测与市场预测的理论框架，批判了宏观经济预测中的常见谬误，强调市场基本面分析的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了一个框架，帮助他们在宏观经济预测的噪音中导航，专注于可操作的、基于证据的见解，优先考虑每股收益反应和投资资本回报率等市场基本面。

title: State Aid Enforcement After Apple
affiliations: University of Virginia School of Law

detail.title: State Aid Enforcement After Apple

declarations.declarationOfInterest: non
declarations.funderStatement: UVA, NYU

publicationDetails.detailsText: Virginia Public Law and Legal Theory Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Virginia Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This is the text of Ruth Mason's Tillinghast Lecture, delivered at NYU School of Law in October 2025.  The lecture frames the EU's anti-subsidy rules (state-aid) as involving balancing act when subsidies are delivered as tax savings: the EU protects free movement and a level playing field, yet Member States retain primary tax-design powers (rates, bases, allocation methods). 

Procedurally, the Commission must prove a selective advantage and often does so by constructing a “reference system” and identifying a derogation—an approach that mirrors tax-expenditure analysis.  But recent cases have pushed this method into controversial territory because those cases concerned what tax-expenditure analysis labels "structural rules." Structural rules are the deep architecture of the tax system—such as tax rates, taxable units, and methods of allocating income—for which there are no ready reference bases.  The Commission's search for new methods that can handle structural tax rules has led to ambiguity, accusations of political motives, baseline fights, and recoveries that rely on  debatable premises.  Mason's solution—described in more detail in a forthcoming book—enlists alternative methodologies that can separate true distortions (tariff equivalents or subsidies for interstate over in-state commerce) from mere mismatches or policy differences between states. Getting the method right is not a mere academic problem: it enhances predictability for business, preserves the Commission’s legitimacy, and better serves the single market’s neutrality goals.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟反补贴规则在处理税收优惠时的平衡问题：既要保护自由流动和公平竞争，又要尊重成员国税收设计权。作者批评了欧盟委员会当前处理结构性税收规则的方法，并提出替代性方法来解决真正的市场扭曲。
AI.research_question: 欧盟反补贴规则如何平衡保护单一市场与尊重成员国税收主权之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 欧盟委员会在处理结构性税收规则时面临方法论困境，导致模糊性、政治动机指控和基于可疑前提的追回，这损害了商业可预测性和委员会合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收支出分析理论、结构性税收规则理论、市场扭曲与政策差异区分理论
AI.method: 比较分析欧盟反补贴规则与税收支出分析方法，识别结构性税收规则处理的方法论问题，提出替代性方法论框架
AI.findings: 欧盟委员会当前通过构建'参考系统'识别选择性优势的方法在处理结构性税收规则时存在严重问题，导致法律不确定性和政治争议
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分真正市场扭曲（关税等价物或跨州商业补贴）与政策差异的理论框架，为处理结构性税收规则提供了新的方法论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 增强商业可预测性，维护欧盟委员会合法性，更好地服务于单一市场的中立性目标

title: Climate Accounting and Domestic Incentives for Agricultural GHG Mitigation
affiliations: Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) - Department of Economics and University of Saskatchewan

detail.title: Climate Accounting and Domestic Incentives for Agricultural GHG Mitigation
detail.abstract: The current global greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting framework excludes CO₂ removed and stored in harvested crops, as well as CO₂ released when crops are consumed. This omission creates flawed incentives, encouraging deforestation and higher global emissions. Net Ecosystem Emission (NEE) accounting, which explicitly includes these biogenic fluxes, could address this gap. We develop a three-region partial equilibrium model of the world vegetable oil market to examine how GHG accounting regimes and green procurement strategies influence agricultural GHG mitigation policy and global emission outcomes. Holding the policies in the other regions constant, we simulate and compare optimal (welfare maximizing) EU policies where GHG emissions are measured using UNFCCC accounting versus NEE accounting. We then use the model to simulate the effectiveness of prohibiting the imports of high GHG emission vegetable oils on domestic and global GHG emissions. Our simulations show that EU policies designed to optimally mitigate UNFCCC-measured GHG emissions will consistently result in higher world vegetable oil prices and increased global agricultural GHG emissions. In contrast, EU policies designed to optimally mitigate NEE-measured GHG emissions will result in lower world vegetable oil prices and reduced global GHG emissions. Import bans on high-emission oils, however, have little effect on global emissions due to trade diversion. These results highlight the need to reform UNFCCC accounting to enable more effective agricultural GHG mitigation.

AI.tldr: 当前UNFCCC温室气体核算框架存在缺陷，忽略了作物收获储存的CO₂和消费释放的CO₂，导致鼓励毁林和全球排放增加。采用净生态系统排放(NEE)核算可以解决这一问题。模拟显示，基于UNFCCC核算的欧盟政策会提高全球植物油价格和排放，而基于NEE核算的政策则能降低价格和排放。进口禁令因贸易转移而效果有限。
AI.research_question: 温室气体核算制度和绿色采购策略如何影响农业温室气体减排政策和全球排放结果？
AI.motivation: 当前全球温室气体核算框架排除了作物收获储存的CO₂和消费释放的CO₂，这一遗漏造成了有缺陷的激励机制，鼓励毁林和更高的全球排放。
AI.theoretical_framework: 净生态系统排放(NEE)核算框架，包括生物源通量的核算；三区域部分均衡模型分析世界植物油市场。
AI.method: 开发三区域部分均衡模型模拟世界植物油市场，比较基于UNFCCC核算和NEE核算的欧盟最优政策效果，并分析高排放植物油进口禁令的有效性。
AI.findings: 1) 基于UNFCCC核算的欧盟政策导致全球植物油价格上涨和农业温室气体排放增加；2) 基于NEE核算的政策降低全球植物油价格和温室气体排放；3) 进口禁令因贸易转移对全球排放影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了净生态系统排放(NEE)核算框架的理论基础，揭示了当前UNFCCC核算制度的系统性缺陷，为农业温室气体核算改革提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的政策建议：改革UNFCCC核算制度，采用NEE核算方法可以更有效地实现农业温室气体减排目标，避免贸易转移导致的政策失效。

title: The Post-Scarcity Catalyst: Permanently Solving Economic Scarcity through Fusion Energy Adoption
affiliations: The Open University - Faculty of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics

detail.title: The Post-Scarcity Catalyst: Permanently Solving Economic Scarcity through Fusion Energy Adoption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicting interests

keywords: The Post-Scarcity Catalyst: Permanently Solving Economic Scarcity Through Fusion Energy Adoption Author: [Rasheeq B. N. N. Choudhury] Date: September 13

detail.abstract: For centuries, the fundamental axiom of economics has been the problem of scarcityunlimited human wants versus limited resources. This preprint posits that the successful development and global adoption of commercial nuclear fusion energy represent a paradigm-shifting technological breakthrough capable of permanently solving the problem of economic scarcity. We argue that fusion energy, characterized by its near-limitless fuel supply, immense energy density, inherent safety, and minimal environmental impact, can decouple human civilization from its dependence on finite energy resources. This decoupling would cascade through all sectors of the economy, drastically reducing the cost base for essential goods like food, water, materials, and transportation. By analysing the downstream effects on production, recycling, and environmental management, we demonstrate that the primary constraints of scarcity can be alleviated. We conclude that the remaining challenges are not technical or economic, but rather political, social, and ideological in transitioning to a new economic model predicated on abundance rather than scarcity.

AI.tldr: 核聚变能源的突破性发展能够永久解决经济稀缺性问题，通过近乎无限的燃料供应和巨大能量密度，使人类文明摆脱有限能源依赖，大幅降低食品、水、材料和运输等必需品的成本基础。
AI.research_question: 核聚变能源的商业化和全球采用是否能够永久解决经济稀缺性问题？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学基于稀缺性公理——无限的人类需求与有限资源之间的矛盾。核聚变能源作为范式转变的技术突破，可能从根本上改变这一状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于稀缺性经济学理论，探讨核聚变能源如何通过能源无限供应来重新定义资源约束。
AI.method: 分析核聚变能源对生产、回收和环境管理的下游影响，评估其对稀缺性约束的缓解作用。
AI.findings: 核聚变能源能够解除人类对有限能源资源的依赖，显著降低必需品的成本基础，从而缓解主要稀缺性约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统经济学的稀缺性公理，提出基于丰裕而非稀缺的新经济模型理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供向丰裕经济转型的路径，强调政治、社会和意识形态层面的挑战而非技术经济障碍。

title: Spatial Spillovers and Determinants of Sovereign ESG Performance: Evidence from a Spatial Durbin Model
affiliations: University of Pécs - Faculty of Business and Economics and University of Pécs

detail.title: Spatial Spillovers and Determinants of Sovereign ESG Performance: Evidence from a Spatial Durbin Model
detail.abstract: Understanding the determinants of Sovereign Environmental, Social, and Governance (SESG) performance is crucial for advancing global sustainability. Despite the increasing interest, most studies concentrate on firms, neglecting the spatial interdependencies among countries. This study addresses this gap by investigating how national attributes and regional interactions collectively influence SESG performances. We analyze a panel of 107 countries from 2000 to 2022 using a spatial econometric framework. The use of Global and local Moran’s I and Getis–Ord Gi* statistics reveals a notable geographic clustering of SESG performance. This observation justifies the adoption of a Spatial Durbin Model (SDM) with two-way fixed effects. Model selection tests identified the SDM as the most appropriate specification, indicating that a country’s SESG performance is affected not only by its own characteristics but also by those of neighboring nations. Our results validate a U-shaped relationship between economic growth and SESG, consistent with the Environmental Kuznets Curve. Notably, we uncover significant spatial spillovers, indicating that economic growth in neighboring countries has a negative effect (“race-to-the-bottom”). At the same time, their investments in climate adaptation and renewable energy generate positive spillovers. Political integration fosters cooperation, whereas economic globalization may exacerbate negative externalities. These findings underscore the inherent regional interdependence of SESG performance. Thus, effective sustainability policies necessitate coordinated regional strategies, including harmonized standards, technology-sharing platforms, and regional cooperation initiatives. Neglecting spatial interdependencies can lead to ineffective policy interventions and worsen regional disparities in sustainable development outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用空间计量经济学方法分析107个国家2000-2022年的主权ESG表现，发现存在显著的地理集聚效应。经济增长与SESG呈U型关系，邻国经济增长产生负面溢出效应，而气候适应和可再生能源投资产生正向溢出。政治整合促进合作，经济全球化可能加剧负面外部性。
AI.research_question: 国家属性和区域互动如何共同影响主权环境、社会和治理（SESG）表现？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注企业ESG表现，忽视了国家间的空间相互依赖性，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境库兹涅茨曲线理论、空间计量经济学理论、区域相互依存理论
AI.method: 使用全球和局部莫兰指数、Getis-Ord Gi*统计量进行空间分析，采用双向固定效应的空间杜宾模型（SDM）分析107个国家2000-2022年的面板数据
AI.findings: 1) SESG表现存在显著地理集聚；2) 经济增长与SESG呈U型关系；3) 邻国经济增长产生负面溢出效应（"竞次效应"）；4) 邻国气候适应和可再生能源投资产生正向溢出；5) 政治整合促进合作，经济全球化可能加剧负面外部性
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将空间相互依赖性纳入SESG研究框架；2) 验证了环境库兹涅茨曲线在主权ESG背景下的适用性；3) 揭示了SESG表现的空间溢出机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 强调可持续发展政策需要区域协调战略；2) 建议建立统一标准、技术共享平台和区域合作倡议；3) 警示忽视空间相互依赖性可能导致政策失效和区域发展差距扩大

title: Identifying Terms-of-Trade Shocks with Foreign Weather: Implications for Monetary Policy
affiliations: University of Florida - Department of Economics

detail.title: Identifying Terms-of-Trade Shocks with Foreign Weather: Implications for Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: How do the terms of trade (ToT) affect the macroeconomy, and how should monetary policy respond? I identify exogenous ToT shocks for 48 economies by combining a rich set of high-frequency weather shocks from foreign territories with bilateral trade flows. I apply machine learning methods to map high-dimensional weather shocks into low dimensional components that predict future ToT growth out of sample, while avoiding overfitting. Using panel local projections, I show that negative ToT shocks are contractionary and inflationary, creating a policy tradeoff under floating exchange rates. A shock that causes a 10% decline in the ToT one year ahead raises prices by 3% and reduces economic activity by 1.5% in the medium run (5 years). Stabilizing inflation requires preemptive contractionary policy of 46 bps, offsetting 90% of the shock’s cumulative effects, while closing the output gap calls for preemptive expansionary policy of 20 bps, neutralizing 70% respectively.

detail.abstract: With his run-off victory over Kemal Kilicdaroglu on May 28, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan stretched his presidency for the next five years into a third term. Turkey, however, held a two-round presidential election, a first in the country’s political history. After 99.43% of the votes were counted, the Supreme Election Council (YSK) of Turkey confirmed that Erdogan had won with 52.14% of the vote, while a total of 48.16% went to Kilicdaroglu. However, thousands of people congregated in Taksim Square in Istanbul, shouting Erdogan’s name and yelling “God is great.” They gathered outside the Party offices in Istanbul as early results indicated that Erdogan was in the lead. There were families with kids there, and there were also people waving flags and horns and lighting off fireworks and flares.

detail.title: Private Military Companies in International Security: History, Responses, and Future Outlooks
detail.abstract: Private Military Companies (PMCs) have become pivotal yet controversial actors in contemporary security, occupying the blurred space between state and private authority. Emerging in the post-Cold War era as states downsized their militaries, PMCs such as Executive Outcomes, Blackwater, and Wagner have since grown into a multibillion-dollar industry providing combat, training, and logistical services worldwide. Their rise has raised profound questions of accountability, legality, and legitimacy under international law. This paper examines the historical drivers of PMC expansion, including economic constraints, technological advances, and geopolitical demand, while distinguishing PMCs from traditional mercenaries. Through case studies of Wagner, Blackwater, and China's Frontier Services Group, the analysis highlights the diverse ways PMCs shape conflicts, from hybrid warfare to resource extraction. The paper also assesses the implications of PMCs for the global rules-based order, particularly the erosion of state sovereignty, humanitarian protections, and the principle of the state monopoly on force. Current regulatory responses, such as the UN anti-mercenary conventions, the Montreux Document, and the International Code of Conduct (ICoC), are evaluated for their strengths and limitations. The study concludes that effective governance of PMCs requires binding international norms alongside stronger national enforcement to prevent the privatization of force from perpetuating impunity and undermining international stability.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了私营军事公司(PMCs)的历史发展、运作模式及其对国际秩序的挑战，评估了现有监管框架的局限性，并提出了加强国际规范和国内执法的治理建议。

AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对非国家行为体在国际安全中作用的理解，拓展了私营化理论在安全领域的应用。

detail.abstract: The transition path from education to employment is a key determinant of sustainable economic growth and development. A poorly trained workforce penalizes companies when they try to grow (Cojocaru, 2017, p. 25). It is generally accepted that university graduates as workforce are the key driver of economic growth and development. The main aim of this study is to identify the difficulties faced by enterprises in the Republic of Kosovo to provide the necessary profiles with adequate skills. Employers say students don't have the ability to think critically, innovate, solve complex problems and work well in a team (Alsop, 2015) In order to analyze the problems that companies face during the selection process, the necessary training, and also the projections for new employments for the coming years, this study uses the primary data provided by the face-to-face questionnaire. The program used for data analysis in SPSS. We came to the conclusion that enterprises find it difficult to ensure the right skills they require, the university graduates lack practice experience and soft skills. The right person with the right skills in the right workplace is the driving force behind the well-functioning of the labor market. The study comes up with further recommendations for the well-functioning of the triangle higher education institutions, policymakers, and enterprises.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了科索沃企业面临的高等教育毕业生技能不匹配问题，发现大学毕业生缺乏实践经验和软技能，导致企业难以找到合适人才。
AI.research_question: 科索沃企业在招聘过程中面临哪些困难？如何确保获得具备必要技能的人才？
AI.motivation: 教育到就业的过渡路径是可持续经济增长和发展的关键决定因素。训练不足的劳动力会阻碍企业发展，大学毕业生作为劳动力是经济增长和发展的关键驱动力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场技能匹配理论，强调合适的人在合适的工作场所具备合适技能对劳动力市场良好运作的重要性。
AI.method: 使用面对面问卷调查收集主要数据，通过SPSS程序进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 企业难以确保所需技能，大学毕业生缺乏实践经验和软技能（如批判性思维、创新能力、复杂问题解决能力和团队合作能力）。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家劳动力市场技能匹配理论，特别关注高等教育与就业市场衔接问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构、政策制定者和企业三方合作提供建议，促进劳动力市场的良好运作。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ziberi, Besime/Avdiu, Merita (2019). Econometric analysis to examine the relationship between unemployment and macroeconomics aggregates : evidence from Kosovo. In: Academic journal of economic studies 6 (2), S. 33 - 41.

detail.abstract: Unemployment is considered one of the most challenging economic problems in Kosovo. In fact, the very high unemployment rate is also the primary economic problem of the country. The purpose of this study is to analyze the correlation and the impact of macroeconomic aggregates in Kosovo's unemployment. Specifically, this study utilized macroeconomic aggregates as follows: Gross Domestic Product, Foreign Direct Investment, Exports, and Inflation. To prove this relationship, based on the theoretical literature, the econometrical model was constructed with multiple regressions analysis based on the Ordinary Least Square (OLS) method, utilizing secondary data from World Bank Indicators for the time period of 2001 till 2018 The paper concludes that in Kosovo, for the time period under consideration (2001–2018), the link between unemployment and economic growth is significant and the results show that 1% growth of Gross Domestic Product will lower the unemployment rate by 1.7%. Also, the results of the regression model show that the relationship between Export and Unemployment rate is significant, namely the increase in Export by 1% will reduce the Unemployment rate to (1,154) while the relation between Foreign Direct Investment and Unemployment rate results negative as growth for 1% of Foreign Direct Investment will increase the Unemployment rate to 1.25. Meanwhile, the results between unemployment and inflation showed an unsatisfactory and insignificant relationship between them.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了科索沃失业率与宏观经济变量（GDP、FDI、出口、通胀）的关系。发现GDP增长1%可降低失业率1.7%，出口增长1%可降低失业率1.154%，但FDI增长1%反而增加失业率1.25%，通胀与失业率关系不显著。
AI.research_question: 科索沃失业率与宏观经济变量（GDP、外国直接投资、出口、通胀）之间存在怎样的相关性和影响关系？
AI.motivation: 失业是科索沃最严峻的经济问题，高失业率是该国的主要经济挑战，需要分析宏观经济变量对失业的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论，构建失业率与GDP、FDI、出口、通胀之间的理论关系模型。
AI.method: 使用多元回归分析的计量经济学模型，基于普通最小二乘法（OLS），利用2001-2018年世界银行指标的二手数据。
AI.findings: GDP增长1%可降低失业率1.7%；出口增长1%可降低失业率1.154%；FDI增长1%反而增加失业率1.25%；通胀与失业率关系不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了科索沃特定背景下奥肯定律的适用性，发现了FDI与失业率的反常关系，为发展中国家失业理论研究提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃政府制定就业政策提供实证依据，建议优先发展GDP增长和出口导向产业，审慎对待FDI对就业的影响。

title: Beyond Meritocracy: Exposing the Invisible Sets that Govern Opportunity and Advancing Pathways for Equity
affiliations: , , , The Perrin Research Institution and Independent

detail.title: Beyond Meritocracy: Exposing the Invisible Sets that Govern Opportunity and Advancing Pathways for Equity
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the concept of "invisible sets," the informal networks and cultural mechanisms that quietly shape access to education and career opportunities. While standardized criteria such as test scores and application requirements create the appearance of fairness, outcomes are often determined by insider knowledge, social ties, and cultural fluency. The paper first defines these mechanisms and situates them within existing theories of credentialism, hidden curriculum, and structural exclusion. It then explores their operation across case studies, including college admissions, AP course access, small business lending, and finance and consulting internships, showing how advantage is consistently reproduced across fields. Finally, the paper evaluates the limits of current equity interventions and offers recommendations, such as mentoring networks, pipeline programs, centralized opportunity databases, and greater transparency in selection processes. Overall, these measures aim to dismantle invisible sets and build systems where access reflects effort and merit rather than inherited privilege.

AI.tldr: 本文提出'隐形集合'概念，指那些通过非正式网络和文化机制悄然影响教育和职业机会获取的现象。虽然标准化标准创造了公平表象，但结果往往由内部知识、社会关系和文化遗产决定。

AI.motivation: 揭示表面公平的标准化标准背后隐藏的不平等机制，这些机制通过内部知识、社会关系和文化遗产持续复制优势。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出'隐形集合'概念，整合文凭主义、隐性课程和结构性排斥理论，深化对机会获取机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体干预措施：导师网络、管道项目、集中机会数据库、选拔过程透明度提升，旨在打破隐形集合

title: Identifying Lottery-Like Stocks Via Lottery Jackpots

detail.title: Identifying Lottery-Like Stocks Via Lottery Jackpots
detail.abstract: We propose a new method to identify lottery-like stocks by leveraging the substitution effect between real lotteries and lottery-like stocks, exploiting declines in retail trading volume on days with large lottery jackpot drawings. Stocks classified as lottery-like under this approach underperform non-lottery-like stocks by 3.80 percentage points over the subsequent year. Unlike traditional measures, our method does not rely on stock prices or returns information and is therefore insulated from overvaluation induced by other factors. The results remain robust after controlling for existing lottery-like characteristics, including MAX, IVOL, ISKEW, and stock price, in both Fama-MacBeth regressions, in sequential double-sorting analyses, and in subsample analyses.

AI.findings: 彩票型股票在随后一年表现比非彩票型股票差3.80个百分点，结果在控制MAX、IVOL、ISKEW和股价等传统彩票特征后仍然稳健

title: Globalization And Environmental Sustainability in Ethiopia: Assessing the Impact of Economic Factors and Resource Management
affiliations: University of Pécs - Faculty of Business and Economics, Ethiopian Economics Association (EEA), Addis Ababa University, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, Ethiopian Economics Association (EEA) and Department of Economics, Inland Norway University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Globalization And Environmental Sustainability in Ethiopia: Assessing the Impact of Economic Factors and Resource Management
detail.abstract: The globalization-environmental sustainability linkage has become a topic of interest in sustainable development. This study examines the impact of globalization, natural resource rent, and renewable energy consumption on Ethiopia's ecological sustainability. The study employed an autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) and dynamic ARDL model using time series data from 1971 to 2018. Findings of the study show that factors such as urbanization, renewable energy consumption, political globalization, and natural resource rents contribute to an upsurge in the ecological footprint, indicating environmental strain. Conversely, the ecological footprint is mitigated by economic globalization, suggesting the potential to slow down environmental deterioration. These findings emphasize the importance of implementing strategies and plans to manage resources. Considering renewable energy sources is essential for supporting technological advancements and promoting sustainable practices. These actions are essential to regulate the impact of globalization and foster sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用ARDL和动态ARDL模型分析1971-2018年埃塞俄比亚数据，发现城市化、可再生能源消费、政治全球化和自然资源租金会增加生态足迹，而经济全球化有助于减缓环境恶化。
AI.research_question: 全球化、自然资源租金和可再生能源消费对埃塞俄比亚生态可持续性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球化与环境可持续性之间的联系已成为可持续发展领域的重要议题，需要研究这些因素如何影响特定国家的生态可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球化与环境可持续性关系的理论框架，探讨不同类型全球化（经济、政治）对生态足迹的不同影响。

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同类型全球化对环境影响的不同机制，丰富了全球化与环境可持续性关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了管理资源、促进可再生能源使用和调控全球化影响的实践建议，以推动可持续发展。

detail.title: From Meat to Plant-Based Products? The Enduring impact of BSE on Beef Consumption

publicationDetails.detailsText: SLU Department of Economics Working Paper 2025:01

detail.abstract: This study redefines the impact of the BSE outbreak on EU dietary patterns, revealing a lasting shift toward plant-based consumption. Utilizing advanced difference-indifferences techniques on 1980-2020 data, we demonstrate that while beef consumption exhibited a transient U-shaped recovery relative to other meats, it declined sharply compared to plant-based products, with average reductions of 79%, 29%, and 28% for pulses, cereals, and vegetable oils, respectively. This highlights a structural dietary change, overlooked by previous analyses focused on meat substitution. Results are robust to sensitivity tests and support plant-based consumption policies that promote health and sustainability in response to meat safety scares.

AI.tldr: 疯牛病疫情导致欧盟饮食结构向植物性消费的持久转变，牛肉消费相对植物性产品大幅下降，脉冲、谷物和植物油分别减少79%、29%和28%。
AI.research_question: 疯牛病疫情对欧盟饮食模式的长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 重新评估疯牛病疫情对欧盟饮食模式的影响，揭示先前分析忽略的结构性饮食变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 差异中的差异（difference-in-differences）分析框架，用于评估政策冲击的因果效应。
AI.method: 使用先进的差异中的差异技术分析1980-2020年数据，并进行敏感性检验。
AI.findings: 牛肉消费相对于其他肉类呈现短暂的U型恢复，但相对于植物性产品急剧下降；脉冲、谷物和植物油消费分别减少79%、29%和28%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了疯牛病疫情引发的结构性饮食变化，超越了先前仅关注肉类替代的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持促进健康和可持续性的植物性消费政策，作为应对肉类安全恐慌的有效策略。

detail.title: Understanding the Effects on Corporate Performance of Investments in Wealth Management Products
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates how purchases of wealth management products (WMPs) influence the performance of Chinese non-financial listed companies. Our main finding is that purchasing WMPs enhances firm performance, but the relationship shows an inverted U-shape: when WMP investment exceeds 62.57% of total assets, its positive effects diminish and ultimately harm performance. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the performance gains are concentrated among non-state-owned enterprises (non-SOEs), while state-owned enterprises (SOEs) experience no significant benefits or even negative effects. Furthermore, the positive impact of WMPs is more pronounced in firms with higher leverage, abundant cash holdings or lower top-shareholder concentration.

AI.tldr: 财富管理产品购买对中国非金融上市公司绩效的影响呈倒U型关系，适度投资提升绩效，但超过总资产62.57%后转为负面影响。非国有企业获益明显，国有企业无显著收益甚至受损。高杠杆、现金充裕或股权集中度低的企业获益更大。
AI.research_question: 财富管理产品购买如何影响中国非金融上市公司的绩效？
AI.motivation: 随着中国财富管理产品市场的快速发展，企业大量投资此类产品，需要研究这种投资行为对企业实际经营绩效的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业投资决策理论、代理理论和资源基础观，分析WMP投资对企业绩效的非线性影响机制。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，使用中国非金融上市公司数据，构建回归模型分析WMP投资与企业绩效的关系。
AI.findings: 1. WMP投资与企业绩效呈倒U型关系，临界点为总资产的62.57%；2. 非国有企业获益明显，国有企业无显著收益；3. 高杠杆、现金充裕或股权集中度低的企业获益更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了WMP投资对企业绩效的非线性影响机制，拓展了企业金融投资理论，丰富了代理理论和资源基础观在金融投资领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业合理配置WMP投资提供决策参考，帮助监管机构识别过度金融化的风险，促进实体经济发展。

title: Beyond GDP: Quantifying Heterogeneous Impact of Climate Change on Well-being and Social Progress
affiliations: Department of Economics Delhi school of economics

detail.title: Beyond GDP: Quantifying Heterogeneous Impact of Climate Change on Well-being and Social Progress
detail.abstract: The growing interest in assessing societal progress and public policies through the lens of Well-being has garnered significant attention from researchers and policymakers. This study examines the relationship between well-being and global warming across 167 countries from 1990 to 2019, employing the Social Progress Index (SPI) as a measure of well-being. Using a fixed-effects panel data framework, we study temperature impacts by modeling local and global anomalies simultaneously, capturing both within-country and global climate variation. First, a statistically significant negative relationship exists between annual temperature anomalies and well-being, with a 1°C global(local) mean temperature deviation leading to a 0.8324(0.096)-point decline, respectively. Second, precipitation anomalies show no significant effect on the SPI. Third, winter temperature anomalies and cold spells have a greater impact on well-being than other seasons or hot spells. Fourth, poorer regions, hotter climates, the global south, and countries with weak institutions are disproportionately affected by temperature deviations. Fifth, the impact of temperature on well-being persists over the medium term, lasting about four years.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用社会进步指数衡量福祉，分析1990-2019年167个国家福祉与全球变暖的关系。发现温度异常与福祉呈显著负相关，全球/局地温度每升高1°C分别导致福祉下降0.8324/0.096点。冬季温度和寒潮影响更大，贫困地区、热带气候、全球南方和制度薄弱国家受影响更严重，温度影响可持续约4年。
AI.research_question: 全球变暖如何影响不同国家的福祉水平？
AI.motivation: 随着研究者与政策制定者日益关注通过福祉视角评估社会进步和公共政策，需要理解气候变化对福祉的具体影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会进步指数(SPI)作为福祉衡量框架，结合气候变化经济学和福祉经济学理论。
AI.method: 使用固定效应面板数据模型，同时建模局地和全球温度异常，捕捉国家内部和全球气候变化变异。
AI.findings: 1) 温度异常与福祉显著负相关；2) 降水异常无显著影响；3) 冬季温度和寒潮影响更大；4) 贫困地区、热带气候、全球南方和制度薄弱国家更易受影响；5) 温度影响可持续约4年。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对气候变化与福祉关系的理解，揭示了温度影响的异质性和持续性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候政策制定提供实证依据，强调需要针对脆弱群体和地区的差异化气候适应策略。

title: Macroeconomic drivers and political stability on asymmetric volatility: Evidence from Bangladesh’s stock market
affiliations: United International University

detail.title: Macroeconomic drivers and political stability on asymmetric volatility: Evidence from Bangladesh’s stock market
detail.abstract: This study investigates the combined effects of macroeconomic shocks and institutional quality on stock market volatility within a frontier economy, specifically examining the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSEX) in Bangladesh. Utilizing daily data from February 2013 to May 2025, the research constructs shocks related to exchange rates, inflation, and political stability scores derived from the World Governance Indicators. Following the verification of stationarity and significant ARCH effects, the study employs symmetric and asymmetric GARCH-family models, including GARCH-X, exponential GARCH (EGARCH), and GJR-GARCH, to capture patterns of volatility clustering, persistence, and leverage effects. Across all model specifications, macroeconomic shocks exhibit a minimal impact on average returns, whereas political stability consistently exerts a slight negative influence on returns and a positive effect on volatility. Volatility persistence is notably high (α + β ≈ 1), and negative shocks tend to increase volatility more than positive ones. Subsample analysis reveals that the influence of political stability diminished post-COVID-19, although volatility persistence remained high. These findings underscore that in thin, frontier markets, volatility serves as the primary channel through which macro-institutional forces operate. The results have policy implications for SDG 8 (promoting resilient, inclusive growth) and SDG 16 (enhancing institutional stability), highlighting the necessity for governance reforms and dynamic risk management to strengthen financial market resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了宏观经济冲击和制度质量对孟加拉国达卡证券交易所(DSEX)波动率的综合影响。研究发现政治稳定性对收益率有轻微负面影响，对波动率有正面影响，而宏观经济冲击影响较小。波动率持续性很高，负向冲击比正向冲击更易增加波动率。COVID-19后政治稳定性的影响减弱，但波动率持续性仍高。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济冲击和制度质量如何共同影响前沿经济体的股票市场波动率？
AI.motivation: 理解在薄弱的、前沿市场中，宏观制度和制度力量如何通过波动率渠道运作，为促进可持续发展和金融市场韧性提供政策启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于波动率建模理论，包括波动率聚类、持续性和杠杆效应概念，结合制度经济学和宏观经济冲击理论。
AI.method: 使用2013年2月至2025年5月的日度数据，采用对称和非对称GARCH族模型（GARCH-X、EGARCH、GJR-GARCH）分析汇率、通胀和政治稳定性冲击对股票市场的影响。
AI.findings: 宏观经济冲击对平均收益率影响很小；政治稳定性对收益率有轻微负面影响，对波动率有正面影响；波动率持续性很高（α+β≈1）；负向冲击比正向冲击更易增加波动率；COVID-19后政治稳定性影响减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对前沿市场中波动率作为宏观制度力量主要传导渠道的理解，扩展了制度质量与金融市场波动关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续发展目标8（促进韧性包容增长）和目标16（增强制度稳定性）提供政策启示，强调治理改革和动态风险管理对增强金融市场韧性的必要性。

title: Skills Mismatch in the Labor Market a Precondition of Brain -Drain Phenomenon in Developing Countries with Special Emphasis in Kosovo

detail.title: Skills Mismatch in the Labor Market a Precondition of Brain -Drain Phenomenon in Developing Countries with Special Emphasis in Kosovo

publicationDetails.detailsText: Balkan and Near Eastern Journal of Social Sciences | Ziberi, 2020: 06

detail.abstract: The main aim of this study is to analyze the skills mismatch in labor market as a precondition of brain-drain phenomenon in Kosovo as a developing country. Due to the lack of secondary data related skills mach vs.mismatch in labor market, profiles created by education and skilled migration in Kosovo, this study indirectly tries to shed light on the possibility that the mismatch of skills requirements in the job market is a precondition for brain-drain phenomenon in the future. The data used in this paper is secondary data gathered form Kosovo Agency of Statistics on the main variables in the analysis included: (i) employment rate vs. Unemployment, (ii)average wages in the public and private sector and (iii) number of students in education. This study, through descriptive and comparative analysis, concludes that although the unemployment rate in total shows a decreasing trend, within it's structure, the unemployment rate with university degrees shows an increasing trend. Seen by the growing number of university graduates, this refers to a skills mismatch in the labor market thus may be considered also as a precondition for brain-drain phenomenom in near future in case of Kosovo. The paper comes with some additional conclusions and recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析科索沃劳动力市场的技能不匹配现象，发现尽管总失业率呈下降趋势，但大学学历者的失业率却在上升，这表明存在技能不匹配问题，可能成为未来人才流失现象的前提条件。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场的技能不匹配是否构成科索沃人才流失现象的前提条件？
AI.motivation: 作为发展中国家，科索沃缺乏关于劳动力市场技能匹配与不匹配、教育培养的人才概况以及技能移民的二手数据，因此本研究间接探讨技能不匹配是否可能成为未来人才流失的前提条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能不匹配理论、人才流失理论、劳动力市场分析框架
AI.method: 使用科索沃统计局提供的二手数据进行描述性和比较分析，主要变量包括：就业率与失业率、公私部门平均工资、教育学生人数
AI.findings: 尽管总失业率呈下降趋势，但大学学历者的失业率却在上升；随着大学毕业生数量增加，这表明劳动力市场存在技能不匹配，可能成为科索沃近期人才流失现象的前提条件
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家的人才流失现象提供了技能不匹配视角的理论解释框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃政策制定者提供了关于教育体系与劳动力市场需求匹配性的实证依据，提出了应对技能不匹配和预防人才流失的政策建议

title: Public Investments Incentive Factors of Economic Growth - Case Study of Republic of North Macedonia
affiliations: and

detail.title: Public Investments Incentive Factors of Economic Growth - Case Study of Republic of North Macedonia
detail.abstract: The basic function of public finances is economic stability that implies the use of public finance instruments in order to stabilize economic cycles to achieve full employment, overall price stability, achieving an adequate rate of economic growth, a stable rate economic development. Governments to contribute to economic balances, job creation, and productivity growth tend to boost productive public spending by undertaking long-term activities in the sphere of public investment, namely public, health and education infrastructure, as well as in the sphere of research and development. Both theoretical and empirical studies conclude that public investment impacts on economic growth, represent an instrument of low growth, but their increasing effect is influenced by various factors such as economic circumstances, level of development the quality of governance, the efficient management of investment projects, the sectors in which it is invested, the capital fund, etc. The purpose of this paper is to research the short-term and long-term effects of public investments in the Republic of Northe Macedonia in economic growth. The analysis takes into account the data on the structure of public investment, gross domestic product for the time period 2008-2017. Using the multiple regression analysis OLS, we conclude that in the long run the impact of public investment on economic growth is symbolic given that a very small percentage of public expenditures for public infrastructure investments although Macedonia is characterized by a low capital public fund.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了北马其顿共和国公共投资对经济增长的短期和长期影响，发现长期影响较小，尽管该国公共资本存量较低。
AI.research_question: 北马其顿共和国公共投资对经济增长的短期和长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 公共财政的基本功能是经济稳定，政府通过公共投资促进经济平衡、就业创造和生产率增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共投资影响经济增长的理论框架，考虑经济环境、发展水平、治理质量、投资项目管理效率等因素。
AI.method: 使用2008-2017年公共投资结构和GDP数据，采用OLS多元回归分析。
AI.findings: 长期来看，公共投资对经济增长的影响较小，公共基础设施投资支出占比很小。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了公共投资对经济增长的影响在不同国家背景下的差异性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为北马其顿政府优化公共投资政策提供实证依据，建议提高公共投资效率。

title: The Financial Inclusion-Health Nexus: Evidence from India, China, and the UAE
affiliations: New Delhi Institute of Management, Amity University Dubai, New Delhi Institute of Management,  and New Delhi Institute of Management

detail.title: The Financial Inclusion-Health Nexus: Evidence from India, China, and the UAE
detail.abstract: This study explores the nexus between financial inclusion and public health outcomes across India, China, and the United Arab Emirates from 2009 to 2023. Employing a pooled Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) framework, the analysis examines two key health indicators—infant mortality rate and life expectancy at birth —in relation to a composite Financial Inclusion Index and a set of socio-economic controls including inequality, poverty, institutional quality, demographics, and macroeconomic conditions. The results highlight under-5 mortality as the most robust determinant, significantly elevating infant mortality while reducing life expectancy, thereby underscoring its pivotal role in shaping population health. Institutional quality, proxied by the Rule of Law, also exerts a positive influence on life expectancy, though its unexpected association with infant mortality points to potential specification and endogeneity challenges. While the direct effects of financial inclusion, inequality, and inflation appear statistically weak, their indirect role through broader socio-economic pathways cannot be discounted. The findings stress the importance of integrating maternal and child healthcare interventions with institutional strengthening to achieve sustainable health improvements. By situating financial inclusion within a wider socio-economic and governance framework, this study contributes to both academic debates and evidence-based policymaking, advancing the discourse on finance as a lever for inclusive and equitable health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了2009-2023年印度、中国和阿联酋的金融包容性与公共卫生结果之间的关系，发现5岁以下儿童死亡率是最稳健的决定因素，而制度质量对预期寿命有积极影响。
AI.research_question: 金融包容性与公共卫生结果（婴儿死亡率和出生时预期寿命）之间在印度、中国和阿联酋的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 将金融包容性置于更广泛的社会经济和治理框架中，探讨金融作为促进包容性和公平健康结果的杠杆作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、公共卫生理论、制度经济学理论
AI.method: 采用混合OLS框架，分析金融包容性指数与健康指标（婴儿死亡率和出生时预期寿命）的关系，控制社会经济变量如不平等、贫困、制度质量、人口统计和宏观经济条件。
AI.findings: 5岁以下儿童死亡率是最稳健的决定因素，显著提高婴儿死亡率并降低预期寿命；制度质量（以法治为代表）对预期寿命有积极影响；金融包容性、不平等和通胀的直接效应统计上较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融包容性置于更广泛的社会经济和治理框架中，推进金融作为促进包容性和公平健康结果的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调将妇幼保健干预与制度强化相结合以实现可持续健康改善的重要性，为循证决策提供依据。

title: Will the New Supply of Western Weapons Change the Directions of the Ukraine War?
affiliations: Department of International Relations, University of Dhaka

detail.title: Will the New Supply of Western Weapons Change the Directions of the Ukraine War?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declared no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study complied with all ethical procedures related to it.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for the research.

detail.abstract: Ukrainian forces incessantly countered the Russian invasion of their country, since the atrocity began in February 2022, using Soviet-era armoured vehicles, aircraft, tanks, artillery and so on, along with some specific cutting-edge weapons and relevant technologies given by the West, such as Javelin anti-tank missiles, Leopard 2 tanks, M142 multiple rocket launcher, or HIMARS and many more. However, the war was already looking dreadful for the Russian military when packages of aid from Ukraine’s peers started arriving and helped change the course of the conflict. By that time, Western artillery and vehicles arrived, followed by artillery ammunition and after that in June 2022, HIMARS was also supplied to Ukraine. In this regard, the High Mobility Artillery Rocket System provided by the West are observed well-competent to whack a target at a range of approximately 80 kilometers (50 miles). Thenceforth, Russian supply depots and command centers were attacked shortly well beyond the front lines. Moreover, in the first few weeks of 2023, Western nations made promises to supply large quantities of heavy armour, including cutting-edge tanks and rocket-launched glide bombs known as ‘Ground-Launched Small Diameter Bombs’ (GLSDB), capable of striking targets at ranges of up to 150 kilometers (93 miles). However, in this respect, the U.S. Secretary of State, Antony Blinken, exhibited his wholehearted support for January’s $2.5 billion aid package by saying that it will “support Ukraine as it valiantly defends its people, its sovereignty, and its territorial integrity.” In a similar vein, NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg said, “Our backing is making a real difference for the Ukrainians.” He also mentioned that this aid is not with a view to only ensuring their survival, but also to repelling the Russian invasion and reclaiming their land.

AI.tldr: 乌克兰使用苏联时代装备和西方先进武器系统（如HIMARS、Javelin导弹等）抵抗俄罗斯入侵，西方援助特别是远程精确打击武器改变了战场态势，使乌克兰能够打击俄军后方补给线和指挥中心。
AI.research_question: 西方军事援助特别是远程精确打击武器如何影响乌克兰战争进程？
AI.motivation: 分析西方先进武器系统在乌克兰战争中的关键作用，特别是远程打击能力对战场态势的改变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 军事技术优势理论、不对称战争理论、远程精确打击理论
AI.method: 基于乌克兰战争实际案例的实证分析，重点考察HIMARS、GLSDB等武器系统的战场表现
AI.findings: 西方提供的远程精确打击武器（HIMARS射程80公里，GLSDB射程150公里）显著改变了战场态势，使乌克兰能够有效打击俄军后方目标，扭转了战争初期的不利局面。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了远程精确打击武器在现代战争中的决定性作用，为不对称战争理论提供了新的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事援助政策制定提供参考，强调远程精确打击能力在现代冲突中的战略价值，对国防装备发展具有指导意义。
