title: Credit Risk Modeling using Machine Learning Techniques
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Credit Risk Modeling using Machine Learning Techniques

publicationDetails.detailsText: No, this paper has not appeared nor been accepted to appear in any Paper Series, Journal, or Book.

detail.abstract: Credit risk assessment is a critical function in financial institutions, as it determines the likelihood of borrowers defaulting on loans. The objective of this project is to develop and compare predictive models for credit risk classification using multiple machine learning techniques, namely Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost. A structured dataset was utilized, containing financial and demographic attributes of borrowers. Data preprocessing steps included encoding categorical variables, scaling numerical features, and handling class imbalances to ensure robust modeling. The methodology involves data preprocessing, feature encoding, and model development using four machine learning algorithms: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost. The models were evaluated using performance metrics such as accuracy, confusion matrix, ROC curve, and AUC score. The tools used for implementation include Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost, pandas, matplotlib, seaborn) for data analysis and model building, along with Power BI for visualization and dashboard creation. The models were evaluated based on performance metrics such as accuracy, confusion matrix, classification report, ROC curve, and AUC score. Results indicate that while Logistic Regression and Decision Trees provide interpretability, ensemble methods such as Random Forest and XGBoost achieved superior predictive performance, with XGBoost attaining the highest AUC score of 0.95. This demonstrates its strong capability in distinguishing between defaulters and non-defaulters. Overall, this project highlights the importance of advanced machine learning techniques in credit risk modeling, enabling financial institutions to minimize default risk and make data-driven lending decisions. The study also emphasizes the practical implications of adopting predictive analytics to enhance credit evaluation processes and improve organizational decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并比较了多种机器学习模型（逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林、XGBoost）用于信用风险分类，发现XGBoost模型表现最佳（AUC=0.95），强调机器学习在信用风险评估中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 哪种机器学习模型在信用风险分类中表现最优？
AI.motivation: 信用风险评估对金融机构至关重要，需要准确预测借款人违约概率以降低风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习分类理论，包括逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林和XGBoost算法。
AI.method: 使用包含借款人财务和人口统计特征的结构化数据集，进行数据预处理、特征编码，并应用四种机器学习算法建模。
AI.findings: XGBoost模型表现最佳（AUC=0.95），随机森林次之，逻辑回归和决策树虽然可解释性强但预测性能较差。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了集成学习方法在信用风险分类中的优越性，特别是XGBoost算法的高效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了有效的信用风险评估工具，有助于降低违约风险并支持数据驱动的贷款决策。

title: Geopolitical Barriers to Globalization
affiliations: Yale University, Yale University and Yale University

detail.title: Geopolitical Barriers to Globalization
detail.abstract: This paper systematically estimates and quantifies how geopolitical alignment shapes global trade across three distinct eras: the Cold War, hyper-globalization, and contemporary fragmentation. We construct a novel measure of bilateral alignment using large language models to compile and analyze 833,485 political events spanning 193 countries from 1950 to 2024. Our analysis reveals that trade flows systematically track geopolitical alignment in both bilateral relationships and aggregate patterns. Using local projections within a gravity framework, we estimate that a one-standard-deviation improvement in geopolitical alignment increases bilateral trade by 20 percent over ten years. Integrating these elasticities into a quantitative general equilibrium model, we find that deteriorating geopolitical relations have reduced global trade by 7 percentage points between 1995 and 2020. Our findings provide empirical benchmarks for evaluating the costs of geopolitical fragmentation in an era of renewed great power competition.

AI.tldr: 本文系统估计了地缘政治结盟如何影响全球贸易，发现双边关系改善一个标准差可使贸易增长20%，而1995-2020年间地缘政治关系恶化导致全球贸易减少7个百分点。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治结盟如何塑造全球贸易模式？
AI.motivation: 在冷战、超全球化和当代碎片化三个不同时代，系统量化地缘政治结盟对全球贸易的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于重力模型框架，结合地缘政治结盟理论。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型构建双边结盟新指标，分析1950-2024年833,485个政治事件；在重力框架内使用局部投影法；整合弹性到定量一般均衡模型。
AI.findings: 贸易流动系统地跟踪地缘政治结盟；双边关系改善一个标准差可使贸易十年内增长20%；1995-2020年地缘政治关系恶化导致全球贸易减少7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了地缘政治结盟影响贸易的实证基准，为评估地缘政治碎片化成本提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估大国竞争时代地缘政治碎片化对贸易的实际影响提供量化参考。

title: The End of Game Theory: Designing Positive-Sum Systems for the Digital Commons
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The End of Game Theory: Designing Positive-Sum Systems for the Digital Commons
detail.abstract: This paper argues that the classical framework of game theory, grounded in scarcity and adversarial strategy, is increasingly obsolete in the digital era. While Hardin (1968) predicted the inevitable tragedy of the commons, and Ostrom (1990) demonstrated that cooperation could prevent collapse, both frameworks assumed that self-interest must be restrained for the collective to endure. I propose something more radical: systems can be designed where self-interest itself strengthens the commons. In these positive-sum systems, free riders do not deplete value but expand it. Participation, even selfish participation, becomes generative. This shift redefines economics and governance: instead of mitigating scarcity, we can design infrastructures where collapse is structurally impossible and abundance is the default outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文认为基于稀缺性和对抗性策略的经典博弈论框架在数字时代已过时。作者提出可以设计让自利行为强化公共资源的系统，在这种正和系统中，搭便车者不会消耗价值而是扩展价值。参与行为（即使是自私的）变得具有生成性，从而重新定义经济学和治理方式。
AI.research_question: 如何在数字时代重新设计系统，使自利行为能够强化而非破坏公共资源？
AI.motivation: 经典博弈论框架（如哈丁的公地悲剧理论和奥斯特罗姆的合作理论）都假设需要约束自利行为来维持集体利益，但在数字时代这种假设可能过时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈丁的公地悲剧理论、奥斯特罗姆的公共资源治理理论、正和博弈理论、生成性系统设计
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建
AI.findings: 可以设计系统使自利行为增强公共资源，在这种系统中搭便车者扩展而非消耗价值，参与行为具有生成性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从零和博弈到正和系统的理论转变，重新定义了自利行为在公共资源治理中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字时代的经济学和治理提供了新范式，展示了如何设计结构上不可能崩溃且默认产生丰裕的基础设施。

title: The Credibility Chasm: U.S. Executive Power Contestation and the Erosion of Trust in Allied AI Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Montreal

detail.title: The Credibility Chasm: U.S. Executive Power Contestation and the Erosion of Trust in Allied AI Supply Chains

keywords: Allied Relations and Supply Chain Instability

detail.abstract: This paper examines how the United States' use of broad, executive-led legal frameworks for artificial intelligence (AI) and trade creates a "credibility chasm" that weakens its key alliances. It's about the legal battles over executive power. Our purpose is to show how unpredictable cooperation with Canada hurts investment and weakens AI supply chains. This instability poses a risk to the collective democratic advantage against global rivals. The findings, therefore, emphasize the urgent need for a more predictable and legally stable governance framework for AI.

AI.tldr: 美国通过行政主导的AI和贸易法律框架造成"可信度鸿沟"，削弱了其关键联盟，特别是与加拿大的合作不可预测性损害了投资和AI供应链，威胁民主优势。
AI.research_question: 美国使用行政主导的AI和贸易法律框架如何影响其关键联盟关系？
AI.motivation: 展示与加拿大合作的不可预测性如何损害投资和削弱AI供应链，这种不稳定性对集体民主优势构成风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政权力与法律框架的可信度理论，联盟稳定性理论
AI.method: 法律分析框架，案例研究
AI.findings: 行政主导的法律框架造成可信度鸿沟，削弱联盟关系，不可预测的合作损害投资和AI供应链稳定性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可信度鸿沟"概念，深化了对行政权力与联盟稳定性关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 强调迫切需要建立更可预测和法律稳定的AI治理框架

title: The Recommendation Principle in Information Design
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Bologna - Department of Economics and Brown University

detail.title: The Recommendation Principle in Information Design
detail.abstract: The recommendation principle states that, without losing generality, a sender can focus on experiments in which messages are recommendations in the receiver’s action space. We study the general validity of the recommendation principle and characterize the conditions under which it holds in persuasive communication settings. Using our characterization, we construct a simple test that asserts the validity of the recommendation principle. We apply our test to examples in the literature where the principle has been assumed or proved for that specific application.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了推荐原则在说服性沟通中的一般有效性，构建了验证该原则有效性的简单测试方法，并应用于文献中的具体案例。
AI.research_question: 推荐原则在什么条件下在说服性沟通环境中成立？
AI.motivation: 推荐原则声称发送者可以专注于在接收者行动空间中的推荐实验，但其一般有效性尚未得到系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 说服性沟通理论、推荐原则、博弈论中的信息设计
AI.method: 理论分析、条件特征化、测试构建、案例应用
AI.findings: 确定了推荐原则成立的具体条件，构建了验证该原则有效性的简单测试方法
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化地研究了推荐原则的一般有效性，提供了理论上的严格条件特征
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和实践者提供了验证推荐原则有效性的实用测试工具

title: The Impact of Covid-19 on the Consumers’ Behaviour: The Case of Republic of Kosovo Economy
affiliations: , AAB College and AAB College

detail.title: The Impact of Covid-19 on the Consumers’ Behaviour: The Case of Republic of Kosovo Economy
detail.abstract: The main aim of this paper is to analyze the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on personal consumption expenditures (PCE) in the case of Kosovo. Labor factor has been considered as the holder of the economic activity, however, manpower, namely its broader term population is at the same time the user of the product and the services, i.e., the result of the economic activity (Škuflić & Šokčević, 2010) Taking into consideration that COVID-19 is harming the labor market and in economic activity in general, we also consider that this situation is affecting the personal consumption expenditures in case of Kosovo, domestic demand, supported by low-interest rates and strong employment growth, will remain the main driver of growth (OECD, 2018). To analyze the importance of personal consumption expenditure in the case of Kosovo during the COVID-19 pandemic we used secondary data from World Bank documents and primary data collected via an online questionnaire that was randomly distributed using social media with a sample of 233 respondents. The data analysis concludes descriptive statistics, frequency tables and charts, Pearson correlation, Cronbach's alpha, and Chi-square test. To conduct the results, the SPSS program is used. The study concludes that the COVID-19 pandemic has impacted personal consumption expenditures and shifted the consumption from luxury to essential products. The study also concludes that citizens will realize the pre-planned expenditures as soon as the anti-COVID-19 measures will be released.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了COVID-19大流行对科索沃个人消费支出的影响，发现疫情促使消费从奢侈品转向必需品，且公民将在防疫措施解除后恢复原计划的支出。
AI.research_question: COVID-19大流行如何影响科索沃的个人消费支出？
AI.motivation: COVID-19对劳动力市场和经济活动造成损害，进而可能影响个人消费支出，而个人消费支出是经济增长的主要驱动力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力作为经济活动的主体，同时也是产品和服务的使用者（Škuflić & Šokčević, 2010）；国内需求在低利率和强劲就业增长支持下是增长的主要驱动力（OECD, 2018）。
AI.method: 使用世界银行文件的二手数据和通过社交媒体随机分发的在线问卷收集的一手数据（样本量233人），数据分析包括描述性统计、频率表和图表、Pearson相关、Cronbach's alpha和卡方检验，使用SPSS程序进行分析。
AI.findings: COVID-19大流行影响了个人消费支出，使消费从奢侈品转向必需品；公民将在反COVID-19措施解除后实现原计划的支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了疫情对消费行为的影响理论，特别是在危机时期消费从非必需品向必需品的转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于疫情对消费影响的实证证据，有助于制定应对策略；为企业提供了消费者行为变化的洞察，以调整产品和服务策略。

title: The Econometric Approach of the Impact of Public Investment in the Road-Infrastructure in the Economic Growth of Kosovo
affiliations: ,  and AAB College

detail.title: The Econometric Approach of the Impact of Public Investment in the Road-Infrastructure in the Economic Growth of Kosovo

publicationDetails.detailsText: Management Dynamics in the Knowledge Economy, volume 9, issue 1, 2021[10.2478/mdke-2021-0001]

detail.abstract: Economic growth and public investments are considered the most challenging problems faced by most countries around the world, including Kosovo. Various assumptions have been made that better and higher-quality transport is essential for the country's economic development. This study aims to analyze the relationship and the impact of public investments in road infrastructure on Kosovo's economic growth taking into analysis also other macroeconomics aggregates such as Consumption, Investment, Exports, and Imports. Two important aspects have been addressed within the extensive literature review, namely theoretical analysis of different studies elaborating on elements regarding infrastructure in general, such as social and economic infrastructure, and road infrastructure in particular. To analyze the impact of public investments in road infrastructure and other macroeconomics aggregates over Kosovo's economic growth, the econometric multiple regression model Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), the Pearson Correlation, and the Test for heteroskedasticity have been applied. The data used is secondary data obtain from the World Bank Indicators, Kosovo Agency of Statistics, and the Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo. All these models are tested with the STATA software program. Based on regression analysis, we can conclude that public investments in road infrastructure for Kosovo's economic growth are non-significant as their effect is manifested in the long run, but all the other independent variables from the OLS model are significant and impact the GDP growth of Kosovo. The study comes with some other conclusions, suggestions and opens paths for future researchers.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了科索沃公路基础设施公共投资对经济增长的影响，发现公路投资在短期内对GDP增长影响不显著，但其他宏观经济变量（消费、投资、出口、进口）对经济增长有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 公路基础设施公共投资对科索沃经济增长的影响关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 经济增长和公共投资是全球各国面临的最具挑战性问题，科索沃也不例外。普遍认为更好更高质量的交通对国家经济发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施理论（包括社会和经济基础设施）、公路基础设施理论、宏观经济理论
AI.method: 计量经济学多元回归模型（OLS）、皮尔逊相关分析、异方差性检验，使用STATA软件分析来自世界银行、科索沃统计局和官方公报的二手数据
AI.findings: 公路基础设施公共投资对科索沃经济增长在统计上不显著，其影响主要体现在长期；但其他自变量（消费、投资、出口、进口）对GDP增长有显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家基础设施投资与经济增长关系研究提供实证证据，验证了基础设施投资长期效应的理论假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃政府制定公共投资政策提供参考，建议关注其他宏观经济变量对经济增长的即时影响，为未来研究者开辟新的研究方向

title: Mitigating Financial Investment Polarization: The Role of Digital Payments in Enhancing Household Participation
affiliations: , Sichuan University - Business School and Xiamen University - School of Economics

detail.title: Mitigating Financial Investment Polarization: The Role of Digital Payments in Enhancing Household Participation
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of digital payments on household financial asset investment, using the China Household Finance Survey (2013-2019). Our findings indicate that digital payments positively affect financial market participation and investment size, reshaping asset allocation structures. While households using digital payments show increased participation and investment amounts across various financial assets, a reduction in the weight of deposits is evident. The study highlights two key channels through which digital payments influence financial behavior: enhancing subjective financial literacy and increasing households' attention to financial information. The research emphasizes the role of digital payments in mitigating polarization effects in household financial asset allocation.

AI.tldr: 基于中国家庭金融调查数据(2013-2019)，研究发现数字支付通过提升主观金融素养和增加金融信息关注度，促进家庭金融市场参与和投资规模，重塑资产配置结构，减少存款比重，缓解家庭金融资产配置的两极化效应。
AI.research_question: 数字支付如何影响家庭金融资产投资？
AI.motivation: 随着数字支付的普及，研究其对家庭金融行为的影响具有重要现实意义，特别是在缓解金融资产配置两极化方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融素养理论和信息关注理论，探讨数字支付影响家庭金融行为的机制。
AI.method: 使用中国家庭金融调查(2013-2019)数据，实证分析数字支付对家庭金融资产投资的影响。
AI.findings: 数字支付显著促进家庭金融市场参与和投资规模，改变资产配置结构，降低存款比重；主要通过提升主观金融素养和增加金融信息关注度两个渠道发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字支付影响家庭金融行为的作用机制，丰富了金融科技与家庭金融决策的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过数字支付促进普惠金融、缓解家庭金融资产配置两极化的实践路径。

reference: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 05/2025
title: SCION and Cross-Border Payments: Enhancing Security and Compliance in Distributed Ledger Networks
affiliations: Princeton University - Princeton University, ETH Zurich, Swiss National Bank and ETH Zurich

detail.title: SCION and Cross-Border Payments: Enhancing Security and Compliance in Distributed Ledger Networks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 05/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss National Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Cross-border payments remain expensive, slow, and opaque due to reliance on correspondent banking. Distributed ledger technology (DLT) offers a possible alternative, enabling peer-to-peer transactions at lower cost with greater speed, transparency, and resilience. However, DLT systems largely rely on the public Internet, which exposes them to network-based outages and attacks. SCION, a secure next-generation Internet architecture, can operate side-by-side with today's Internet to mitigate network-related risks. In addition to the security benefits, SCION also provides a novel approach to enforce regulatory compliance on a permissionless DLT with a governance model well-suited for multi-jurisdictional platforms. We present the first practical blueprint for deploying a DLT-based settlement system on SCION and demonstrate, through a simulation-based analysis of the real-world DLT system Sui, that SCION can mitigate more than half of routing-based network attacks, even when only partially adopted by DLT validators. Overall, SCION can provide a robust infrastructure foundation for DLT-based cross-border payment systems by enhancing their security, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了在SCION下一代互联网架构上部署基于分布式账本技术（DLT）的跨境支付系统的首个实用蓝图，通过仿真分析证明SCION能够减轻超过一半的路由网络攻击，增强系统的安全性、可靠性和监管合规性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用SCION安全下一代互联网架构来增强基于DLT的跨境支付系统的网络安全性、可靠性和监管合规性？
AI.motivation: 跨境支付目前依赖代理银行体系，存在成本高、速度慢、透明度低的问题。DLT技术虽然提供了替代方案，但其基于公共互联网的特性使其面临网络中断和攻击风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式账本技术（DLT）、SCION安全互联网架构、跨境支付系统理论、网络安全理论
AI.method: 仿真分析方法，基于真实DLT系统Sui进行模拟，分析SCION架构对网络攻击的缓解效果
AI.findings: SCION能够减轻超过一半的路由网络攻击，即使DLT验证者仅部分采用SCION架构；SCION提供了在无需许可DLT上执行监管合规的新方法
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个在SCION架构上部署DLT支付系统的实用蓝图；建立了SCION与DLT集成的新型安全模型；发展了多司法管辖区平台的治理模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为基于DLT的跨境支付系统提供了更安全、可靠的基础设施解决方案；增强了系统的监管合规能力；降低了网络攻击风险

title: Evaluating the Extent to Which China's Development Projects Abroad Classify as "Debt Diplomacy"
affiliations: , ,  and Global Virtual Model United Nations

detail.title: Evaluating the Extent to Which China's Development Projects Abroad Classify as "Debt Diplomacy"
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether China's overseas development projects, particularly under the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), constitute "debt diplomacy," defined as lending designed to create dependency and extract strategic concessions. Using four evaluative criteria including intentionality, loan design, remedies under distress, and systemic patterns, the study analyzes three prominent cases: Sri Lanka's Hambantota port, Pakistan's Gwadar port, and Kenya's Standard Gauge Railway. The analysis finds that outcomes are more complex than the debt trap narrative suggests. In Sri Lanka, debt distress was driven largely by international sovereign bonds rather than Chinese loans. Pakistan's Gwadar port reveals asymmetrical terms and local unrest, yet strategic influence emerges alongside Pakistani agency and governance failures. Kenya's railway shows how Chinese financing delivers infrastructure gains while raising sustainability concerns tied to weak oversight. The study concludes that while elements of debt diplomacy exist, China's lending is best understood as a context-dependent mix of development finance, strategic consequences, and borrower agency.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察中国海外发展项目是否构成"债务外交"，通过四个评估标准分析三个案例，发现结果比债务陷阱叙事更复杂，中国贷款应理解为发展融资、战略后果和借款国能动性的混合体。
AI.research_question: 中国的海外发展项目（特别是"一带一路"倡议下的项目）是否构成"债务外交"？
AI.motivation: 探讨关于中国"一带一路"倡议下贷款是否旨在创造依赖性和获取战略让步的争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债务外交理论，包括意向性、贷款设计、困境下的补救措施和系统性模式四个评估标准。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析斯里兰卡汉班托塔港、巴基斯坦瓜达尔港和肯尼亚标准轨距铁路三个典型案例。
AI.findings: 1）斯里兰卡债务困境主要由国际主权债券而非中国贷款驱动；2）巴基斯坦案例显示不对称条款和当地动荡，但战略影响力与巴基斯坦能动性和治理失败并存；3）肯尼亚案例表明中国融资带来基础设施收益，但引发与监管薄弱相关的可持续性担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了简化的"债务陷阱"叙事，提出了更复杂的理解框架，强调情境依赖性和借款国能动性。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Economics, Management and Sustainability, volume 6, issue 1, 2021[10.14254/jems.2021.6-1.5]

detail.abstract: Public spending as an important component of the composition of GDP has an impact on economic growth and development. The main purpose of this paper is to analyze the effects of disaggregated public expenditures, to measure the impact of current expenditures, transfers and subsidies, and capital expenditures as part of total government expenditures on economic growth and development of the Republic of Kosovo. To achieve the main goal of the paper was used the multiple linear regression model (OLS) and Pearson. The regression model has been modified and adapted to measure the regression of public spending on economic growth in Kosovo. The data used in the paper are secondary and collected from the Ministry of Finance of Kosovo, Agency of Statistics, and the Tax Administration of Kosovo. Data processing was done with SPSS. The results of the analysis show that the trend of Kosovo public spending for the analyzed period is increasing. According to Pearson correlation analysis, the results show that current public spending; transfers, and subsidies have a strong positive correlation to Gross Domestic Product. Whereas capital (investment) expenditures have a weaker positive correlation with GDP. The results of OLS regression, in our case, did not show the significance of independent variables, which means that the pubic expenses do not have an impact on economic growth in Kosovo.

title: Human Capital Accumulation Across Space
affiliations: Southern Methodist University (SMU), Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) - Centre de Recerca en Economia Internacional (CREI) and University of Chicago

detail.title: Human Capital Accumulation Across Space
detail.abstract:
This paper studies how human capital shapes the economic geography of development. We develop a model in which the cost of acquiring human capital varies across space, and regions with higher human capital innovate more. Locations are spatially connected through migration and trade. There are localized agglomeration economies, and human-capital-augmenting technology diffuses across space. Using high-resolution data on income and schooling, we quantify and simulate the model at the 1° x 1° resolution for the entire globe. Over the span of two centuries, the model predicts strong persistence in the spatial distribution of development — unlike spatial dynamic models without human capital, which predict convergence. Proportionally lowering the cost of education in sub-Saharan Africa or Central and South Asia raises local outcomes but reduces global welfare, whereas the same policy in Latin America improves global outcomes. An alternative policy equalizing educational costs across sub-Saharan Africa generates relatively worse outcomes, as population reallocates within the region toward less productive areas. Central to these results is the estimated negative correlation between the education costs and local fundamentals, as well as inefficiencies in the spatial allocation due to externalities.

title: What Does It Take? Quantifying Cross-Country Transfers in the Eurozone
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, , Stanford University and Stanford University

detail.title: What Does It Take? Quantifying Cross-Country Transfers in the Eurozone
detail.abstract:
We compute the cross-country transfers that result from unconventional monetary policy in the Eurozone. The ECB funds the expansion of its aggregate balance sheet mostly by issuing bank reserves and cash in core countries. The national central banks (NCBs) in periphery countries then borrow from the core NCBs at below-market rates to fund the asset purchases and bank lending. In addition, NCBs in the periphery lend more to their own banks at below-market rates. To compute the cross-country transfers, we compare the resulting cross-country distribution of NCB income to a counterfactual scenario without the ECB and without non-marketable intra-Eurozone debt. We document significant and persistent transfers from the core to the periphery.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Bond Convenience Yields in the Eurozone Currency Union
affiliations: , Stanford University, Columbia University Graduate School of Business and University of Texas, Austin - Department of Finance

detail.title: Bond Convenience Yields in the Eurozone Currency Union
detail.abstract:
In a monetary union, the risk-free rate cannot adjust to country-level fiscal positions, leaving only default spreads and convenience yields to respond. Empirically, we find that convenience yields explain a large share of the variation in Eurozone sovereign bond yields. Eurozone sovereign bonds earn larger convenience yields when their governments run larger surpluses. Since convenience yields generate substantial seigniorage revenue from debt issuance, our estimates imply economically large fiscal costs from low convenience yields for peripheral countries in the Eurozone.

title: Understanding and Addressing Temperature Impacts on Mortality
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Earth System Science and the FSE, Stanford University, Stanford, Stanford University, Stanford University, , Indiana University Bloomington, University of Washington, Stanford University, Stanford University, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - School of Public Health, Stanford University - Center on Food Security and the Environment, Stanford University, State University of New York (SUNY), Stanford University and Stanford University

detail.title: Understanding and Addressing Temperature Impacts on Mortality
detail.abstract:
A large literature documents how ambient temperature affects human mortality. Using decades of detailed data from 30 countries, we revisit and synthesize key findings from this literature. We confirm that ambient temperature is among the largest external threats to human health, and is responsible for a remarkable 5-12% of total deaths across countries in our sample, or hundreds of thousands of deaths per year in both the U.S. and EU. In all contexts we consider, cold kills more than heat, though the temperature of minimum risk rises with age, making younger individuals more vulnerable to heat and older individuals more vulnerable to cold. We find evidence for adaptation to the local climate, with hotter places experiencing somewhat lower risk at higher temperatures, but still more overall mortality from heat due to more frequent exposure. Within countries, higher income is not associated with uniformly lower vulnerability to ambient temperature, and the overall burden of mortality from ambient temperature is not falling over time. Finally, we systematically summarize the limited set of studies that rigorously evaluate interventions that can reduce the impact of heat and cold on health. We find that many proposed and implemented policy interventions lack empirical support and do not target temperature exposures that generate the highest health burden, and that some of the most beneficial interventions for reducing the health impacts of cold or heat have little explicit to do with climate.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过30个国家几十年的详细数据，重新审视环境温度对人类死亡率的影响。研究发现环境温度是人类健康的最大外部威胁之一，在样本国家中造成5-12%的总死亡，每年在美国和欧盟导致数十万人死亡。寒冷比炎热造成更多死亡，但最低风险温度随年龄增长而上升。存在对当地气候的适应现象，但高温地区仍因更频繁暴露而承受更多热相关死亡。收入与温度脆弱性关系不明确，且温度相关死亡负担未随时间下降。现有干预措施缺乏实证支持且未针对最高健康负担的温度暴露。

AI.motivation: 环境温度作为重要的外部健康威胁，现有文献对其影响程度、分布特征和干预效果缺乏系统性评估，需要基于大规模跨国数据重新审视和整合关键发现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境流行病学和气候健康关系理论，探讨温度暴露与死亡率之间的剂量反应关系，以及适应机制、社会经济因素在其中的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用30个国家几十年的详细死亡率数据，采用计量经济学方法分析温度与死亡率的关系，考察年龄、地区、收入等因素的调节效应，并系统评估现有干预措施的有效性。

AI.theory_contributions: 1)系统量化了环境温度对健康的总体影响；2)揭示了年龄、地区差异在温度脆弱性中的作用；3)挑战了收入与温度脆弱性的简单线性关系假设；4)提供了气候适应机制的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)为公共卫生政策制定提供温度相关健康风险的量化依据；2)指出现有干预措施的不足和改进方向；3)强调需要针对最高健康负担的温度暴露设计更有效的干预策略。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Economics and Business, volume 34, issue 1, 2020[10.2478/eb-2020-0019]

detail.abstract: The main aim of this study is to analyse the trend of public spending dedicated to education in case of Kosovo over the years and to measure the impact of public spending in education on economic growth of Kosovo. In order to achieve the aim, the Pearson Correlation has been used and a multifactorial regression model (OLS) has been modified and adapted, where we have determined the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) as a dependent variable and as an independent variable in the model: (i) Public expenditure on secondary education and (ii) Public expenditure on higher education (university). The data used are secondary data from the Kosovo's State Budget, Ministry of Finance and Transfers, and Kosovo Agency of Statistics. We have come to a conclusion that public spending dedicated to higher education (university) has a positive impact on Kosovo's economic growth meanwhile public spending on secondary education does not show any effect. The paper suggests further recommendations on public spending policies dedicated to education in order to influence Kosovo's economic growth.

title: Group versus Individual Coaching for Rural Social Protection Programs: Evidence from Uganda, Philippines, and Bangladesh
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor, University of Vermont - Department of Economics, Northwestern University - Buffett Institute for Global Studies, BRAC, University of Oxford - Department of Economics, Innovations for Poverty Action, BRAC University, Northwestern University, BRAC University, Innovations for Poverty Action, , University of Tokyo, Northwestern University and University of Oxford

detail.title: Group versus Individual Coaching for Rural Social Protection Programs: Evidence from Uganda, Philippines, and Bangladesh
detail.abstract:
Multifaceted social protection programs in low-income countries often include both capital grants and informational and behavioral support on the premise that households face simultaneous and multiple frictions. To tackle informational and behavioral constraints, programs typically deploy either individual or group coaching visits from field agents. The relative efficacy of individual versus group coaching could provide insights into the underlying mechanism through which information and behavioral support change household decisions. However, in three similar randomized evaluations in Uganda, the Philippines, and Bangladesh, we find no differences in efficacy. Given its 15–20% lower costs, group coaching is more cost-effective.

title: Genius on Demand: The Value of Transformative Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Genius on Demand: The Value of Transformative Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how the emergence of transformative AI systems providing ``genius on demand" would affect knowledge worker allocation and labour market outcomes. We develop a simple model distinguishing between routine knowledge workers, who can only apply existing knowledge with some uncertainty, and genius workers, who create new knowledge at a cost increasing with distance from a known point. When genius capacity is scarce, we find it should be allocated primarily to questions at domain boundaries rather than at midpoints between known answers. The introduction of AI geniuses fundamentally transforms this allocation. In the short run, human geniuses specialise in questions that are furthest from existing knowledge, where their comparative advantage over AI is greatest. In the long run, routine workers may be completely displaced if AI efficiency approaches human genius efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当AI系统能够提供"按需天才"服务时，对知识工作者分配和劳动力市场的影响。模型区分常规知识工作者和天才工作者，发现AI天才的出现会改变人才分配模式，短期内人类天才专注于AI优势较小的领域，长期可能完全替代常规工作者。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统能够提供"按需天才"服务时，这将如何影响知识工作者的分配和劳动力市场结果？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统能力的快速发展，特别是能够提供"天才级"知识创造服务，这将对知识工作者的角色和劳动力市场产生深远影响，需要理解这种转变的机制和后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个简单模型，区分两类知识工作者：常规知识工作者（只能应用现有知识但存在不确定性）和天才工作者（能够创造新知识但成本随距离已知点增加而增加）。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过构建数学模型来分析天才能力稀缺和AI天才引入两种情况下的最优人才分配策略。
AI.findings: 1）当天才能力稀缺时，应主要分配到领域边界问题而非已知答案中点；2）AI天才引入后，短期内人类天才专注于离现有知识最远的问题；3）长期来看，如果AI效率接近人类天才效率，常规工作者可能被完全替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个分析AI天才对知识工作者分配影响的理论框架，揭示了在不同技术发展阶段的最优人才配置策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了关于AI时代人才配置的指导，帮助理解AI对劳动力市场的短期和长期影响，以及人类工作者如何适应这种变革。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Research and Development
affiliations: Northwestern University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Research and Development
detail.abstract:
How much can AI accelerate progress in different research fields? This paper shows that three features—the share of research tasks AI performs, the productivity of AI at those tasks, and the strength of bottlenecks—are key determinants of AI’s implications in any area, from cancer therapeutics to software design. The model maps changes in AI capabilities to research outcomes, quantifies the “marginal returns to intelligence,” and shows how AI can shift returns to R&D investment. Concepts like superintelligence, Powerful AI, and Transformative AI are further engaged and disciplined. Finally, the framework sets a measurement agenda linking AI benchmarks to field-specific opportunities for accelerating progress.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个分析AI如何加速不同研究领域进展的框架，重点关注三个关键特征：AI执行研究任务的份额、AI在这些任务上的生产力以及瓶颈强度。该模型将AI能力变化映射到研究成果，量化"智能边际回报"，并展示AI如何改变研发投资回报。
AI.research_question: AI在不同研究领域能多大程度加速研究进展？
AI.motivation: 理解AI对研究进展的影响机制，为评估AI在不同领域的潜在影响提供理论框架
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI能力与研究成果映射的模型框架，包含任务份额、生产力和瓶颈三个关键维度
AI.method: 理论建模方法，建立AI能力变化与研究成果的量化关系模型
AI.findings: AI对研究进展的影响取决于三个关键特征：任务份额、生产力和瓶颈强度；AI能够改变研发投资的边际回报
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析AI加速研究进展的理论框架，量化了"智能边际回报"概念，规范了超级智能、强大AI和变革性AI等概念
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估AI在不同研究领域的潜在影响提供了测量议程，将AI基准与领域特定的加速机会联系起来

title: The Impact of AI and Digital Platforms on the Information Ecosystem
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance and Columbia University

detail.title: The Impact of AI and Digital Platforms on the Information Ecosystem
detail.abstract:
We develop a tractable model to study how AI and digital platforms impact the information ecosystem. News producers — who create truthful or untruthful content that becomes a public good or bad — earn revenue from consumer visits. Consumers search for information and differ in their ability to distinguish truthful from untruthful information. AI and digital platforms influence the ecosystem by: improving the efficiency of processing and transmission of information, endangering the producer business model, changing the relative cost of producing misinformation and altering the ability of consumers to screen quality. We find that in the absence of adequate regulation (accountability, content moderation, and intellectual property protection) the quality of the information ecosystem may decline, both because the equilibrium quantity of truthful information declines and the share of misinformation increases; and polarization may intensify. While some of these problems are already evident with digital platforms, AI may have different, and overall more adverse, impacts.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究AI和数字平台如何影响信息生态系统的模型分析，发现缺乏适当监管时，信息生态系统质量可能下降，真实信息减少而虚假信息增加，极化现象加剧。
AI.research_question: AI和数字平台如何影响信息生态系统？
AI.motivation: 研究AI和数字平台对信息生态系统的影响，特别是在缺乏适当监管的情况下可能带来的负面后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和平台经济学的理论框架，分析新闻生产者、消费者和平台之间的互动关系。
AI.method: 开发了一个可处理的模型，分析AI和数字平台通过四种机制影响信息生态系统：信息处理效率提升、生产者商业模式威胁、虚假信息生产成本变化、消费者筛选能力改变。
AI.findings: 缺乏适当监管时，信息生态系统质量下降，真实信息数量减少，虚假信息比例增加，极化现象加剧；AI的影响可能比数字平台更为负面。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析AI和数字平台影响信息生态系统的理论模型，识别了四种关键影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了监管措施（问责制、内容审核、知识产权保护）的重要性，为政策制定者提供了应对信息生态系统质量下降的建议。

title: What Can Satellite Imagery and Machine Learning Measure?
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC), University of Chicago, University of California, Berkeley, University of California, Berkeley, University of California, Berkeley, University of California, Berkeley, University of California, Berkeley, Stanford University, Stanford University,  and Stanford University

detail.title: What Can Satellite Imagery and Machine Learning Measure?
detail.abstract:
Satellite imagery and machine learning (SIML) are increasingly being combined to remotely measure social and environmental outcomes, yet use of this technology has been limited by insufficient understanding of its strengths and weaknesses. Here, we undertake the most extensive effort yet to characterize the potential and limits of using a SIML technology to measure ground conditions. We conduct 115 standardized large-scale experiments using a composite high-resolution optical image of Earth and a generalizable SIML technology to evaluate what can be accurately measured and where this technology struggles. We find that SIML alone predicts roughly half the variation in ground measurements on average, and that variables describing human society (e.g. female literacy, R2=0.55) are generally as easily measured as natural variables (e.g. bird diversity, R2=0.55). Patterns of performance across measured variable type, space, income and population density indicate that SIML can likely support many new applications and decision-making use cases, although within quantifiable limits.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 卫星影像与机器学习结合可测量社会和环境结果，但存在局限性。通过115个实验发现，该技术平均能预测地面测量约50%的变异，对人类社会变量和自然变量的测量效果相当。
AI.research_question: 卫星影像与机器学习技术测量地面条件的潜力和局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 卫星影像与机器学习结合用于远程测量社会和环境结果的应用日益增多，但对其优缺点理解不足限制了该技术的使用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卫星影像与机器学习结合的遥感测量理论框架
AI.method: 使用地球高分辨率光学图像和通用SIML技术进行115个标准化大规模实验
AI.findings: SIML技术平均能预测地面测量约50%的变异；人类社会变量（如女性识字率）与自然变量（如鸟类多样性）的测量效果相当；性能模式随变量类型、空间、收入和人口密度而变化
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地表征了SIML技术的测量潜力和局限性，为相关理论研究提供了实证基础
AI.practical_contributions: 明确了SIML技术可支持的新应用场景和决策用例，同时指出了其量化限制

title: Incorporating Non-Unitary Income Elasticities, Choke Prices and Choke Incomes into Applied General-Equilibrium Models
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder - Department of Economics

detail.title: Incorporating Non-Unitary Income Elasticities, Choke Prices and Choke Incomes into Applied General-Equilibrium Models
detail.abstract:
Traditional applied general-equilibrium (AGE) models have always faced trade-offs between analytical and computational tractability and counter-empirical restrictions. One is the assumption of homothetic preferences implying unitary income elasticities of demand, significantly inconsistent with data. Similarly, there is no “choke” income level, below which a certain good is not purchased and there is no choke price above which a good is not purchased, implying no changes in the extensive margin of trade. Here I exploit what I will label a Stone-Geary Modified (SGM) formulation. This produces a model in which there are non-unitary income elasticities, choke income levels for some/all goods, and choke prices. The second approach modifies CRIE (constant relative income elasticity) preferences which are preferred for modeling income elasticities, but don’t by themselves permit choke income and prices. While other authors have explored these properties in alternative ways, both my approaches have considerable advantages for high-dimension simulation models in that they retain CES structures and functional forms so that they can slot right into existing modeling formats. They require only small modifications to off-the-shelf cost and expenditure functions, and therefore goods and factor demand functions via Shepard’s lemma. Unobserved parameters can be calibrated from observed data and econometric estimates.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: When the Left-Behind Catch Up: AI Automation Favors the Less Automated
affiliations: Yahoo!

detail.title: When the Left-Behind Catch Up: AI Automation Favors the Less Automated

declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether advances in AI disproportionately accelerate automation in tasks that are already heavily automated or instead drive change in lessautomated areas of work. Using task-level data from the Anthropic Economic Index, I find strong evidence that automation gains are largest in tasks with initially low levels of automation, contradicting the "rich-get-richer" hypothesis. Instead, AI appears to expand automation into new domains, suggesting diminishing returns where automation is already advanced. These findings carry important policy implications: workers in currently low-automation sectors may face sudden disruption, requiring proactive retraining, early warning systems, and adaptive labor policies. Policymakers and firms must recognize that the next wave of AI-induced change will not simply deepen existing trends but broaden automation into areas previously considered less vulnerable.

AI.tldr: AI自动化收益在初始自动化水平较低的任务中最大，这与"富者愈富"假说相反，表明AI将自动化扩展到新领域，在已高度自动化的领域存在收益递减。
AI.research_question: AI进步是否不成比例地加速已经高度自动化的任务，还是推动较少自动化工作领域的变革？
AI.motivation: 理解AI如何影响不同自动化水平的任务，以预测劳动力市场变化并制定相应政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: "富者愈富"假说与收益递减理论
AI.method: 使用Anthropic经济指数的任务级数据进行分析
AI.findings: 自动化收益在初始自动化水平低的任务中最大，AI将自动化扩展到新领域，高度自动化领域存在收益递减
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"富者愈富"假说，支持收益递减理论在AI自动化中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供预警：当前低自动化部门的工人可能面临突然冲击，需要主动再培训、预警系统和适应性劳动力政策

title: Building Trust with a Teachable Artificial Intelligence: The Case of Repeated Trust Games *
affiliations: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), Singapore University of Technology and Design and Singapore University of Technology and Design

detail.title: Building Trust with a Teachable Artificial Intelligence: The Case of Repeated Trust Games *

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval for the study was obtained from the ethical committee of the Singapore University of Technology and Design on 3 May 2023 (IRB-23-00590).
declarations.funderStatement: The financial support received from AI Singapore Governance Grant (AISG3-GV-2021- 005) is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: This study explores the teaching of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems in a repeated trust game. We evaluate whether participants trust the AI and teach it to adopt the most beneficial strategies among a set of four options with different levels of benefit. Results indicate that participants are initially cautious with the AI but increase their trust throughout the experiment, especially those with initially low trust. Participants imperfectly teach the AI, initially adopting beneficial strategies, then progressively learning the most advantageous ones while discarding those that offer minimal or no benefit. We also observe that participants inefficiently choose to avoid positive learning when it involves a risk of large losses. In additional tasks, we observe that participants naturally seek ways to exploit the AI, although a significant portion maintains human fairness in the interaction. Moreover, they effectively transfer prior knowledge to similar tasks. We conclude that participants trust an AI they can teach to generate significant benefits, although the risk of loss limits this trust and the efficiency of teaching.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在重复信任游戏中教授人工智能系统的行为。参与者对AI持谨慎态度但信任度逐渐提升，能够教授AI采用有益策略但教学效率不高，风险规避限制了信任和教学效果。
AI.research_question: 参与者在重复信任游戏中如何信任和教授AI系统？
AI.motivation: 探索人类与AI互动中的信任建立和教学行为，了解人类如何教导AI采用最优策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任游戏理论、人类-AI互动理论、行为经济学中的风险规避理论
AI.method: 重复信任游戏实验，评估参与者对AI的信任度和教学行为
AI.findings: 参与者初始谨慎但信任度提升；能够教授AI采用有益策略但教学不完美；风险规避限制了教学效率；部分参与者试图利用AI但多数保持公平；能够有效转移先验知识
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对人类-AI信任动态的理解，揭示了教学过程中的行为模式，拓展了信任游戏理论在AI互动中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更有效的AI教学系统提供指导，帮助理解人类在AI互动中的风险偏好和教学行为

title: Capital Reallocation and Private Firm Dynamics
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis - Department of Economics, University of Wisconsin-Madison and University of Minnesota - Minneapolis

detail.title: Capital Reallocation and Private Firm Dynamics
detail.abstract:
We develop a theory of firm dynamics and capital reallocation in private firms and use it to study the taxation of business income, capital, and capital gains. Intangible assets—such as customer bases and trade names—are created using owners' time and are infrequently traded in bilateral meetings. We discipline the model with U.S. administrative data, which report purchase prices and counterparties in asset transfers, allowing us to calibrate the investment technology and output elasticity for otherwise unobservable intangible capital. The equilibrium features dispersion in marginal product of capital, transferable share of firm value, and return on business wealth. Introducing taxation, we find that capital gains taxes are most distortionary, primarily by discouraging entry and reallocation of capital, whereas income taxes are least distortionary.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了私营企业动态和资本再配置理论，分析商业收入税、资本税和资本利得税的影响。研究发现无形资产（如客户基础和商誉）由所有者时间创造且交易不频繁，资本利得税对经济扭曲最大，主要抑制企业进入和资本再配置，而所得税扭曲最小。
AI.research_question: 不同税种（商业收入税、资本税、资本利得税）如何影响私营企业的资本再配置和企业动态？
AI.motivation: 理解无形资产在私营企业中的作用以及税收政策对企业进入、退出和资本再配置的影响，为税收政策设计提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业动态理论和资本再配置理论，重点关注无形资产（客户基础、商誉）的创造和交易特性。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，并使用美国行政数据进行校准，这些数据记录了资产转移的购买价格和交易对手方信息。
AI.findings: 均衡状态下存在资本边际产出、企业价值可转移份额和商业财富回报率的分散；资本利得税对经济扭曲最大，主要抑制企业进入和资本再配置，而所得税扭曲最小。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了私营企业动态和资本再配置的理论框架，特别关注无形资产的作用和税收影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税收政策制定提供实证依据，表明资本利得税相比其他税种对经济活动的扭曲更大，有助于优化税收结构设计。

title: Risk-Return Trade-off: The Role of Firm Credit Risk Opacity
affiliations: Universidad Rey Juan Carlos - Facultad de Ciencias Jurisdicas y Sociales, National Distance Education University (UNED) - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration, Universidad Complutense de Madrid (UCM) - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration and National Distance Education University (UNED) - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration

detail.title: Risk-Return Trade-off: The Role of Firm Credit Risk Opacity
detail.abstract: This paper examines the risk-return trade-off in the cross-section of S&P 500 firms, with a focus on the role of firm informational opacity. Using panel data models, we find a robust positive relationship between excess returns and risk, supporting financial theory, but only for transparent firms. In contrast, for opaque firms, no relationship is detected. These results are robust to different risk measures (conditional, unconditional, systematic, idiosyncratic, and downside risk), to alternative panel model specifications, and when considering only highly opaque firms. However, when firms are segmented by credit risk, the positive risk-return relationship, dependent on firm opacity, persists only for investment-grade firms. Among speculative-grade firms, a risk-return relationship is observed regardless of informational opacity. A similar pattern emerges when splitting the sample by market volatility: the results are robust during low-volatility periods, while in high-volatility periods, a risk-return relationship is observed for all firms, irrespective of opacity. This suggests that, under conditions of higher credit risk or heightened market volatility, investors price risk even in the presence of informational opacity, possibly because risk signals become more salient or transparency concerns are temporarily outweighed by broader market dynamics. These findings highlight the importance of transparency in maintaining an effective risk-return mechanism in equity markets but also reveal that this mechanism can be overridden in riskier or more turbulent environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了标普500公司中风险-收益权衡关系，重点关注企业信息不透明度的作用。研究发现，透明企业存在正风险-收益关系，但不透明企业无此关系。在信用风险高或市场波动大的环境下，无论透明度如何，投资者都会对风险定价。
AI.research_question: 企业信息不透明度如何影响标普500公司的风险-收益权衡关系？
AI.motivation: 理解信息不透明度在风险定价中的作用，以及不同市场环境下风险-收益关系的稳定性
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融理论中的风险-收益权衡理论，信息不对称理论
AI.method: 面板数据模型分析，使用多种风险度量指标（条件风险、无条件风险、系统性风险、特质性风险、下行风险）
AI.findings: 透明企业存在稳健的正风险-收益关系，但不透明企业无此关系；在投资级企业中，风险-收益关系依赖于透明度，而在投机级企业中，无论透明度如何都存在风险-收益关系；低波动期结果稳健，高波动期所有企业都存在风险-收益关系
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息透明度在风险定价中的关键作用，以及不同市场环境下风险-收益关系的动态变化
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在不同市场环境下评估风险提供指导，强调了透明度在正常市场环境中的重要性

title: The Weaponization of Presentism and Anti-Woke Discourse: A Critical Framework for Understanding Contemporary Structural Erasure
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Weaponization of Presentism and Anti-Woke Discourse: A Critical Framework for Understanding Contemporary Structural Erasure

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted as independent scholarship

detail.abstract: This study employs critical race theory, institutional analysis, and counter-hegemonic frameworks to examine how contemporary anti-woke discourse weaponizes presentist interpretations of history to facilitate structural erasure through epistemological warfare. Using a novel collaborative methodology that combines traditional critical scholarship with AI-assisted research verification, this analysis demonstrates that the systematic dismantling of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives represents a coordinated institutional response to challenges against white supremacist structures. This analysis argues that anti-woke discourse operates as a state-driven epistemological warfare campaign—a strategic manipulation of knowledge systems and belief structures designed to make structural racism epistemologically invisible while leaving its material structures intact. The analysis reveals a cyclical pattern showing how structural racism adapts to maintain its position in American institutions through controlling narratives, destroying knowledge structures, and excluding alternative epistemologies. The paper documents how this administration's activism aims not merely at policy change but at the permanent destruction of the cognitive infrastructure necessary for multiracial democracy.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用批判种族理论、制度分析和反霸权框架，分析当代反觉醒话语如何利用历史现时主义解读来通过认识论战争促进结构性抹除。研究发现反觉醒话语是一种国家驱动的认识论战争，旨在使结构性种族主义在认识论上隐形，同时保持其物质结构完整。
AI.research_question: 当代反觉醒话语如何利用历史现时主义解读来通过认识论战争促进结构性抹除？
AI.motivation: 分析系统性拆除多元化、公平和包容(DEI)倡议背后的制度性回应机制，揭示结构性种族主义如何适应以维持其在美国制度中的地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判种族理论、制度分析、反霸权框架
AI.method: 结合传统批判学术与AI辅助研究验证的新型协作方法论
AI.findings: 反觉醒话语作为国家驱动的认识论战争运动运作，通过控制叙事、摧毁知识结构和排除替代认识论来维持结构性种族主义。揭示了一个循环模式，显示结构性种族主义如何适应以维持其地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了认识论战争作为分析结构性种族主义维持机制的新理论框架，深化了对制度性种族主义运作方式的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了当前行政活动不仅旨在政策改变，而是永久摧毁多民族民主所需的认知基础设施，为反种族主义实践提供了理论依据。

title: Climate Change, Conflict, and the Risk of Economic Collapse in Africa
affiliations: , Stanford University - Department of Earth System Science and the FSE, University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and Stanford University

detail.title: Climate Change, Conflict, and the Risk of Economic Collapse in Africa
detail.abstract:
Is human-caused climate change likely to trigger enduring economic decline in modern societies? We study whether changes in violent conflict and economic growth caused by warming could interact to degrade economic opportunities and trap African countries in poverty. We provide evidence of an emerging high-conflict and low-growth "poverty trap" equilibrium in Africa and describe theoretically how such an equilibrium could result from warming. We then combine historical data on temperature, growth, and conflict with projections from a large ensemble of global climate models to evaluate the risk that warming and subsequent conflict could push African economies into a regime of sustained negative economic growth. We find that the risk of such "economic collapse" is material in a moderate-to-high emissions scenario. We estimate that in Africa, a current "high" emissions trajectory (RCP 7.0) may increase the incidence of conflict 5.1 percentage points (95% CI 0.2-13.0) and increase the share of countries with net negative GDP growth this century by 12.2 percentage points (95% CI 2.0-27.5). We calculate that roughly 82% of this additional conflict risk and 14% of projected GDP losses are due to the interacting effects between these two outcomes, underscoring the importance of accounting for their indirect effects and feedbacks. Our findings suggest an unprecedented scale of emissions mitigation, economic policy innovation or institutional investment that would be required to contain the risk of catastrophic human impacts from climate change in many African countries.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 气候变化可能导致非洲国家陷入高冲突、低增长的贫困陷阱，在中等至高排放情景下，非洲面临经济崩溃的实质性风险。RCP 7.0排放路径可能使冲突发生率增加5.1个百分点，负增长国家比例增加12.2个百分点。
AI.research_question: 人类引起的气候变化是否可能引发现代社会的持久经济衰退？气候变化导致的暴力冲突和经济增长变化是否会相互作用，使非洲国家陷入贫困陷阱？
AI.motivation: 研究气候变化、冲突和经济增长之间的相互作用，评估气候变化对非洲经济稳定的威胁，特别是贫困陷阱风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贫困陷阱理论，气候变化与冲突的相互作用机制，经济增长与冲突的反馈循环。
AI.method: 结合历史温度、增长和冲突数据，使用全球气候模型的大规模集合进行预测分析，评估经济崩溃风险。
AI.findings: 在中等至高排放情景下，非洲面临经济崩溃的实质性风险。RCP 7.0排放路径可能使冲突发生率增加5.1个百分点，负增长国家比例增加12.2个百分点，其中82%的额外冲突风险和14%的GDP损失源于两者的相互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了气候变化、冲突和经济增长相互作用的贫困陷阱机制理论，揭示了间接效应和反馈循环的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了气候变化经济风险的具体量化评估，强调了需要前所未有的减排力度、经济政策创新或制度投资来应对气候变化在非洲的灾难性影响。

title: Best-of/Worst-of Rainbow Futures: Closed-Form Pricing and Properties
affiliations: University College London

detail.title: Best-of/Worst-of Rainbow Futures: Closed-Form Pricing and Properties
detail.abstract: We derive a closed-form analytic approximation for Best-of/Worst-of rainbow futures in large baskets with heterogeneous forwards, volatilities, and correlations under Black-Scholes dynamics. The key ingredients are: (i) a covariance least-squares equicorrelation proxy that reduces the problem to a one-factor structure; and (ii) a deterministic-threshold representation for balanced rank selection based on the mixture median of log-forwards. A simple but important practical message is that for large universes (N ≈ 100), the proxy level can be taken as the plain average correlation with negligible impact: the difference between the volatility-weighted proxy and the plain mean is controlled by the cross-sectional covariance between the squared vol products and the pairwise correlations. We provide explicit error controls: a √ T times Frobenius norm term for the covariance projection, an O(N-1/2) threshold error, and a small bias from dropping the common factor inside selection. Expressions are provided for both futures and their spread along with a first-order daily P&L decomposition exposing market level, momentum tilt, dispersion, correlation, and theta exposures.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了在Black-Scholes动态下，具有异质性远期、波动率和相关性的大型篮子中Best-of/Worst-of彩虹期权的闭式解析近似解。关键方法包括协方差最小二乘等相关系数代理和基于对数远期混合中位数的确定性阈值表示。研究发现对于大型资产组合（N≈100），代理水平可简单取平均相关性，且提供了明确的误差控制。
AI.research_question: 如何在具有异质性远期、波动率和相关性的大型篮子中推导Best-of/Worst-of彩虹期权的闭式解析近似解？
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以处理大型资产组合中彩虹期权的定价问题，需要开发有效的近似方法来解决这一计算挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Black-Scholes动态模型，采用协方差最小二乘等相关系数代理和确定性阈值表示的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用协方差最小二乘等相关系数代理将问题简化为单因子结构，并基于对数远期混合中位数构建平衡秩选择的确定性阈值表示。
AI.findings: 对于大型资产组合（N≈100），代理水平可简单取平均相关性，且提供了明确的误差控制：协方差投影的√T倍Frobenius范数项、O(N-1/2)阈值误差，以及忽略选择中共同因子的小偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 推导了Best-of/Worst-of彩虹期权的闭式解析近似解，建立了误差控制理论框架，为大型资产组合期权定价提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了期货及其价差的显式表达式，以及一阶每日P&L分解，揭示了市场水平、动量倾斜、离散度、相关性和theta暴露，为实际交易和风险管理提供了实用工具。

title:
"Essential Uses" and "Non-Essential Uses" in (Environmental) Law 

Analysis of the Concept of "Essential Uses" and "Non-Essential Uses" under Selected International, EU and US Federal Law
affiliations: Independent Researcher and K.U. Leuven

detail.title:
"Essential Uses" and "Non-Essential Uses" in (Environmental) Law 

Analysis of the Concept of "Essential Uses" and "Non-Essential Uses" under Selected International, EU and US Federal Law
detail.abstract:
(non-)essential use has been gaining traction in chemicals policy. The authors have analysed “essential” and “non-essential” use under selected parts of International law, EU law, and US federal law with particular focus given to derogations/exemptions to a general prohibition/restriction which are (i) granted based on essentiality (or equivalent concepts) or (ii) are not granted because of non-essentiality (or equivalent concepts).

We conducted a thorough review of essential uses approaches in 9 legal sources: The Montreal Protocol; the US Clean Air Act 1977; the EU Regulation 517/2014 on fluorinated greenhouse gases; the Stockholm Convention on persistent organic pollutants; the EU POPs Regulation 2019/1021; the EU Regulation 528/2012 on biocidal products; the EU Regulation 1107/2009 on plant protection products; the EU Directive 2011/65 on hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment; and the EU Regulation 1333/2008 on food additives.

The study concludes that deployment of an essential use justification in this complex area of the law is rare. The Montreal Protocol appears to be an outlier in the regulation of hazardous substances with an essential use approach, and our analysis of the 1978 US forerunner to that approach is a most relevant element, we submit, in the current discussions on essential uses.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际法、欧盟法和美国联邦法中关于“必要使用”和“非必要使用”概念的应用，特别关注基于必要性概念的豁免条款。研究发现，在危险物质监管领域，必要使用理由的应用较为罕见，蒙特利尔议定书是该领域的特例。
AI.research_question: 在国际法、欧盟法和美国联邦法中，基于必要性概念（或等效概念）的豁免条款如何应用？
AI.motivation: 必要使用概念在化学品政策中日益受到关注，需要系统分析其在现有法律框架中的实际应用情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际法、欧盟法和美国联邦法的法律分析框架，重点关注必要性概念在危险物质监管中的法律地位。
AI.method: 对9个法律来源进行彻底审查：蒙特利尔议定书、美国清洁空气法1977、欧盟氟化温室气体法规517/2014、斯德哥尔摩持久性有机污染物公约、欧盟POPs法规2019/1021、欧盟生物杀灭剂产品法规528/2012、欧盟植物保护产品法规1107/2009、欧盟电子电气设备有害物质指令2011/65、欧盟食品添加剂法规1333/2008。
AI.findings: 在危险物质监管这一复杂法律领域，必要使用理由的应用较为罕见。蒙特利尔议定书在采用必要使用方法方面是一个特例。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了必要使用概念在不同法律体系中的实际应用状况，为化学品政策理论发展提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前关于必要使用的讨论提供了重要的法律分析参考，特别是对美国1978年相关先例的分析具有现实意义。

title: Gender and Urban Fiscal Governance: Evidence from Female Leadership in Indian Municipal Corporations
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur

detail.title: Gender and Urban Fiscal Governance: Evidence from Female Leadership in Indian Municipal Corporations
detail.abstract: This study examines how female leadership shapes fiscal outcomes in India's Municipal Corporations, which, despite comprising only 5.5% of Urban Local Bodies, control 60-65% of aggregate municipal revenues. Integrating representative bureaucracy and fiscal federalism theories, we analyze a novel panel dataset of 201 corporations over 2018-2024-hand-curated leadership records and detailed budgets-supplemented by state-level aggregates from RBI reports (2022, 2024). Employing two-way fixed effects, instrumental variables, and Callaway-Sant'Anna staggered difference-indifferences , we find that female-led corporations expand total budgets by 15-20%, strengthen own-source revenue through enhanced tax and user-charge collection, and reallocate expenditures toward service delivery. Dynamic analysis reveals pronounced fiscal shifts within the first year of tenure. The findings provide the first evidence of gendered fiscal dynamics in Indian cities and carry direct implications for gender-responsive reforms in urban public finance. Findings also inform policy prescriptions, namely, strengthening mayoral authority, synchronizing tenures with budget cycles, and embedding gender-responsive performance metrics in intergovernmental transfers.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度市政公司中女性领导对财政结果的影响，发现女性领导的市政公司总预算增加15-20%，通过改善税收和使用费征收来加强自有收入，并将支出重新分配到服务提供上。
AI.research_question: 女性领导如何影响印度市政公司的财政结果？
AI.motivation: 尽管市政公司仅占城市地方机构的5.5%，但控制着60-65%的市政总收入，研究女性领导对这些重要财政实体的影响具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代表性官僚制理论和财政联邦主义理论
AI.method: 使用2018-2024年201个市政公司的面板数据，采用双向固定效应、工具变量和Callaway-Sant'Anna交错差分法
AI.findings: 女性领导的市政公司总预算扩大15-20%，通过改善税收和使用费征收加强自有收入，支出向服务提供重新分配，财政转变在任职第一年内最为明显
AI.theory_contributions: 为印度城市中的性别化财政动态提供了首个证据，整合了代表性官僚制和财政联邦主义理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为性别响应型城市公共财政改革提供直接启示，包括加强市长权力、任期与预算周期同步、在政府间转移支付中嵌入性别响应型绩效指标

title: Market Interventions and Investor Sentiment in China’s Stock Market
affiliations: Dongbei University of Finance & Economics, University of Cincinnati - Department of Finance - Real Estate, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics (DUFE)

detail.title: Market Interventions and Investor Sentiment in China’s Stock Market
detail.abstract: The supply of initial public offerings is closely aligned with investor sentiment, serving as the Chinese government’s primary instrument to counteract sentiment-driven equity demand. Using this novel measure, we document a significantly negative relation between sentiment betas and expected stock returns in China’s equity market. Earnings extrapolation drives the overvaluation of high-sentiment-beta stocks, while short-sale constraints and the disposition effect impede correction. The anomaly is concentrated in large state-owned enterprises with close government ties, highlighting that market interventions are a critical source of mispricing alongside investors’ animal spirits (Brunnermeier, Sockin, and Xiong, 2022).

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现中国股市中情绪贝塔与预期股票回报呈显著负相关，这种异常现象主要由收益外推、卖空限制和处置效应驱动，且集中在与政府关系密切的大型国有企业中。
AI.research_question: 中国股市中情绪贝塔与预期股票回报之间的关系是什么？这种关系的驱动机制是什么？
AI.motivation: IPO供应与投资者情绪密切相关，是中国政府应对情绪驱动股票需求的主要工具，需要研究这种干预对市场定价的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Brunnermeier等人的动物精神理论，结合收益外推、卖空限制和处置效应等行为金融学理论框架。
AI.method: 使用情绪贝塔作为新度量，分析其与预期股票回报的关系，并检验相关驱动机制。
AI.findings: 情绪贝塔与预期股票回报呈显著负相关；收益外推导致高情绪贝塔股票被高估；卖空限制和处置效应阻碍价格修正；异常现象集中在与政府关系密切的大型国企。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场干预是错误定价的重要来源，补充了投资者动物精神理论，提供了中国情境下的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者识别错误定价机会提供指导，为监管机构优化市场干预政策提供参考，有助于理解政府干预对市场效率的影响。

title: Dynamically Optimal Fertility Subsidy: A Policy to Escape from the Empty Planet
affiliations: University of Macau and University of Macau - Department of Economics

detail.title: Dynamically Optimal Fertility Subsidy: A Policy to Escape from the Empty Planet
detail.abstract: Evidence indicates that fertility rates in many high-income countries have fallen below the replacement level, implying long-term population decline and potentially leading to the "Empty Planet" scenario. This study examines how a dynamic fertility policy can serve as a timely intervention to prevent this outcome. Our theoretical analysis shows that implementing an optimal fertility subsidy as soon as possible is crucial to avoid an economy with negative population growth becoming stuck in the Empty Planet. Moreover, a time-variant fertility subsidy is necessary to achieve a steady state with both positive population and economic growth. Using aggregate data from Japan, we find that the current fertility subsidy rate is insufficient to reverse the negative population growth trend. Additionally, our quantitative analysis outlines the optimal fertility subsidy trajectory and suggests that the welfare loss from applying a long-run optimal fertility subsidy, rather than a dynamically first-best subsidy, depends on the economy's distance from the targeted steady state.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨动态生育政策如何作为及时干预措施防止"空荡星球"情景。理论分析表明，尽早实施最优生育补贴对避免负人口增长经济体陷入空荡星球至关重要，且需要时变生育补贴来实现人口和经济正增长的稳态。基于日本数据的定量分析发现当前补贴率不足，并确定了最优补贴轨迹。
AI.research_question: 动态生育政策如何作为及时干预措施防止"空荡星球"情景？
AI.motivation: 许多高收入国家生育率已低于更替水平，可能导致长期人口下降和"空荡星球"情景
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优生育补贴理论、动态生育政策理论、人口经济学理论
AI.method: 理论分析和基于日本汇总数据的定量分析
AI.findings: 1. 当前生育补贴率不足以逆转负人口增长趋势；2. 需要时变生育补贴实现人口和经济正增长的稳态；3. 尽早实施最优生育补贴对避免陷入空荡星球至关重要；4. 福利损失取决于经济体与目标稳态的距离
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了动态生育政策理论，提出了时变生育补贴的必要性，建立了避免空荡星球情景的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了最优生育补贴轨迹的定量指导，强调了及时干预的重要性，有助于防止人口下降和空荡星球情景

title: Designing Interim Deadlines for Time-Inconsistent Agents
affiliations: Hunan University

detail.title: Designing Interim Deadlines for Time-Inconsistent Agents
detail.abstract: This paper studies the optimal design of interim deadlines in divisible projects. Production uncertainty generates value for flexibility, while time-inconsistent agent preferences create demand for commitment. The principal seeks timely project completion at the lowest compensation cost, whereas the agent may privately benefit from delay. The optimal contract specifies a fixed wage conditional on both meeting an interim deadline and completing the project on time. The optimal interim deadline requires a minimum level of early-stage output, which increases with the agent's time inconsistency but decreases with the project's difficulty. Under severe time inconsistency, however, the interim deadline may become dispensable due to substitution between internal and external commitments. Consequently, the optimal contract for a more inconsistent agent may appear more flexible.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可分项目中临时截止日期的最优设计。生产不确定性产生灵活性价值，而时间不一致的代理人偏好产生承诺需求。最优合同规定固定工资，条件是既满足临时截止日期又按时完成项目。最优临时截止日期要求最低水平的早期产出，该水平随代理人时间不一致性增加而增加，但随项目难度增加而减少。然而，在严重时间不一致的情况下，由于内部和外部承诺之间的替代，临时截止日期可能变得可有可无。因此，对于更不一致的代理人，最优合同可能显得更灵活。
AI.research_question: 可分项目中临时截止日期的最优设计是什么？
AI.motivation: 生产不确定性产生灵活性价值，而时间不一致的代理人偏好产生承诺需求。委托人希望以最低补偿成本及时完成项目，而代理人可能从延迟中私下获益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论、时间不一致偏好理论、项目截止日期设计理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，研究最优合同设计和临时截止日期的设定
AI.findings: 最优合同规定固定工资，条件是既满足临时截止日期又按时完成项目。最优临时截止日期要求最低水平的早期产出，该水平随代理人时间不一致性增加而增加，但随项目难度增加而减少。在严重时间不一致的情况下，临时截止日期可能变得可有可无。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了内部承诺和外部承诺之间的替代关系，解释了为什么对于更不一致的代理人，最优合同可能显得更灵活。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者设计项目截止日期和激励机制提供了理论指导，特别是在面对时间不一致的员工时如何平衡灵活性和承诺需求。

title: Credit Markets and Racial Mortality Inequality
affiliations: Fordham University  , National Bank of Denmark, Fordham University and Halle Institute for Economic Research

detail.title: Credit Markets and Racial Mortality Inequality
detail.abstract: This paper tests whether and how local banking market conditions affect mortality rates in the United States. Exploiting the staggered relaxation of branching restrictions in the 1990s across states, we find that banking deregulation decreases local mortality rates. This effect is driven by a decrease in the mortality rate of black residents, implying a decrease in the black-white mortality gap. We provide evidence for expanding the healthcare sector in black communities, access to private health insurance, and home ownership as channels through which local banking markets affect individuals’ longevity and decrease mortality inequality.

title: Modeling Euro Area Benchmark Rates After the End of LIBOR
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Modeling Euro Area Benchmark Rates After the End of LIBOR
detail.abstract: We adopt an affine short-rate model for the contemporaneous evolution of the term structures based on EURIBOR and on €STR. The model builds on the observation that the risk-free rate follows a constant trajectory and moves only at deterministic times (depending on the European Central Bank meetings). We calibrate the model using Kalman filtering and compare its performances to the dynamic Nelson-Siegel model. The model is able to reproduce some common features of the term structure dynamics, such as the “snake” shaped term structure volatility and the fact that the volatility increases in periods containing the meeting dates. We analyze the sensitivity of the €STR term structure to variations in monetary policy expectations and apply the model to estimate the level and the probability distribution of the future rates, and to show how to compute the fallback risk of a on-going contract in case EURIBOR would be replaced by €STR.

AI.tldr: 本文采用仿射短期利率模型分析EURIBOR和€STR利率期限结构的动态演化，该模型假设无风险利率在ECB会议期间发生确定性变动。通过卡尔曼滤波校准并与动态Nelson-Siegel模型比较，模型能重现期限结构波动率的'蛇形'特征和会议期间波动率上升现象。应用包括分析€STR对货币政策预期的敏感性、估计未来利率水平和概率分布，以及计算EURIBOR被€STR替代时的回退风险。
AI.research_question: 如何有效建模EURIBOR和€STR利率期限结构的动态演化，并分析货币政策预期对€STR的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着€STR逐渐替代EURIBOR成为欧元区基准利率，需要开发能够准确捕捉两个利率期限结构动态特征的模型，以支持风险管理和金融产品定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于仿射短期利率模型框架，假设无风险利率在ECB会议期间发生确定性跳跃，结合期限结构理论。
AI.method: 采用卡尔曼滤波技术进行模型校准，并与动态Nelson-Siegel模型进行性能比较。
AI.findings: 模型能重现期限结构波动率的'蛇形'特征，会议期间波动率显著上升，€STR对货币政策预期变化敏感。

title: The Impact of Immunotherapy on Reductions in Cancer Mortality: Evidence from Medicare
affiliations: , University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, Stanford University - Department of Economics and University of Southern California

detail.title: The Impact of Immunotherapy on Reductions in Cancer Mortality: Evidence from Medicare
detail.abstract: Immunotherapy is a breakthrough innovation in cancer care but is also among the most expensive treatments, with costs exceeding $150,000 per patient. We study the introduction of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), the most widely used class of immunotherapy drugs. In 2022, ICIs accounted for 44% of the $17.5 billion Medicare Part B cancer drug spending. We focus on metastatic melanoma, the first approved indication for ICIs. While overall cancer mortality rates declined since the 1990s, melanoma mortality rates increased through the early 2010s. Following the first ICI approvals in 2011 and 2014, melanoma mortality declined sharply. Using traditional Medicare claims, we estimate the impact of the introduction of ICIs on healthcare utilization, costs, and 1-year survival for patients with metastatic melanoma, relative to metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC), where ICIs were not approved until 2017. Variation in approval timing allows us to isolate the effect of ICIs from broader cancer care trends. We find that ICIs reduced 1-year mortality by 6.2%. Since about 1 in 5 metastatic melanoma patients received ICIs, this implies a 27.5% reduction among treated patients. The introduction of ICIs also reduced chemotherapy and radiation use, but increased Medicare spending by 59.3% or about 260% among ICI-treated patients. Accounting for life expectancy gains beyond one year, the benefits of ICIs for melanoma patients appear comparable, or potentially even greater, than the substantial added Medicare costs. Nonetheless, ICI use remains relatively low given large survival benefits and few alternative treatments, suggesting that costsand other barriers limit patient access.

AI.tldr: 免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）的引入显著降低了转移性黑色素瘤患者的1年死亡率（6.2%），但使Medicare支出增加了59.3%。尽管ICIs带来了巨大的生存获益，但由于成本和其他障碍，其使用率仍然相对较低。
AI.research_question: 免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）的引入对转移性黑色素瘤患者的医疗资源利用、成本和1年生存率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 免疫疗法是癌症治疗的突破性创新，但也是最昂贵的治疗方法之一。ICIs占Medicare Part B癌症药物支出的44%，需要评估其成本效益和患者可及性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用ICIs在不同癌症类型中批准时间的差异（黑色素瘤2011/2014年批准 vs 结直肠癌2017年批准），通过准实验设计分离ICIs的净效应。
AI.method: 使用传统Medicare索赔数据，比较转移性黑色素瘤和转移性结直肠癌患者在ICIs引入前后的医疗资源利用、成本和1年生存率变化。
AI.findings: ICIs使1年死亡率降低6.2%（治疗患者降低27.5%），减少了化疗和放疗使用，但Medicare支出增加59.3%（治疗患者增加260%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了ICIs在真实世界中的成本效益证据，展示了创新癌症治疗在医疗系统中的实际影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供ICIs的成本效益分析，强调了在确保患者可及性的同时控制医疗支出的重要性。
